title: Two-stage Residual Learning for Modelling Strength-Informed Optimisation of Thermal Systems
summary: Aggregate performance metrics do not identify local modelling inaccuracies in machine learning (ML) surrogates used for thermal-system optimisation. This study assesses local modelling strength through validation-based reliability screening and post-optimisation residual assessment. A two-stage residual learning (TSRL) framework, built on artificial neural networks (ANNs), is developed for modelling-strength-informed and domain-constrained optimisation of thermal systems. Within the TSRL framework, a base ANN predicts the process output, and a residual ANN learns the signed residuals left by the base ANN. The TSRL framework is implemented on two case studies of thermal systems, including 817 simulation observations of a crude distillation unit and operating records from a 395 MW industrial gas turbine. The TSRL framework reduces the test root mean square error (RMSE) from 10.3 g/s to 4.7 g/s for Fuel Oil in the refinery dataset and from 151 kJ/kWh to 105 kJ/kWh for turbine heat rate (THR). The base ANNs trained within TSRL are embedded in domain-constrained optimisation problems, and the modelling strength at each computed solution is assessed using the locked residual-score threshold. Each computed solution receives a good modelled region (GMR) or weak modelled region (WMR) label to inform ML model-based decision-making for safety-critical operation of thermal systems.

title: Cross-Scenario Industrial Defect Detection via Domain-Robust Training and Metric-Aligned Selection
comments: This paper has been accepted for presentation in IEEE ICME 2026
summary: Automated defect detection of industrial boards must remain highly reliable under cross-scenario variations in lighting, surface contaminants, and production line conditions. This makes cross-scenario defect detection a domain generalization problem, wherein models are required to detect, localize, and classify defects across unseen scenarios while minimizing false alarms on clean boards. For the IDA 2026 Track 1 challenge, we propose a cross-scenario defect detection method that includes four complementary modules: cross-scenario robust training, small-defect-aware learning, score calibration and inference threshold selection, and metric-aligned checkpoint selection. These four modules respectively introduce cross-scenario robust normalization and DSU-style statistic perturbation with progressive random convolution, NWD and parameter-free spatial attention, the VFL learning objective, and a custom SWAD variant driven by the Track 1-oriented proxy. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves a Track 1 score of 0.564 with a screening score of 0.696 on the test dataset on a single RTX 4090 GPU. The code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/Dikai.

title: GS-PRM: Gaussian Visual Roadmap for Image-Goal Navigation
summary: Image-goal navigation requires a global planner that connects visually specified endpoints while providing observations that a local policy can follow. Three-dimensional Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides map-registered RGB, opacity, and depth renderings, but does not explicitly encode navigable topology. We introduce \method, a Gaussian visual roadmap whose milestones, local connections, and visual references are constructed directly through 3DGS rendering without deriving an occupancy grid or signed distance field. We define render-based collision-free (RC-free) configurations and paths. Panoramic depth supplies conservative clearance for milestone validation and adaptive coverage, while edge-aligned orthographic rendering tests the robot's swept volume. We establish conditional soundness and sufficient conditions for deterministic query completeness and probabilistic construction completeness of GS-PRM. To validate the performance of GS-PRM, we conduct experiments in both simulated and real-world environments, demonstrating long-horizon navigation using goal-conditioned policies guided by GS-PRM. Compared with a state-of-the-art 3DGS-based navigation system, our GS-PRM-based navigation system achieves up to a twice higher average success rate and reduces travel time by up to 57.2% when both systems complete the navigation task.

title: General Classification for Digital Knowledge: Algorithm, Identifiers and a First Benchmark
summary: Digital libraries and knowledge graphs need a way to organize very large collections so that related works are close and any work is quick to reach. The classifications libraries inherited for this, such as LCC and DDC, are maintained by editorial staff, are partly closed, and were not built against a stated, measurable objective. We propose the opposite: a general classification that is fitted, under the constraints that make a classification usable on a shelf or in a browse list, to the same quantity that a companion survey and benchmark (Awad, 2026) ranks existing schemes by. The objective is J = D + 0.005 N, where D is the normalized Dasgupta cost of the class tree on a fixed similarity graph (Dasgupta, 2016) and N is an expected navigation cost in bits with a per-level charge. Two constraints are hard: every class is a contiguous run of one fixed shelf order (the optimal-alphabetic-tree constraint of Hu and Tucker, 1971), and new works are filed by splitting leaf classes only, so that every existing class keeps its code, label and parent. On a corpus of 10,000 arXiv papers the fitted prototype has 110 hand-labelled classes and reaches cost 0.1722 in sample (average linkage 0.1518; arXiv's own categories 0.3333; the best existing scheme reached through the same lexical classifier 0.6414, from the survey). Filing 500 library books as new works created 16 classes and changed no existing identifier. Fit, filing and scoring share one embedding: the held-out skill of 0.922 falls to 0.896 when the same fit is scored on the graphs of the two other models, and on books the average falls from 0.806 to 0.731. The scheme has also seen only arXiv, and labels for inserted classes are weak. We state those limits plainly, release the scheme as CC0 open data, and ask whether a learned, open, order-preserving classification can become a general one.

title: GraphRAG-LTM: A Layered Threat Modeling Framework for Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) uses document-derived knowledge graphs to assemble evidence for large language model (LLM) answers. Its security depends on both the seed chunks retrieved for a query and the graph evidence assembled from them, yet attacks on this evidence path remain underexplored. We introduce GraphRAG-LTM, a Layered Threat Modeling framework that tests three nested levels of attacker access. BB Query uses ranking feedback to make query edits under a semantic-similarity constraint and demote relevant seed chunks. WB Query uses retriever gradients for the same objective. Graph-aware WB keeps the white-box adversarial query and deletes bridge triplets from the query-specific evidence graph, disrupting multi-hop evidence propagation through localized graph edits. Across datasets, retrievers, and LLM backbones, rank feedback alone reduces answer quality, gradient access strengthens query attacks, and bridge-triplet deletion further impairs supporting-fact retrieval. Further analyses show how seed retrieval and graph evidence jointly contribute to these failures.

title: LabCompiler: A Framework for Verifiable Human-Machine Laboratory Execution from Imperfect Protocols
summary: Closing the loop of AI-driven science requires reliably translating natural-language protocols into executable laboratory workflows despite protocol defects and heterogeneous hardware. Existing approaches often couple scientific interpretation with device-specific code generation, making errors difficult to localize and limiting reuse across laboratory platforms. We introduce LabCompiler, a robust protocol-to-execution framework that transforms imperfect natural-language protocols into verifiable human-machine workflows. Its protocol firewall diagnoses and repairs defects before compilation while preserving unaffected content, guided by troubleshooting knowledge accumulated through perturbation-guided self-evolution. A two-level, device-agnostic graph representation separates experimental semantics from hardware-specific implementation and supports capability-based device assignment with coordinated human execution. We further introduce a protocol recovery benchmark covering four controlled perturbation types and naturally occurring errors collected from protocols written by iGEM participants. Experiments show that LabCompiler outperforms frontier LLMs in protocol error correction while enabling coordinated human-machine execution across heterogeneous, partially automated laboratory settings.

title: TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering
summary: Text-to-image models increasingly generate readable Chinese text that still contains local rendering defects, such as a character with an extra or missing stroke or a malformed component. Such errors are invisible to OCR and vision-language models, which are trained for recognition and are therefore invariant to the very structural deviations that define a rendering error. We formalize text rendering verification as a target-conditioned problem: given a target character and an image crop, decide whether the crop is a correct rendering of that character. Our verifier TEXTVERIFIER feeds the text tower a character's Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) rather than a single-character symbol, and is trained on 12.7M crop-IDS pairs plus label-free "same-character, different-quality" hard pairs sampled from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. To evaluate this ability we build TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH, the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text, annotating position, identity, and correctness for 7,358 characters. TEXTVERIFIER reaches an F1 of 0.844, far above OCR confidence (0.526), a general VLM (0.329), and TextPecker (0.590). Used as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO post-training, it further reduces rendering errors, showing that its score can both detect and correct errors.

title: Test-Time Forecasting: Recurrent Depth Enables In-Context Dynamics Prediction
summary: Foundation models for dynamical systems can forecast unseen partial differential equations (PDEs), ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and time series during inference. However, it remains an open question whether these foundation models truly learn generalizable in-context forecasting strategies. We show that looped transformers are capable of emulating propagators for dynamical systems in-context by first establishing a link between linear attention and (extended) dynamic mode decomposition. We then generalize this insight into the $\textit{Test-Time Forecasting}$ (TTF) framework in which a one-step forecaster leverages iterations of gradient descent as recurrent depth. We demonstrate that lightweight TTF models trained on ODEs and PDEs generalize to out-of-distribution system dynamics during autoregressive rollout after being trained for one-step prediction. Our results reinforce TTF as a theoretically motivated framework for designing recurrent depth models capable of forecasting unseen dynamical systems at test-time.

title: Speaking Longer Than Learned: Training-Free Long-Form Generation for Full-Stream Text-to-Speech
summary: Recent full-stream text-to-speech (TTS) models enable low-latency personalized synthesis as input text arrives. However, sustaining generation beyond the lengths seen during training without additional training remains largely unexplored. We systematically analyze VoXtream2, which extends generation by periodically discarding past context while retaining the acoustic prompt. We find that this strategy does not prevent degradation: pronunciation accuracy deteriorates near the end of the training range due to the range of positions in which the model operates rather than the loss of past context, while speaker similarity gradually declines throughout generation. Based on these findings, we propose two training-free modifications that reduce the attention window and strengthen attention to the acoustic prompt. Experiments show that these modifications preserve pronunciation accuracy and speaker similarity throughout long-form generation while retaining the naturalness of the original model. Ablations further show complementary effects of the two modifications.

title: Evidence-Anchored Overdose Death Prediction from Death Investigation Reports
summary: Confirmation of overdose deaths in the United States is often delayed due to the complexities of certifying drug-involved deaths. Death investigation reports represent a rich but underutilized data source that could be used to predict whether a death is a suspected overdose (i.e., a death preliminarily identified as an overdose prior to the final cause and manner of death determination). We present an automated framework that classifies suspected overdoses from death investigation reports, while producing supporting explanations guided by expert knowledge. Through an expert-guided design process, we investigate 1) what type of explanations are best for model prediction performance, and 2) which architecture is better suited for this task: pipeline models that rationalize first and then predict, or self-rationalizing models that jointly predict and rationalize? Our experiments show that a pipeline model with explanations grounded in the input death investigation reports outperforms the other settings. Our best model also outperforms a rule-based system currently in deployment by 15%, while allowing expert interventions for final decisions.

title: TEX-MEX: Similarity-Guided Temporal Contrastive Learning for Time Series
summary: Contrastive learning for time series depends on deciding which pairs of inputs should be treated as similar and dissimilar. Because few augmentations reliably preserve meaning in time series, prior methods have relied on two disjoint notions of similarity between windows: structural similarity, which relates windows with similar morphology, and temporal similarity, which relates windows that occur close together in time. We introduce TEX-MEX, to our knowledge the first approach to unify the two into a single relationship. Given a random batch of windows drawn across the dataset, TEX-MEX uses the encoder to identify which windows are structurally similar or dissimilar to each other. It then pulls each window toward the temporally shifted versions of similar windows and pushes it away from those of dissimilar ones, learning what typically accompanies similar windows in time. Across PPG, EEG, ECG, accelerometry, and continuous glucose monitoring, TEX-MEX broadly achieves state-of-the-art performance against contrastive, reconstructive, JEPA-based, and modality-specific approaches, establishing it as a strong general SSL objective. We further train a 560K-parameter PPG foundation model that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a broad range of downstream benchmarks while being roughly 50x smaller than the next-best unimodally pretrained PPG foundation model in our evaluation. We will release this foundation model open-source and open-weight to the community to support future work and practical applications.

title: The Two-Level Poset Game is PSPACE-Complete
summary: Poset games form a fundamental class of combinatorial games that includes classical games such as Nim and Chomp. Determining the outcome of a poset game is known to be PSPACE-complete even for posets of height at most three. However, the exact computational complexity of Two-Level Poset Game, played on posets of height at most two, has remained an open problem for over a decade. We resolve this problem by proving that Two-Level Poset Game is PSPACE-complete via a polynomial-time reduction from Avoid True on positive CNF formulas.

title: Learning Visual Speech Representations via Cross-Modal Distillation and Joint Face-Lip Modeling
summary: Lipreading remains challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of visual speech cues and their sensitivity to head pose and video resolution. In this work, we propose FLARE, a framework for robust visual speech representation learning via cross-modal distillation and joint face-lip modeling. FLARE leverages semantically rich Whisper representations as the acoustic teacher signal, converting them into discrete distillation targets through a random-projection quantizer and pretraining the model with a masked prediction objective. To capture complementary visual information, FLARE employs a dual-stream architecture that jointly processes lip region-of-interest (ROI) and full-face inputs, where the lip stream captures finegrained articulatory motion and the face stream encodes broader facial dynamics. During pretraining, auxiliary audio input is incorporated to facilitate cross-modal alignment, and modality dropout is applied to encourage robust visual-only representations. For downstream lipreading, FLARE serves as a visual encoder coupled with either a lightweight Transformer decoder or an LLM-based decoder. Evaluated on LRS2, LRS3, and the out-of-domain WildVSR benchmark, FLARE achieves strong lipreading performance, with word error rates of 11.7%, 13.2%, and 34.3%, respectively. A progressive design study confirms the contribution of each major component. Further analyses demonstrate that joint face-lip modeling improves robustness under degraded video resolution and large head pose variation, while yielding more phoneme-discriminative visual representations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/jxzhanggg/FLARE.

AI.title_translation: 通过跨模态蒸馏和联合面部-唇部建模学习视觉语音表示
AI.tldr: FLARE是一个通过跨模态蒸馏和联合面部-唇部建模来学习鲁棒视觉语音表示的框架，在唇读任务上取得了SOTA性能，并在视频质量下降和头部姿态变化下表现出更高的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 唇读仍然具有挑战性，因为视觉语音线索固有的模糊性以及它们对头部姿态和视频分辨率的敏感性。
AI.method: 本文提出了FLARE框架，通过跨模态蒸馏和联合面部-唇部建模来学习鲁棒的视觉语音表示。FLARE利用语义丰富的Whisper表示作为声学教师信号，通过随机投影量化器将其转换为离散蒸馏目标，并使用掩码预测目标进行模型预训练。它采用双流架构，联合处理唇部ROI和全脸输入，唇部流捕获精细的关节运动，面部流编码更广泛的面部动态。预训练期间，引入辅助音频输入以促进跨模态对齐，并应用模态dropout以鼓励鲁棒的纯视觉表示。在下游唇读任务中，FLARE作为视觉编码器与轻量级Transformer解码器或基于LLM的解码器结合使用。
AI.result: FLARE在LRS2、LRS3和域外WildVSR基准测试上取得了强大的唇读性能，词错误率分别为11.7%、13.2%和34.3%。渐进式设计研究证实了每个主要组件的贡献。进一步分析表明，联合面部-唇部建模在视频分辨率降低和头部姿态大范围变化下提高了鲁棒性，同时产生了更具音素区分度的视觉表示。
AI.conclusion: FLARE通过跨模态蒸馏和联合面部-唇部建模，有效地学习了鲁棒的视觉语音表示，显著提高了唇读性能，并在恶劣条件下展现出优异的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 唇读仍然具有挑战性，因为视觉语音线索固有的模糊性以及它们对头部姿态和视频分辨率的敏感性。在这项工作中，我们提出了FLARE，一个通过跨模态蒸馏和联合面部-唇部建模来学习鲁棒视觉语音表示的框架。FLARE利用语义丰富的Whisper表示作为声学教师信号，通过随机投影量化器将其转换为离散蒸馏目标，并使用掩码预测目标对模型进行预训练。为了捕获互补的视觉信息，FLARE采用双流架构，联合处理唇部感兴趣区域（ROI）和全脸输入，其中唇部流捕获精细的关节运动，面部流编码更广泛的面部动态。在预训练期间，引入辅助音频输入以促进跨模态对齐，并应用模态dropout以鼓励鲁棒的纯视觉表示。对于下游唇读任务，FLARE作为视觉编码器与轻量级Transformer解码器或基于LLM的解码器结合使用。在LRS2、LRS3和域外WildVSR基准测试上进行评估，FLARE取得了强大的唇读性能，词错误率分别为11.7%、13.2%和34.3%。渐进式设计研究证实了每个主要组件的贡献。进一步分析表明，联合面部-唇部建模在视频分辨率降低和头部姿态大范围变化下提高了鲁棒性，同时产生了更具音素区分度的视觉表示。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/jxzhanggg/FLARE获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FLARE，一个用于鲁棒视觉语音表示学习的框架。FLARE通过将Whisper声学表示蒸馏为离散目标并采用掩码预测进行预训练。其核心是双流架构，联合处理唇部ROI和全脸输入，以捕获细粒度关节运动和更广泛的面部动态。通过引入辅助音频输入和模态dropout，FLARE在预训练中实现了跨模态对齐和鲁棒的纯视觉表示。在唇读任务中，FLARE作为视觉编码器与不同解码器结合，在多个基准测试上取得了优异性能，并在视频质量下降和头部姿态变化下展现出更高的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 视觉语音表示, 唇读, 跨模态蒸馏, 面部-唇部建模, FLARE
AI.comments: FLARE的创新性在于结合了跨模态蒸馏和独特的双流联合面部-唇部建模，有效地解决了视觉语音线索的模糊性和对视频质量、头部姿态的敏感性问题。利用Whisper作为教师模型提供了强大的语义信息，而唇部ROI与全脸输入的结合则全面捕捉了视觉语音的细节和上下文。这种设计显著提升了唇读的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其是在实际应用中可能面临的挑战性条件下。该框架对未来的视觉语音识别研究具有重要意义。

title: $τ$-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
comments: Accepted to the UserSim Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $τ$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. By allowing dissatisfied users to terminate inefficient interactions, the harness provides an interaction-aware signal that filters trajectories with excessive user dependence and favors effective tool use. Experiments with two user simulators show that frontier agents remain unreliable, with substantial gaps between average task success and consistent task completion. Tracer-generated supervision consistently improves Qwen3 models across scales, generalizes to unseen domains, and transfers to $τ$-Bench and $τ$-Trait. Behavioral analyses further show that higher task success is associated with a better balance between tool execution and necessary user follow-up. Overall, $τ$-Emotion-Bench and Tracer provide a scalable framework for evaluating agent reliability under diverse user behaviors and improving tool-calling agents through interaction-aware supervision.
comment: Accepted to the UserSim Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

AI.title_translation: $\tau$-Emotion-Bench：通过真实世界用户情绪揭示大语言模型智能体的交互脆弱性
AI.tldr: 论文提出了包含10个领域的评估基准$\tau$-Emotion-Bench与数据生成管线Tracer，揭示了LLM智能体在应对用户情绪波动时的交互脆弱性，并通过交互感知监督显著提升了工具调用智能体的表现。
AI.motivation: 在长程工具调用任务中，LLM智能体不仅会因工具使用不当而失败，更常因与用户的低效交互而失败。现有评测基准普遍假设用户是合作且行为稳定的，忽视了现实中用户情绪波动对智能体可靠性的显著影响。
AI.method: 1. 构建$\tau$-Emotion-Bench：涵盖10个领域，在保持任务目标不变的前提下，在受控的情绪条件化用户交互中评测工具调用智能体。2. 提出Tracer数据生成管线：构建有依据且符合策略的任务，利用智能体-用户-环境交互框架收集轨迹；允许不满意的用户终止低效交互，以此作为交互感知反馈信号来过滤过度依赖用户的轨迹，鼓励高效工具调用。
AI.result: 前沿智能体面对情绪波动时仍显脆弱，平均任务成功率与一致性任务完成率之间存在显著差距；Tracer生成的数据有效且持续提升了各规模Qwen3模型的性能，展现出向未见领域及其他基准（$\tau$-Bench、$\tau$-Trait）的良好泛化与迁移能力；行为分析表明，高成功率依赖于智能体在工具执行与必要用户跟进之间的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: $\tau$-Emotion-Bench和Tracer为评估多样化用户行为下的智能体可靠性，以及通过交互感知监督提升工具调用智能体的能力提供了一个系统且可扩展的框架。
AI.translation: 在长程工具调用任务中，LLM智能体不仅会因工具使用错误而失败，还会因与用户的无效交互而失败。然而，现有的基准测试大多假设用户是合作且行为稳定的，这使得情绪变化对智能体可靠性的影响尚未得到充分探索。我们引入了$\tau$-Emotion-Bench，这是一个涵盖十个领域的基准测试，用于在保持底层任务目标的同时，评估工具调用智能体在受控的情绪条件化用户交互下的表现。为了扩展基准构建和智能体训练的规模，我们提出了Tracer，这是一种可扩展的智能体数据生成管线，用于构建有根据、符合策略的任务，并通过交互式智能体-用户-环境测试框架收集轨迹。通过允许不满意的用户终止低效交互，该框架提供了一种交互感知信号，过滤掉过度依赖用户的轨迹，并促进有效的工具使用。基于两个用户模拟器的实验表明，前沿智能体仍然不够可靠，平均任务成功率与稳定任务完成率之间存在巨大差距。Tracer生成的监督信号在不同参数规模下持续提升了Qwen3模型的表现，能够泛化到未见过的领域，并能迁移到$\tau$-Bench和$\tau$-Trait。行为分析进一步表明，更高的任务成功率与工具执行和必要的用户跟进之间更好的平衡相关联。总体而言，$\tau$-Emotion-Bench和Tracer提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于评估智能体在多样化用户行为下的可靠性，并通过交互感知监督来改进工具调用智能体。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有LLM工具调用智能体在面对非理想用户时表现脆弱的问题，提出了评估受控情绪交互的基准$\tau$-Emotion-Bench和数据生成管线Tracer。通过引入允许不满意用户终止交互的交互感知机制，不仅揭示了前沿智能体在情绪干扰下的不可靠性，还成功利用该机制生成的数据显著提升了模型的任务完成度与交互平衡能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 工具调用, 用户情绪, 交互脆弱性, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于打破了智能体评测中“理想化、高度合作用户”的常规假设，首次系统性地探讨了真实用户情绪波动对LLM长程工具调用稳定性的负面冲击。其提出的Tracer管线通过引入“不满意用户提前终止”机制来构建交互感知信号，非常符合实际人机交互场景。局限性在于情绪交互仍依赖用户模拟器生成，与真实人类的复杂心理和情绪动态可能仍存在一定域差。

title: REWIND: Uncertainty-Guided Trajectory Repair for Test-Time Reasoning
summary: An early mistake in the generated reasoning can constrain all subsequent reasoning. Repeated-generation methods, like MCMC-based approaches, attempt to improve output quality by sampling multiple generations, but their effectiveness can be limited by randomly selecting where to regenerate. On MATH500 with Qwen2.5-Math-7B, we find that incorrect responses have substantially higher mean token entropy than correct responses, with an average within-question relative increase of approximately 112%, suggesting that entropy can signal reasoning errors. Motivated by this finding, we introduce REWIND, a training-free controller that uses entropy dynamics to propose targeted suffix regenerations. Across three model families and five benchmarks, REWIND outperforms all baselines, with gains of 0.51-10.00 percentage points over the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of targeted, uncertainty-guided trajectory repair across models and tasks. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rewind-D310.

AI.title_translation: REWIND：用于测试时推理的不确定性引导轨迹修复
AI.tldr: REWIND利用token熵作为信号，在测试时有针对性地修复大语言模型的推理错误，无需训练即可显著提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在生成推理过程中，早期的错误会限制后续所有推理，而现有的重复生成方法（如基于MCMC的方法）随机选择重新生成的位置，效率和效果受限。论文发现错误响应的平均token熵明显高于正确响应，这启发了通过不确定性来指导推理错误修复的动机。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为REWIND的训练期无需调优的控制器，利用token的熵动态来定位推理错误，并据此提出有针对性的后缀重生成策略。
AI.result: 跨三个模型系列和五个基准测试的实验表明，REWIND优于所有基准方法，比最强基准提升了0.51到10.00个百分点。
AI.conclusion: REWIND通过监控熵动态引导目标后缀重生成，有效修复了测试时推理过程中的早期错误，显著提升了模型在多个数学和推理基准上的性能。
AI.translation: 在生成的推理过程中，早期的错误会限制所有后续的推理。像基于MCMC的方法这样的重复生成方法试图通过采样多个生成结果来提高输出质量，但它们的有效性往往受限于随机选择重新生成的位置。在MATH500上使用Qwen2.5-Math-7B时，我们发现不确定性（如平均token熵）在错误响应中明显高于正确响应，问题内的平均相对增幅约为112%，这表明熵可以作为推理错误的信号。受此发现的启发，我们推出了REWIND，这是一个无需训练的控制器，它利用熵动态来提出有针对性的后缀重生成策略。在三个模型系列和五个基准测试中，REWIND优于所有基准方法，比最强基准高出0.51到10.00个百分点。这些结果证明了有针对性的、不确定性引导的轨迹修复在不同模型和任务中的有效性。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rewind-D310获取。
AI.summary: 该论文针对大语言模型在测试时推理中容易因早期错误导致后续推理失效的问题，发现错误回答通常伴随着更高的token熵。基于此发现，作者提出了REWIND——一种无需训练、利用熵动态指导目标后缀重生成的控制器，并在多个基准测试中验证了其显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 测试时推理, 轨迹修复, 不确定性引导, 熵动态, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用不确定性（token熵）指导大语言模型的测试时推理修复，无需额外训练，方法直观且在多个基准测试中表现出色，展示了强大的实用价值。

title: Semi-Linearity and Generalized Stratified Semi-Linearity beyond Context-Free Languages
comments: (10pt, 6 figures, 21 pages) This is a preliminary report
summary: Parikh's famous theorem relates to the semi-linearity of context-free languages. We seek for expanding the scope of the semi-linear property from context-free languages to languages beyond them. Of those languages, this work focuses on the languages that are particularly recognized by one-way nondeterministic depth-k storage automata under a natural restriction of frozen blank sensitivity. Those languages (which are called $k$-storable languages) have been already proven to satisfy a natural generalization of the well-known pumping lemmas for regular and context-free languages. The semi-linearity of k-storable languages generalizes Parikh's theorem on the semi-linearity of context-free languages. As for bounded languages, Ginsburg and Spanier's well-known theorem characterizes context-free languages in terms of stratified semi-linearity. This notion is further generalized and is used to characterize the k-storable languages as well. Such a generalization is interesting in its own right. This helps us take an abstract treatment of k-storable languages without relying on "machines". Our results strengthen the belief that those languages are "natural" generalizations of context-free languages.

AI.title_translation: 半线性和超上下文无关语言的广义分层半线性
AI.tldr: 本文将上下文无关语言的半线性性质扩展到k-可存储语言，证明了k-可存储语言的半线性是Parikh定理的推广，并使用广义分层半线性来刻画k-可存储语言，加强了它们是上下文无关语言的“自然”推广的信念。
AI.motivation: 旨在将半线性性质的范围从上下文无关语言扩展到更广泛的语言，特别是那些由单向非确定性深度k存储自动机识别的语言（即k-可存储语言）。此外，这种推广本身也很有趣，有助于对k-可存储语言进行抽象处理，而不依赖于“机器”。
AI.method: 研究了由单向非确定性深度k存储自动机识别的k-可存储语言。通过推广Parikh关于上下文无关语言半线性的定理，证明了k-可存储语言的半线性。同时，进一步推广了Ginsburg和Spanier关于分层半线性的定理，并用广义分层半线性来刻画k-可存储语言。
AI.result: k-可存储语言的半线性推广了Parikh关于上下文无关语言半线性的定理。广义分层半线性被用于刻画k-可存储语言。这些结果加强了k-可存储语言是上下文无关语言“自然”推广的信念。
AI.conclusion: 本文的发现加强了k-可存储语言是上下文无关语言“自然”推广的信念。通过推广半线性和分层半线性，实现了对k-可存储语言的抽象处理，而不依赖于具体的机器模型。
AI.translation: Parikh著名的定理与上下文无关语言的半线性有关。我们寻求将半线性性质的范围从上下文无关语言扩展到超越它们的语言。在这些语言中，这项工作专注于在冻结空白敏感性的自然限制下，由单向非确定性深度k存储自动机特别识别的语言。这些语言（被称为k-可存储语言）已被证明满足正则语言和上下文无关语言的著名抽引引理的自然推广。k-可存储语言的半线性推广了Parikh关于上下文无关语言半线性的定理。至于有界语言，Ginsburg和Spanier著名的定理根据分层半线性来刻画上下文无关语言。这个概念被进一步推广，并用于刻画k-可存储语言。这种推广本身就很有趣。这有助于我们对k-可存储语言进行抽象处理，而不依赖于“机器”。我们的结果加强了这些语言是上下文无关语言“自然”推广的信念。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了将半线性性质从上下文无关语言扩展到k-可存储语言。通过研究由单向非确定性深度k存储自动机识别的k-可存储语言，作者证明了其半线性是Parikh定理的推广。此外，论文还推广了分层半线性概念，并用其来刻画k-可存储语言。这些发现支持了k-可存储语言是上下文无关语言自然推广的观点，并提供了一种不依赖于具体机器模型的抽象处理方法。
AI.keywords: 半线性, k-可存储语言, 上下文无关语言, 分层半线性, Parikh定理
AI.comments: 该论文在形式语言理论领域具有重要意义，它成功地将上下文无关语言的关键性质（半线性）推广到更广泛的语言类别——k-可存储语言。这种推广不仅加深了我们对这些语言结构的理解，还提供了一种更抽象的分析方法。通过引入广义分层半线性，论文为刻画这些复杂语言提供了新的工具，并有力地支持了k-可存储语言作为上下文无关语言“自然”扩展的观点。这对于理解计算复杂性和语言层次结构具有潜在影响。

title: SaTPO: Text-to-Image Safety Alignment via Transition Preference Optimization
summary: Safety alignment of text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress harmful content without compromising useful generation capabilities. However, preferences over completed images compress multidimensional generation factors into a coarse signal, potentially driving changes beyond those required for safety. To address this, we propose Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO), which enforces step-wise alignment during denoising. SaTPO leverages the insight that an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite naturally form a tightly coupled preference pair when conditioned on a shared parent state and noise realization. By anchoring optimization on identical parent states, SaTPO eliminates historical trajectory divergence, confining safety adaptation to an incremental alignment while preserving task-relevant semantics. Multi-scale drift constraints and benign replay further limit behavioral deviation and preserve ordinary generation. We additionally construct CoProPV, a refined dataset ensuring visually verified contrasts. Experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and SDXL demonstrate improved safety-quality trade-offs. Compared with AlignGuard, PerspectiveVision unsafe-detection rates on Inappropriate Image Prompts decrease from 12.70% to 6.00% and from 15.04% to 9.30%, respectively, while FID improves from 32.28 to 25.95 and from 36.50 to 27.51. Warning: this paper includes potentially offensive content.

AI.title_translation: SaTPO：通过转换偏好优化实现文本到图像的安全对齐
AI.tldr: SaTPO通过在去噪过程中进行逐步对齐，并利用安全提示和其安全重写之间的紧密耦合偏好对，改进了文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐，同时保持了生成质量，并在Stable Diffusion模型上取得了更好的安全-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐方法，通过对完整图像的偏好进行优化，可能会导致超出安全需求的变化，影响生成能力。
AI.method: 本文提出了安全转换偏好优化（SaTPO），它在去噪过程中执行逐步对齐。SaTPO利用不安全提示和其安全重写在共享父状态和噪声实现下形成的紧密耦合偏好对，通过锚定在相同的父状态上消除历史轨迹分歧，将安全适应限制在增量对齐，同时保留任务相关语义。多尺度漂移约束和良性重放进一步限制行为偏差并保持普通生成。此外，构建了CoProPV数据集，确保视觉验证的对比。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.5和SDXL上的实验表明，安全-质量权衡得到改善。与AlignGuard相比，PerspectiveVision在不当图像提示上的不安全检测率分别从12.70%降至6.00%和从15.04%降至9.30%，同时FID分别从32.28提高到25.95和从36.50提高到27.51。
AI.conclusion: SaTPO通过其逐步对齐和偏好优化机制，有效提升了文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐效果，同时显著改善了生成质量，实现了更好的安全-质量权衡。
AI.translation: 文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐旨在抑制有害内容，同时不损害有用的生成能力。然而，对完成图像的偏好将多维生成因素压缩成粗略信号，可能导致超出安全所需的变化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了安全转换偏好优化（SaTPO），它在去噪过程中强制执行逐步对齐。SaTPO利用了这样的洞察：当以共享父状态和噪声实现为条件时，一个不安全的提示及其安全重写自然形成了一个紧密耦合的偏好对。通过将优化锚定在相同的父状态上，SaTPO消除了历史轨迹分歧，将安全适应限制在增量对齐，同时保留了任务相关的语义。多尺度漂移约束和良性重放进一步限制了行为偏差并保留了普通生成。我们还构建了CoProPV，一个经过精炼的数据集，确保了视觉验证的对比。在Stable Diffusion v1.5和SDXL上的实验表明，安全-质量权衡得到了改善。与AlignGuard相比，PerspectiveVision在不当图像提示上的不安全检测率分别从12.70%降至6.00%和从15.04%降至9.30%，同时FID分别从32.28提高到25.95和从36.50提高到27.51。警告：本文包含潜在冒犯性内容。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SaTPO，一种用于文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐方法，通过在去噪过程中进行逐步对齐。它利用不安全提示及其安全重写在共享父状态下的紧密耦合偏好对，将安全适应限制在增量对齐，并结合多尺度漂移约束和良性重放来保持生成质量。通过引入CoProPV数据集，SaTPO在Stable Diffusion模型上显著降低了不安全内容检测率，并提高了FID分数，实现了优越的安全-质量权衡。
AI.keywords: 文本到图像,安全对齐,扩散模型,偏好优化,SaTPO
AI.comments: SaTPO的创新之处在于其“逐步对齐”和利用“共享父状态”来形成紧密耦合偏好对的策略，这避免了传统方法中对完整图像偏好优化可能带来的过度修改。这种精细化的对齐方法能够更精准地抑制有害内容，同时更好地保留原始生成能力。CoProPV数据集的构建也为评估提供了可靠基础。

title: Frame Evidence:A Benchmark for Reference Frames and Visual Evidence in Multi-Image Spatial Reasoning
summary: A spatial answer depends on the reference frame specified in language and its supporting visual evidence. Item accuracy alone obscures whether correctness persists when either changes. We introduce Frame Evidence, a benchmark of 320 matched triplets and 960 Chinese multiple-choice questions from captured and rendered scenes. One family compares three grounded reference frames over fixed images. The other pairs image deletion annotated as insufficient with answer-preserving addition. Joint metrics require correct answers across all three frames and paired evidence variants. Across 20 configurations on 288 held-out questions, GPT three-shot reaches 50.00\% item accuracy, but the best three-frame group accuracy is 5/48 (10.42\%), reached by GPT two-shot. Few-shot prompting and task-specific adaptation improve item accuracy without consistently improving joint correctness. Input controls show where images support matched success, while repeated executions reveal answer instability beneath similar scores.

AI.title_translation: Frame Evidence：多图像空间推理中参考系和视觉证据的基准
AI.tldr: 引入Frame Evidence基准，评估多图像空间推理中参考系和视觉证据对准确性的影响，发现现有模型在联合正确性方面表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只关注项目准确性，忽略了当参考系或视觉证据改变时，正确性是否能持续。需要一个基准来评估模型在不同参考系和视觉证据下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入Frame Evidence基准，包含320个匹配三元组和960个中文多项选择题，来自捕获和渲染的场景。该基准包括两种家庭：一种比较固定图像上的三种接地参考系，另一种配对图像删除（不足）与答案保留添加。使用联合度量，要求在所有三个参考系和配对证据变体中答案都正确。
AI.result: 在288个保留问题上的20种配置中，GPT三样本达到50.00%的项目准确率，但最佳三参考系组准确率仅为5/48 (10.42%)，由GPT两样本实现。少量样本提示和任务特定适应提高了项目准确率，但未能持续提高联合正确性。输入控制显示图像支持匹配成功的位置，而重复执行揭示了相似分数下的答案不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在处理多图像空间推理中的参考系和视觉证据变化时，虽然项目准确率可能较高，但在联合正确性方面表现不足，模型答案存在不稳定性。
AI.translation: 空间答案取决于语言中指定的参考系及其支持的视觉证据。单独的项目准确性掩盖了当两者之一发生变化时，正确性是否持续存在。我们引入了Frame Evidence，这是一个由320个匹配三元组和960个来自捕获和渲染场景的中文多项选择题组成的基准。一个系列比较了固定图像上的三个接地参考系。另一个系列将不足的图像删除与保留答案的图像添加配对。联合度量要求在所有三个参考系和配对证据变体中答案都正确。在288个保留问题的20种配置中，GPT三样本达到50.00%的项目准确率，但最佳三参考系组准确率仅为5/48 (10.42%)，由GPT两样本实现。少量样本提示和任务特定适应提高了项目准确率，但未能持续提高联合正确性。输入控制显示图像支持匹配成功的位置，而重复执行揭示了相似分数下的答案不稳定性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Frame Evidence基准，用于评估多图像空间推理模型在不同参考系和视觉证据下的鲁棒性。该基准包含多组匹配问题，旨在测试模型在参考系变化和视觉证据增删时的联合正确性。实验表明，尽管大型语言模型在单项准确率上表现尚可，但在多参考系和证据变体下的联合正确性方面表现显著不足，且答案存在不稳定性，揭示了现有模型在此类复杂推理任务中的局限性。
AI.keywords: 多图像空间推理, 参考系, 视觉证据, 基准, Frame Evidence
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个新颖的基准Frame Evidence，它不仅仅关注单一的答案准确性，而是通过设计多参考系和视觉证据变体的匹配问题，来更全面地评估模型在复杂空间推理任务中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。其揭示了当前大型语言模型在处理此类细微变化时的深层不足和答案不稳定性，为未来的研究指明了方向。

title: Identifiability-Guided Composite Load Modeling of AI Data Centers
summary: The rapid growth of AI data centers introduces large, workload-dependent loads whose protection and reconnection behavior can affect power-system transient stability. Calibrating dynamic models of such loads is challenging because treating all associated elements as freely estimable may lead to weakly identified or physically confounded parameterizations. This paper proposes an identifiability-guided calibration framework for a composite load model with separate IT, cooling, and auxiliary branches. A nuisance-projected Fisher-information criterion characterizes the local identifiability of the cooling-motor composition, while a workload non-equivalence result shows that voltage-only recalibration cannot reproduce workload-dependent responses. Guided by these results, a grey-box estimator trained with branch-level supervision learns the workload-to-power relation and the cooling composition, while retaining a prescribed UPS protection law and an externally anchored reconnect-ramp duration. The learned workload relation is then distilled into a closed form for transient-stability simulation. Evaluation using 300,000 MIT Supercloud GPU power-utilization samples and 12,600 IEEE 39-bus fault scenarios yields an aggregate active-power $R^2$ of 0.948, compared with 0.856 for an LSTM baseline. Removing branch-level supervision preserves relatively high aggregate accuracy but substantially degrades cooling-component recovery. Under unseen deep voltage sags, the proposed model achieves a transient $R^2$ of 0.750, compared with 0.033 for the LSTM. Closed-loop simulations further show that cooling composition and protection behavior can affect retained-load states and voltage responses near protection thresholds.

AI.title_translation: AI数据中心可识别性引导的复合负荷建模
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可识别性引导的校准框架，用于AI数据中心的复合负荷模型，该模型通过分支级监督学习工作负载到功率的关系和冷却组成，并在瞬态稳定性模拟中表现出高精度，优于LSTM基线。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心的快速增长带来了大量与工作负载相关的负荷，其保护和重连行为会影响电力系统暂态稳定性。校准此类负荷的动态模型具有挑战性，因为将所有相关元素视为可自由估计可能导致弱识别或物理混淆的参数化。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种可识别性引导的复合负荷模型校准框架，该模型具有独立的IT、冷却和辅助分支。利用干扰投影Fisher信息准则表征冷却电机组成的局部可识别性。工作负载非等效结果表明，仅电压重新校准无法再现与工作负载相关的响应。在此结果指导下，一个带有分支级监督的灰盒估计器学习工作负载到功率的关系和冷却组成，同时保留预设的UPS保护定律和外部锚定的重连斜坡持续时间。然后将学习到的工作负载关系提炼成闭合形式，用于暂态稳定性模拟。
AI.result: 使用300,000个MIT Supercloud GPU功率利用率样本和12,600个IEEE 39总线故障场景进行评估，聚合有功功率R²达到0.948，而LSTM基线为0.856。移除分支级监督仍能保持相对较高的聚合精度，但冷却组件恢复能力显著下降。在未见过的深度电压骤降下，所提出的模型瞬态R²达到0.750，而LSTM为0.033。闭环仿真进一步表明，冷却组成和保护行为会影响保护阈值附近的保留负荷状态和电压响应。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的可识别性引导的复合负荷建模框架能够准确地模拟AI数据中心的动态行为，尤其是在瞬态稳定性模拟中表现出色，优于传统方法。冷却组成和保护行为对电力系统稳定性有显著影响。
AI.translation: AI数据中心的快速增长引入了大量与工作负载相关的负荷，其保护和重连行为会影响电力系统的暂态稳定性。校准此类负荷的动态模型具有挑战性，因为将所有相关元素视为可自由估计可能导致弱识别或物理混淆的参数化。本文提出了一种可识别性引导的校准框架，用于具有独立IT、冷却和辅助分支的复合负荷模型。一个干扰投影的Fisher信息准则表征了冷却电机组成的局部可识别性，而一个工作负载非等效结果表明，仅电压重新校准无法再现与工作负载相关的响应。在这些结果的指导下，一个带有分支级监督的灰盒估计器学习工作负载到功率的关系和冷却组成，同时保留预设的UPS保护定律和外部锚定的重连斜坡持续时间。然后将学习到的工作负载关系提炼成闭合形式，用于暂态稳定性模拟。使用300,000个MIT Supercloud GPU功率利用率样本和12,600个IEEE 39总线故障场景进行评估，聚合有功功率R²达到0.948，而LSTM基线为0.856。移除分支级监督仍能保持相对较高的聚合精度，但冷却组件恢复能力显著下降。在未见过的深度电压骤降下，所提出的模型瞬态R²达到0.750，而LSTM为0.033。闭环仿真进一步表明，冷却组成和保护行为会影响保护阈值附近的保留负荷状态和电压响应。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI数据中心负荷建模的挑战，提出了一种可识别性引导的复合负荷模型校准框架。该框架通过分支级监督的灰盒估计器学习工作负载与功率的关系及冷却组成，并将其提炼为闭合形式用于瞬态稳定性模拟。实验结果表明，该模型在聚合有功功率和深度电压骤降下的瞬态响应方面均优于LSTM基线，并且冷却组成和保护行为对系统稳定性具有重要影响。
AI.keywords: AI数据中心, 复合负荷建模, 可识别性, 暂态稳定性, 灰盒估计
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个可识别性引导的框架来解决AI数据中心复合负荷模型校准中的参数识别困难问题。通过结合物理知识和数据驱动方法（灰盒估计器），实现了对复杂负荷行为的准确建模，特别是在电力系统暂态稳定性分析方面表现出色。其方法考虑了工作负载依赖性、冷却组成和保护机制，为AI数据中心与电网的互动提供了更精确的理解和预测能力，具有重要的工程实践价值。

title: Mission (Im)Possible: Towards Autonomous Discovery of Autopilot Logic Flaws in Open-Source Drone Frameworks
summary: Autonomous drones are increasingly deployed in safety-critical tasks, yet their autopilot software can still contain subtle logic flaws that lead to unsafe behaviors. These flaws are difficult to discover with existing techniques because they often depend on semantic relationships across modules, commands, and runtime state, and rarely manifest as crashes or detectable failures. With recent advances in LLMs, we observe that, when equipped with essential domain knowledge and carefully crafted context, LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in understanding the high-level semantics of autopilot systems, making them suitable for logic flaw discovery. However, LLMs are limited by their context and can be biased to the vulnerabilities frequently occurs in training dataset, while logic flaws often require higher-level semantic bug oracles to identify their existence. To bridge the gap, we present Impossible Mission Finder (IMF), a multi-agent system combining static analysis, dynamic execution and log analysis, that supports fully automated identify, test, and validate logic flaws in autonomous vehicles. IMF primarily contains three LLM agents, it first uses the auditor agent to propose logic flaw hypothesis based on carefully-crafted program slicing, then it launches tester agents to write and execute test cases for each candidate, and finally it spawns the log analyzer agent to validate the execution log against the flaw hypothesis. This enables IMF dynamically validate bug oracles in a case-by-case manner, making it suitable for discovering logic flaws that do not have a unified pattern. We evaluated IMF on two widely used open-source autopilot systems, PX4 and Ardupilot, leading to 105 previously unknown logic flaws, that can cause unsafe behaviors including mission interruption failures, invalid actions, entering into restricted fly zones etc.

AI.title_translation: 任务（不）可能：迈向开源无人机框架中自动驾驶逻辑缺陷的自主发现
AI.tldr: 提出IMF系统，利用多LLM代理和多模态分析，自动发现开源无人机自动驾驶仪中的逻辑缺陷，发现了105个未知缺陷。
AI.motivation: 自主无人机在安全关键任务中部署，但其自动驾驶软件可能包含导致不安全行为的微妙逻辑缺陷。现有技术难以发现这些缺陷，因为它们依赖于语义关系且很少表现为崩溃。LLM虽然有理解语义的潜力，但受限于上下文和偏差，且逻辑缺陷常需要更高级别的语义错误预言。
AI.method: 提出Impossible Mission Finder (IMF)，一个结合静态分析、动态执行和日志分析的多智能体系统。IMF包含三个LLM代理：审计员代理提出缺陷假设；测试员代理编写并执行测试用例；日志分析员代理验证执行日志。该系统能动态验证错误预言，适用于发现无统一模式的逻辑缺陷。
AI.result: 在PX4和Ardupilot两个开源自动驾驶系统上评估了IMF，发现了105个以前未知的逻辑缺陷，这些缺陷可能导致任务中断失败、无效操作、进入受限飞行区域等不安全行为。
AI.conclusion: IMF系统成功地实现了对开源无人机自动驾驶仪中复杂逻辑缺陷的自主发现、测试和验证，显著提高了无人机软件的安全性。
AI.translation: 自主无人机越来越多地部署在安全关键任务中，但其自动驾驶软件仍然可能包含导致不安全行为的微妙逻辑缺陷。这些缺陷很难用现有技术发现，因为它们通常依赖于模块、命令和运行时状态之间的语义关系，并且很少表现为崩溃或可检测的故障。随着LLM的最新进展，我们观察到，当配备必要的领域知识和精心设计的上下文时，LLM在理解自动驾驶系统的高级语义方面表现出强大的能力，使其适用于逻辑缺陷的发现。然而，LLM受限于其上下文，并且可能偏向于训练数据集中经常出现的漏洞，而逻辑缺陷通常需要更高级别的语义错误预言来识别其存在。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Impossible Mission Finder (IMF)，一个结合了静态分析、动态执行和日志分析的多智能体系统，支持全自动化识别、测试和验证自主车辆中的逻辑缺陷。IMF主要包含三个LLM代理，它首先使用审计员代理基于精心设计的程序切片提出逻辑缺陷假设，然后启动测试员代理为每个候选缺陷编写并执行测试用例，最后生成日志分析员代理根据缺陷假设验证执行日志。这使得IMF能够以逐案方式动态验证错误预言，使其适用于发现没有统一模式的逻辑缺陷。我们在两个广泛使用的开源自动驾驶系统PX4和Ardupilot上评估了IMF，发现了105个以前未知的逻辑缺陷，这些缺陷可能导致不安全行为，包括任务中断失败、无效操作、进入受限飞行区域等。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了Impossible Mission Finder (IMF)，一个利用多智能体LLM系统、结合静态分析、动态执行和日志分析的框架，旨在自主发现开源无人机自动驾驶仪中的逻辑缺陷。IMF通过审计员代理生成缺陷假设，测试员代理编写并执行测试，以及日志分析员代理验证结果，从而有效识别传统方法难以发现的深层语义缺陷。在PX4和Ardupilot上的评估发现了105个未知的安全关键逻辑缺陷。
AI.keywords: 自主无人机, 逻辑缺陷发现, LLM, 多智能体系统, 自动驾驶仪
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其将大型语言模型（LLM）与传统软件分析技术（静态分析、动态执行、日志分析）相结合，构建了一个多智能体系统来解决无人机自动驾驶仪中复杂的逻辑缺陷发现问题。特别是利用LLM的语义理解能力来生成缺陷假设和验证错误预言，并通过多智能体协作实现全自动化，克服了LLM在上下文和偏差方面的局限性，并能够动态验证没有统一模式的逻辑缺陷，这对于提高自主系统的安全性具有重要意义。

title: INTACT: Inducing Latent Reasoning on a Frozen Backbone
summary: Latent reasoning replaces natural-language chains of thought with compact continuous "soft-token" representations, reducing the number of intermediate tokens that must be decoded autoregressively. We use a small external encoder to induce latent reasoning in a frozen backbone model. The encoder iteratively maps the backbone's hidden states to new latent blocks, constructing a latent reasoning prefix, after which the frozen model writes its remaining reasoning and its answer as text. Our method, INTACT, trains this encoder through distillation to reproduce the effect of written reasoning steps while keeping the model's behavior close to that of the frozen backbone, and then reinforces it on answer correctness. Across four frozen backbones from 1B to 8B, INTACT improves both GSM8K and average out-of-domain accuracy, including GSM8K gains from 75.8% to 79.3% on Llama-3.2-3B and from 77.6% to 79.7% on Qwen2.5-3B. It also reduces end-to-end latency per problem by 19% on Llama-3.2-3B and outperforms the evaluated latent-reasoning baselines at the 3B and 8B scales. Beyond the mathematics setting, the same recipe trained on a multi-domain corpus improves the frozen backbone on twelve evaluation benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and commonsense, without task-specific adaptation.

AI.title_translation: INTACT：在冻结骨干模型上诱导潜在推理
AI.tldr: INTACT通过一个小型外部编码器在冻结的大语言模型中引入潜在推理，无需修改骨干模型，显著提升了数学和多领域任务的准确性，并降低了推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 传统的自然语言思维链会产生大量中间token，导致自回归解码效率降低。本文旨在通过紧凑的连续“软token”表示（即潜在推理）来解决这一问题，同时保持基础模型的性能。
AI.method: INTACT方法使用一个小型外部编码器在冻结的骨干模型中诱导潜在推理。该编码器迭代地将骨干模型的隐藏状态映射到新的潜在块，构建一个潜在推理前缀。之后，冻结模型以文本形式生成剩余推理和答案。编码器通过蒸馏（以复制书面推理步骤并使行为接近冻结骨干）和基于答案正确性的强化学习进行训练。
AI.result: INTACT在从1B到8B的四种冻结骨干模型上提高了GSM8K和平均域外准确性，例如Llama-3.2-3B上GSM8K从75.8%提升到79.3%，Qwen2.5-3B上从77.6%提升到79.7%。它还使Llama-3.2-3B的每个问题的端到端延迟降低了19%，并在3B和8B规模上优于现有的潜在推理基线。在数学领域之外，在多领域语料库上训练的相同方法在跨数学、科学和常识的十二个评估基准上提升了冻结骨干模型的性能，且无需进行任务特定适应。
AI.conclusion: INTACT成功地在冻结的骨干模型中诱导了高效的潜在推理，显著提升了模型在数学和多领域任务上的性能和效率，证明了其在不修改大型预训练模型前提下的强大通用性和有效性。
AI.translation: 潜在推理用紧凑的连续“软token”表示取代了自然语言思维链，减少了必须自回归解码的中间token数量。我们使用一个小型外部编码器在冻结的骨干模型中诱导潜在推理。该编码器迭代地将骨干模型的隐藏状态映射到新的潜在块，构建一个潜在推理前缀，之后冻结模型以文本形式生成剩余推理和答案。我们的方法INTACT通过蒸馏训练该编码器，以复制书面推理步骤的效果，同时使模型行为接近冻结骨干，然后通过答案正确性对其进行强化。在从1B到8B的四种冻结骨干模型上，INTACT提高了GSM8K和平均域外准确性，包括Llama-3.2-3B上GSM8K从75.8%提升到79.3%，Qwen2.5-3B上从77.6%提升到79.7%。它还将Llama-3.2-3B的每个问题的端到端延迟降低了19%，并在3B和8B规模上优于现有评估的潜在推理基线。除了数学设置，在多领域语料库上训练的相同方法在跨数学、科学和常识的十二个评估基准上提升了冻结骨干模型的性能，无需进行任务特定适应。
AI.summary: 本文提出INTACT，一种在冻结骨干模型中诱导潜在推理的方法。通过一个小型外部编码器将骨干模型的隐藏状态转换为紧凑的“软token”潜在推理前缀，然后由冻结模型完成文本输出。INTACT通过蒸馏和强化学习训练编码器，在不修改大型预训练模型的情况下，显著提升了模型在数学（如GSM8K）和多领域任务上的准确性，并降低了推理延迟，性能优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 潜在推理, 冻结骨干模型, 蒸馏, 效率, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: INTACT的创新点在于其能够在不修改（冻结）大型预训练模型骨干的情况下，通过一个轻量级外部编码器引入复杂的潜在推理能力。这极大地降低了微调大型模型的计算成本和风险，同时提升了性能和效率。其在多领域任务上的泛化能力也显示出广阔的应用前景。潜在的局限性可能在于外部编码器在处理更复杂、需要深层次推理的任务时，其诱导的潜在推理是否能完全替代内部的、模型固有的推理能力。

title: Geometric Kernel Diversity: An Axiomatic Diversity Measure in Euclidean Space
summary: Quantifying the diversity of a set of objects is a fundamental problem in machine learning and statistics. Mironov and Prokhorenkova (2025) recently showed that three axioms-monotonicity, uniqueness, and continuity-are crucial for a reliable diversity measure and that none of the standard metrics in the literature satisfy all three. They also constructed two measures that do satisfy the axioms, but both are NP-hard to compute, leaving open the question of whether efficient axiomatic diversity measures can exist. We study a Euclidean-restricted version of this question. We introduce Geometric Kernel Diversity (GKD), which associates a radial kernel solid with each point and measures the volume of their union. We show that canonical GKD satisfies all three Mironov-Prokhorenkova axioms on Euclidean-realizable inputs. For canonical GKD, we give exact polynomial-time algorithms in dimensions $d \le 3$. In arbitrary dimensions, we give a randomized algorithm that returns a $(1 \pm \varepsilon)$-approximation with probability at least $1-δ$ in time $O \left(\frac{nd}{\varepsilon^2}\log\frac{2}δ\right)$ for $n$ points. The axiomatic guarantee applies to exact canonical GKD; the randomized algorithm approximates this deterministic quantity. We further show that the two diversity measures of Mironov and Prokhorenkova (2025) remain NP-hard on Euclidean-realizable inputs and, unless $\mathrm{NP} = \mathrm{RP}$, admit no FPRAS even on this restricted domain.

AI.translation:
论文题目：几何核多样性：欧几里得空间中的公理多样性度量

摘要：量化一组对象的 다양性是机器学习和统计学中的一个基本问题。Mironov 和 Prokhorenkova (2025) 最近表明，单调性、唯一性和连续性这三个公理对于可靠的多样性度量至关重要，但文献中没有一个标准度量能同时满足这三个公理。他们还构建了两种满足这些公理的度量，但两者都是NP-hard计算的，这使得是否存在高效的公理多样性度量成为一个悬而未决的问题。我们研究了这个问题在欧几里得空间中的受限版本。我们引入了几何核多样性（GKD），它将一个径向核实体与每个点关联起来，并测量它们并集的体积。我们证明了规范GKD在欧几里得可实现输入上满足所有三个Mironov-Prokhorenkova公理。对于规范GKD，我们在$d 	ext{≤} 3$的维度中提供了精确的多项式时间算法。在任意维度中，我们提供了一种随机算法，以至少$1-δ$的概率返回一个$(1 	ext{±} 	ext{ε})$-近似值，对于$n$个点，时间复杂度为$O 	ext{（} rac{nd}{	ext{ε}^2}	ext{log} rac{2}δ	ext{）}$。公理保证适用于精确的规范GKD；随机算法近似这个确定性量。我们进一步表明，Mironov 和 Prokhorenkova (2025) 的两种多样性度量在欧几里得可实现输入上仍然是NP-hard的，并且除非$	ext{NP} = 	ext{RP}$，否则即使在这个受限域上也不承认FPRAS。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了几何核多样性（GKD），这是一种在欧几里得空间中量化对象多样性的新方法。GKD通过测量与每个点关联的径向核实体的并集体积来工作。研究表明，规范GKD满足了Mironov-Prokhorenkova提出的关于多样性度量的三个关键公理：单调性、唯一性和连续性。针对GKD，论文提供了在$d 	ext{≤} 3$维度下的精确多项式时间算法，以及在任意维度下实现$(1 	ext{±} 	ext{ε})$-近似的随机算法。此外，论文还证明了Mironov和Prokhorenkova先前提出的两种多样性度量在欧几里得可实现输入上仍然是NP-hard的，并且不承认FPRAS，从而突显了GKD在效率方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 几何核多样性, 公理多样性, 欧几里得空间, 多样性度量, 多项式时间算法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了几何核多样性（GKD），这是一种在欧几里得空间中高效且符合公理的多样性度量。它解决了先前由Mironov和Prokhorenkova提出的公理化多样性度量计算复杂度过高（NP-hard）的开放问题。GKD的重要性在于为机器学习和统计学中量化多样性提供了一个实用且理论上健全的工具，特别是在低维度空间中提供了精确的多项式时间算法，并在高维度空间中提供了有效的近似算法。这对于需要评估数据集多样性的应用具有重要意义。

title: LED-BENCH: A Benchmark for Large-format Engineering Drawing Understanding
summary: Real-world engineering drawings are often large-format and information-dense. Answering practical engineering questions therefore requires both fine-grained understanding of engineering information and complex reasoning over objects, relations, and evidence distributed across different regions or views. Existing benchmarks cover a range of engineering-drawing understanding tasks involving local regions, individual views, specific elements, or more constrained visual settings. However, systematic evaluation of understanding over realistic, large-format engineering drawings remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce LED-BENCH, a multidisciplinary benchmark designed to evaluate fine-grained understanding and complex reasoning over large-format engineering drawings, spanning the mechanical, architectural, and transportation domains. Extensive evaluation of 11 representative multimodal large language models, including 8 proprietary models and 3 open-source models, reveals substantial remaining difficulty: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves 52.65% average accuracy, performance varies across engineering domains, and all evaluated models perform worse on questions requiring broader evidence integration. These results highlight fine-grained understanding, evidence integration, and complex reasoning over large-format engineering drawings as persistent challenges for current multimodal models.

AI.title_translation: LED-BENCH：大幅面工程图纸理解基准
AI.tldr: 推出LED-BENCH基准以评估多模态模型对大幅面工程图纸的理解与推理能力，实验表明当前模型在此任务上表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试主要集中在局部区域、单个视图或受限的视觉设置上，缺乏对真实、大幅面工程图纸理解的系统性评估，无法满足实际工程中对跨区域对象、关系和证据进行复杂推理的需求。
AI.method: 引入了一个名为LED-BENCH的多领域基准，并对11个代表性的多模态大模型（8个闭源模型和3个开源模型）进行了广泛评估。
AI.result: GPT-5.6 Sol取得了52.65%的平均准确率，不同工程领域的性能存在差异，且所有评估模型在需要广泛证据整合的问题上表现更差。
AI.conclusion: 当前的多模态大模型在处理大幅面工程图纸时仍面临巨大挑战，特别是在细粒度理解和跨区域证据整合方面表现不足，LED-BENCH为此提供了一个重要的评估基准。
AI.translation: 现实世界的工程图纸通常是大幅面且信息密集的。因此，回答实际的工程问题既需要对工程信息进行细粒度理解，又需要对分布在不同区域或视图的对象、关系和证据进行复杂的推理。现有的基准测试涵盖了一系列涉及局部区域、单个视图、特定元素或受限视觉设置的工程图纸理解任务。然而，对真实、大幅面工程图纸理解的系统性评估仍然有限。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了LED-BENCH，这是一个多学科基准，旨在评估对大幅面工程图纸的细粒度理解和复杂推理，涵盖机械、建筑和交通领域。对11个具有代表性的多模态大模型（包括8个专有模型和3个开源模型）的广泛评估揭示了巨大的剩余难度：GPT-5.6 Sol取得了52.65%的平均准确率，不同工程领域的性能各不相同，且所有评估模型在需要更广泛证据整合的问题上表现更差。这些结果突显了细粒度理解、证据整合以及对大幅面工程图纸的复杂推理仍然是当前多模态模型面临的持久挑战。
AI.summary: 论文推出了LED-BENCH——一个用于评估多模态大模型在大幅面工程图纸上进行细粒度理解和复杂推理能力的跨领域基准。对11个主流模型的评估表明，当前模型在处理大幅面工程图纸、跨区域证据整合及复杂推理方面仍面临严峻挑战。
AI.keywords: 工程图纸, 多模态大模型, 基准测试, 细粒度理解, 复杂推理
AI.comments: 该论文填补了大幅面工程图纸理解基准的空白，跨越多个领域并测试了主流多模态模型，揭示了当前模型在细粒度理解和证据整合方面的局限性。

title: Divergence-Routed On-Policy Distillation for Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge from a teacher model to a student along student-generated trajectories, typically by minimizing the reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence. However, RKL can provide weak corrective signals for teacher-supported tokens to which the student assigns very low probability. This raises two questions: which positions are most consequential for the behavioral gap between the student and teacher, and what additional supervision is needed at these positions? Through cross-sampling, we find that divergence-based routing more effectively pinpoints positions contributing to the teacher-student performance gap than entropy-based routing. Further analysis reveals teacher-mode under-coverage at high Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence positions, where standard OPD increases the large teacher-student probability gaps. Motivated by these findings, we propose Divergence-Routed On-Policy Distillation (DrOPD). DrOPD retains RKL supervision at all positions and selectively adds forward Kullback-Leibler (FKL) divergence supervision at positions with high JS divergence. Experiments across six math benchmarks show that DrOPD improves over standard OPD and entropy-based routing. DrOPD also reduces severe under-coverage cases by 37.9 percent relative to OPD, supporting targeted FKL as an effective complement to OPD.

AI.title_translation: 散度路由的语言模型在策略蒸馏
AI.tldr: 标准在策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型对教师支持的低概率token分配极低概率时信号较弱。本文提出的散度路由在策略蒸馏（DrOPD）通过散度路由更有效地识别教师-学生性能差距，并在高JS散度位置选择性地添加前向KL散度（FKL）监督。实验表明DrOPD在数学基准测试中优于标准OPD，并显著减少了欠覆盖情况。
AI.motivation: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通常通过最小化反向Kullback-Leibler（RKL）散度将知识从教师模型转移到学生模型。然而，当学生对教师支持的token分配极低概率时，RKL可能提供弱的纠正信号。这引发了两个问题：哪些位置对学生和教师之间的行为差距影响最大，以及在这些位置需要哪些额外的监督。
AI.method: 本文提出了散度路由的在策略蒸馏（DrOPD）。DrOPD在所有位置保留RKL监督，并选择性地在高Jensen-Shannon（JS）散度位置添加前向Kullback-Leibler（FKL）散度监督。通过交叉采样，研究发现基于散度的路由比基于熵的路由能更有效地找出导致教师-学生性能差距的位置。
AI.result: 在六个数学基准测试中的实验表明，DrOPD优于标准OPD和基于熵的路由方法。DrOPD还相对于OPD将严重的欠覆盖情况减少了37.9%。
AI.conclusion: 有针对性的FKL散度监督，通过散度进行路由，可以有效地补充标准的在策略蒸馏，以提高语言模型性能并解决欠覆盖问题。
AI.translation: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过最小化反向Kullback-Leibler（RKL）散度，将知识从教师模型转移到学生生成的轨迹上。然而，RKL对于学生分配极低概率的教师支持的token可能提供弱的纠正信号。这引发了两个问题：哪些位置对学生和教师之间的行为差距影响最大，以及在这些位置需要哪些额外的监督？通过交叉采样，我们发现基于散度的路由比基于熵的路由能更有效地找出导致教师-学生性能差距的位置。进一步分析揭示，在高Jensen-Shannon（JS）散度位置存在教师模式欠覆盖，而标准OPD会增加大的教师-学生概率差距。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了散度路由的在策略蒸馏（DrOPD）。DrOPD在所有位置保留RKL监督，并选择性地在高JS散度位置添加前向Kullback-Leibler（FKL）散度监督。在六个数学基准测试中的实验表明，DrOPD优于标准OPD和基于熵的路由方法。DrOPD还相对于OPD将严重的欠覆盖情况减少了37.9%，支持有针对性的FKL作为OPD的有效补充。
AI.summary: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型对教师支持的低概率token分配极低概率时，RKL散度提供的纠正信号较弱。本文通过交叉采样发现，基于散度的路由比基于熵的路由能更有效地识别教师-学生性能差距，并揭示在高Jensen-Shannon（JS）散度位置存在教师模式欠覆盖问题。为此，论文提出了散度路由的在策略蒸馏（DrOPD），该方法在所有位置保留RKL监督，并选择性地在高JS散度位置添加前向Kullback-Leibler（FKL）散度监督。实验结果表明，DrOPD在多个数学基准测试中优于标准OPD和基于熵的路由方法，并显著减少了欠覆盖情况。
AI.keywords: 在策略蒸馏, 知识蒸馏, 语言模型, 散度路由, Kullback-Leibler散度
AI.comments: 这篇论文创新性地解决了在策略蒸馏中学生模型对教师分布欠覆盖的关键问题。通过引入散度路由机制来精确识别教师-学生行为差距的关键位置，并有针对性地在高JS散度位置补充FKL散度监督，DrOPD提供了一种有效且新颖的知识蒸馏策略。这种结合RKL和FKL的自适应监督方法，对于提升语言模型蒸馏效果具有重要意义。

title: Learning Across Temporal Graph Representation Silos
summary: Temporal graph data are recorded in different representations, but whether these differences also determine the scope of learned knowledge reuse remains unclear. This study investigates whether predictive structure learned from relational histories can be reused between continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) and temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs). Bidirectional reuse emerges while retaining distinct input and prediction interfaces and independent vocabularies, and sources with the same representation are not always more useful. Controlled reorganizations of source histories show that the organization contributing to reuse varies across source-target conditions. We show that learned aspects of Relational Dynamics, the predictive structure present in relational histories, can be reused across conventional representation boundaries. Independently pretrained TKG and CTDG learners can also be fused at the score level to improve prediction on a third dataset without entity or relation-semantic alignment. Two proofs of concept in recommendation and security detection illustrate that external temporal sources without direct alignment can also become useful pretraining resources.

AI.title_translation: 跨时间图表示孤岛学习
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了时间图的不同表示（如CTDG和TKG）之间学习到的预测结构是否可以重用。结果表明，即使在没有直接对齐的情况下，双向重用是可行的，并且可以提高在第三方数据集上的预测性能，证明了外部时间源作为预训练资源的潜力。
AI.motivation: 时间图数据以不同的表示形式记录，但这些差异是否也决定了学习到的知识重用范围尚不清楚。本研究旨在探究关系历史中学习到的预测结构是否可以在连续时间动态图（CTDGs）和时间知识图（TKGs）之间重用。
AI.method: 本研究调查了关系历史中学习到的预测结构在CTDGs和TKGs之间的重用情况。它通过保留不同的输入和预测接口以及独立的词汇进行双向重用。研究还对源历史进行了受控重组，并展示了如何将独立预训练的TKG和CTDG学习器在得分层面融合，以在没有实体或关系语义对齐的第三方数据集上改进预测。通过推荐和安全检测领域的两个概念验证进行了说明。
AI.result: 研究发现，即使保留了不同的输入和预测接口以及独立的词汇，双向重用也能实现。具有相同表示的源并不总是更有用。贡献于重组的组织在源-目标条件之间有所不同。关系历史中存在的预测结构（关系动力学）的学习方面可以在常规表示边界之间重用。独立预训练的TKG和CTDG学习器可以在得分层面融合，以在没有实体或关系语义对齐的第三方数据集上改进预测。外部时间源（无需直接对齐）也可以成为有用的预训练资源。
AI.conclusion: 本研究得出结论，关系历史中学习到的关系动力学（预测结构）可以跨越传统的表示边界（如CTDG和TKG）进行重用。即使没有直接的语义对齐，独立预训练的模型也可以融合以提高预测性能，这表明外部时间源可以作为有效的预训练资源。
AI.translation: 时间图数据以不同的表示形式记录，但这些差异是否也决定了学习到的知识重用范围尚不清楚。本研究调查了关系历史中学习到的预测结构是否可以在连续时间动态图（CTDGs）和时间知识图（TKGs）之间重用。即使保留了不同的输入和预测接口以及独立的词汇，双向重用也能实现，并且具有相同表示的源并不总是更有用。对源历史的受控重组表明，贡献于重用的组织在源-目标条件之间有所不同。我们表明，关系历史中存在的预测结构——关系动力学——的学习方面可以在常规表示边界之间重用。独立预训练的TKG和CTDG学习器也可以在得分层面融合，以在没有实体或关系语义对齐的第三方数据集上改进预测。推荐和安全检测领域的两个概念验证说明，无需直接对齐的外部时间源也可以成为有用的预训练资源。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了时间图数据在不同表示（如连续时间动态图CTDGs和时间知识图TKGs）之间进行知识重用的可能性。研究发现，即使在输入接口、预测接口和词汇独立的情况下，学习到的预测结构（关系动力学）仍能实现双向重用。实验表明，相同表示的源不一定更有效，且重用机制因源-目标条件而异。通过将独立预训练的CTDG和TKG学习器在得分层面融合，即使没有实体或关系语义对齐，也能提高在第三方数据集上的预测性能。这证明了外部时间源作为有效预训练资源的潜力，并在推荐和安全检测中得到了概念验证。
AI.keywords: 时间图, 知识重用, 表示学习, 关系动力学, 预训练
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它挑战了时间图表示之间知识重用的传统界限。它证明了即使在表示形式、输入/输出接口和词汇都不同的情况下，通过学习关系动力学，知识仍然可以进行双向迁移和重用。特别是，在没有直接语义对齐的情况下，通过模型融合来提升第三方数据集性能的发现，为利用异构时间数据进行预训练开辟了新途径，具有重要的理论和实际意义。

title: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
summary: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.

AI.title_translation: 弥合拓扑鸿沟：基于语义先验的双分支图蒸馏实现鲁棒的冷启动推荐
AI.tldr: 图协同过滤模型在严格冷启动场景中因未观测物品的拓扑隔离而遭遇表示崩溃。DualGCN提出一个双分支图知识蒸馏框架，通过语义先验和解耦的两阶段训练，有效弥合拓扑鸿沟，显著提升冷启动推荐性能，同时保持活跃物品的推荐精度。
AI.motivation: 图协同过滤模型在严格冷启动场景中，由于未观测物品的拓扑隔离，固有地遭受灾难性的表示崩溃。直接将孤立的语义属性映射到全局拓扑驱动的协同空间中，经常导致表示退化和优化冲突。本研究的动机是弥合这一根本性的结构鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出了DualGCN，一个创新的双分支图知识蒸馏框架。该框架采用解耦的两阶段训练范式：首先，构建一个鲁棒的协同教师网络，其中物品表示通过拓扑平滑的语义先验进行锚定，有效重塑潜在流形。其次，一个语义学生分支采用残差映射机制和与幅度无关的余弦蒸馏目标，实现高保真度的跨模态对齐，同时不扰乱已建立的协同信号。此外，引入了动态范数重构机制，以在全局检索期间严格校准新物品和活跃物品的物理尺度。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DualGCN在严格冷启动场景中显著优于最先进的基线方法，同时全面保持了高度活跃物品的推荐精度。
AI.conclusion: DualGCN通过结合语义先验和双分支蒸馏框架，有效弥合了冷启动推荐中的拓扑鸿沟。它在提升冷启动物品性能的同时，保持了活跃物品的推荐精度，为鲁棒的冷启动推荐提供了一个创新解决方案。
AI.translation: 图协同过滤模型在推荐系统中取得了显著成功。然而，由于未观测物品的拓扑隔离，它们在严格冷启动场景中固有地遭受灾难性的表示崩溃。虽然整合多模态语义特征提供了一种潜在的补救措施，但将孤立的语义属性直接映射到全局拓扑驱动的协同空间中，经常导致表示退化和优化冲突。为了弥合这一根本性的结构鸿沟，我们提出了DualGCN，一个创新的双分支图知识蒸馏框架。DualGCN在解耦的两阶段训练范式下运行，首先构建一个鲁棒的协同教师网络，其中物品表示通过拓扑平滑的语义先验进行锚定，有效重塑潜在流形。随后，一个语义学生分支采用残差映射机制和与幅度无关的余弦蒸馏目标，实现高保真度的跨模态对齐，同时不扰乱已建立的协同信号。此外，我们引入了动态范数重构机制，以在全局检索期间严格校准新物品和活跃物品的物理尺度。在三个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DualGCN在严格冷启动场景中显著优于最先进的基线方法，同时全面保持了高度活跃物品的推荐精度。
AI.summary: 图协同过滤（GCF）模型在冷启动推荐中因新物品的拓扑隔离而面临表示崩溃问题，且直接整合语义特征常导致性能下降。为解决此根本性结构鸿沟，本文提出了DualGCN，一个双分支图知识蒸馏框架。DualGCN采用解耦的两阶段训练：首先，教师网络利用拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定物品表示；随后，学生分支通过残差映射和余弦蒸馏实现高保真跨模态对齐。此外，引入动态范数重构机制校准新旧物品的尺度。实验证明，DualGCN在严格冷启动场景中显著优于现有方法，并能保持活跃物品的推荐精度。
AI.keywords: 冷启动推荐, 图神经网络, 知识蒸馏, 语义先验, 协同过滤
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于针对图协同过滤模型在冷启动场景中因拓扑隔离导致的表示崩溃问题，提出了一个结合语义先验和双分支知识蒸馏的框架。其解耦的两阶段训练范式，特别是拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定和幅度无关的余弦蒸馏目标，有效地解决了语义与协同空间融合的冲突。该研究的重要性在于为冷启动推荐提供了一种鲁棒且高效的解决方案，在提升新物品推荐性能的同时，不影响现有活跃物品的推荐精度，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Back on Track: Deployment-time Policy Improvement via World Model Planning
summary: State-of-the-art visuomotor policies are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks, yet can fail during deployment in ways they cannot predict or recover from on their own. Improving their performance and robustness typically requires collecting more data, retraining, or modifying the policy architecture, all of which are time- and resource-intensive in practice. We instead propose an offline-trained monitoring-and-intervention framework that improves a policy during deployment using only black-box query access. From a limited set of labeled on-policy rollouts, we learn a policy-conditioned liveness value that measures the nominal policy's progress toward task completion; we additionally train a compact latent world model using these rollouts together with play data. At deployment, the liveness value continuously monitors execution. When it detects a loss of progress, a short-horizon planner searches the world model for corrective actions using the same value as its planning objective, after which control returns to the nominal policy. We evaluate our method on the LIBERO-Goal task suite and on a Franka Panda manipulator, using the vision-language-action model $π_{0.5}$ and a diffusion policy as nominal policies, and demonstrate significant improvements in task success rates, while supporting real-time control. Additional results and videos are available on the project website (https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/).

AI.title_translation: 重回正轨：通过世界模型规划进行部署时策略改进
AI.tldr: 现有的视觉运动策略在部署时可能会以不可预测的方式失败。本文提出了一种离线训练的监控与干预框架，该框架在部署期间使用学习到的活跃度值和世界模型来改进策略，从而在不进行重新训练的情况下显著提高任务成功率并支持实时控制。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的视觉运动策略在部署时可能会以它们无法预测或自行恢复的方式失败。改进其性能和鲁棒性通常需要收集更多数据、重新训练或修改策略架构，这些在实践中都是耗时且资源密集型的。
AI.method: 本文提出一个离线训练的监控与干预框架，仅通过黑盒查询访问在部署期间改进策略。该框架从有限的标记在策略轨迹中学习一个策略条件活跃度值，用于衡量名义策略完成任务的进展；同时，利用这些轨迹和游戏数据训练一个紧凑的潜在世界模型。在部署时，活跃度值持续监控执行情况。当检测到进展损失时，一个短时规划器在世界模型中搜索纠正动作，使用相同的活跃度值作为规划目标，之后控制权返回给名义策略。
AI.result: 该方法在LIBERO-Goal任务套件和Franka Panda机械臂上进行了评估，使用视觉-语言-动作模型$π_{0.5}$和扩散策略作为名义策略，结果表明任务成功率显著提高，并支持实时控制。
AI.conclusion: 通过提出的监控与干预框架，本文成功地在部署期间改进了视觉运动策略的性能和鲁棒性，显著提高了任务成功率并支持实时控制，提供了一种无需耗时重新训练的有效方法。
AI.translation: 最先进的视觉运动策略越来越能够执行复杂的任务，但在部署时可能会以它们无法预测或自行恢复的方式失败。改进其性能和鲁棒性通常需要收集更多数据、重新训练或修改策略架构，所有这些在实践中都是耗时且资源密集型的。我们反而提出了一种离线训练的监控与干预框架，该框架仅使用黑盒查询访问在部署期间改进策略。从有限的标记在策略轨迹中，我们学习了一个策略条件活跃度值，用于衡量名义策略完成任务的进展；我们还使用这些轨迹和游戏数据训练了一个紧凑的潜在世界模型。在部署时，活跃度值持续监控执行情况。当检测到进展损失时，一个短时规划器在世界模型中搜索纠正动作，使用相同的活跃度值作为其规划目标，之后控制权返回给名义策略。我们在LIBERO-Goal任务套件和Franka Panda机械臂上评估了我们的方法，使用视觉-语言-动作模型$π_{0.5}$和扩散策略作为名义策略，并展示了任务成功率的显著提高，同时支持实时控制。更多结果和视频可在项目网站（https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/）上获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的离线训练监控与干预框架，旨在部署期间改进视觉运动策略。该框架通过学习一个策略条件活跃度值来衡量任务进展，并利用一个紧凑的潜在世界模型在检测到进展损失时规划纠正动作。实验结果表明，该方法在机器人操作任务中显著提高了任务成功率，并支持实时控制，为策略改进提供了一种无需昂贵重新训练的有效替代方案。
AI.keywords: 策略改进, 世界模型, 部署时, 视觉运动策略, 实时控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种在部署时而非重新训练阶段改进策略的黑盒方法，这对于需要实时适应性和鲁棒性且数据收集/重新训练成本高昂的机器人应用具有重要意义。通过结合活跃度值进行监控和世界模型进行规划，该方法提供了一个巧妙且实用的解决方案。

title: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively. We propose XferAgent, a framework for cross-agent experience transfer that organizes reusable experience in local and shared experience graphs. XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges. For each new task, it selects shared experiences and integrates them with the target agent's local experience to support task execution. Experiments across diverse task domains show improvements over representative memory-based methods and effective experience transfer between heterogeneous agent frameworks. Cumulative task success also increases over successive task passes as agents update and reuse their experiences.

AI.title_translation: XferAgent：用于自我改进LLM智能体的跨智能体经验迁移
AI.tldr: XferAgent是一个跨智能体经验迁移框架，它通过本地和共享经验图组织可重用经验，以提高LLM智能体在后续任务中的性能，并在多样化任务领域中显示出改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法虽然允许跨智能体经验共享，但由于智能体执行历史和任务要求的差异，共享经验难以有效重用。本研究旨在解决LLM智能体中跨智能体经验有效重用和性能提升的问题。
AI.method: 我们提出了XferAgent，一个用于跨智能体经验迁移的框架，它将可重用经验组织在本地和共享经验图中。XferAgent协调来自异构智能体的兼容贡献，同时避免不可靠的合并。对于每个新任务，它选择共享经验并将其与目标智能体的本地经验集成以支持任务执行。
AI.result: 在多样化任务领域的实验表明，XferAgent优于代表性的基于记忆的方法，并在异构智能体框架之间实现了有效的经验迁移。随着智能体更新和重用其经验，累积任务成功率在连续的任务传递中也有所增加。
AI.conclusion: XferAgent通过组织本地和共享经验图，有效地实现了LLM智能体之间的跨智能体经验迁移，解决了现有方法中经验重用效率低下的问题，并显著提高了智能体在多样化任务中的性能和成功率。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以重用先前的任务执行经验，以提高后续任务的性能。尽管现有方法能够实现跨智能体经验共享，但由于智能体的执行历史和任务要求的差异，共享经验难以有效重用。我们提出了XferAgent，一个用于跨智能体经验迁移的框架，它将可重用经验组织在本地和共享经验图中。XferAgent协调来自异构智能体的兼容贡献，同时避免不可靠的合并。对于每个新任务，它选择共享经验并将其与目标智能体的本地经验集成以支持任务执行。在多样化任务领域的实验表明，XferAgent优于代表性的基于记忆的方法，并在异构智能体框架之间实现了有效的经验迁移。随着智能体更新和重用其经验，累积任务成功率在连续的任务传递中也有所增加。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了XferAgent，一个用于LLM智能体的跨智能体经验迁移框架。该框架通过本地和共享经验图组织可重用经验，旨在解决现有方法中因智能体执行历史和任务要求差异导致的经验重用效率低下的问题。XferAgent能够协调异构智能体的兼容贡献，并为新任务选择和整合共享经验与本地经验。实验结果表明，XferAgent在多样化任务领域中优于传统记忆方法，并能有效促进异构智能体框架间的经验迁移，从而提高累积任务成功率。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 经验迁移, 自我改进, 经验图, XferAgent
AI.comments: XferAgent的创新之处在于其通过本地和共享经验图组织经验，并能够协调异构智能体的贡献，有效解决了跨智能体经验共享中的重用难题。这对于提升LLM智能体的自我学习和泛化能力具有重要意义。未来研究可以探索其在更复杂、动态环境中的鲁棒性。

title: Who's Behind the Text? Robust Model Authorship Attribution
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate text, their misuse has become a growing societal problem, with implications for academic misconduct, model distillation, and cyberattacks. For these reasons, Model Authorship Attribution (MAA), which identifies the source model of a given text, is important for promoting the responsible use of LLMs and improving AI safety. In practice, attribution systems must remain reliable beyond the distributions observed during training. They may encounter texts from unseen domains and writing settings, as well as generations from future versions of model families that were not available when the system was trained. However, existing MAA methods often exhibit substantial performance degradation under such distribution shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Authorship Tracing via Likelihood-based Attribution of Sources (ATLAS), which formulates MAA through source-conditioned text modeling rather than direct source prediction. ATLAS learns how text from each source family is generated and attributes a given text by comparing its likelihood under each learned source condition. We aggregate this likelihood evidence at the token level with clipping so that no single token dominates the decision. We further introduce MAABench, a broad MAA benchmark for evaluating practical OOD settings such as domain and version. Our experiments show that ATLAS consistently outperforms existing baselines across MAABench and OpenTuringBench. In particular, when both the generation domain and the model version change on MAABench, ATLAS achieves 74.27% accuracy, 9.00pp higher than the strongest baseline. Beyond MAA, ATLAS can also help identify distillation source models by measuring which source model a target LLM most closely resembles. Our extended experiments show that ATLAS recovers the known teacher of every distilled model we evaluate.

AI.title_translation: 谁是文本背后的作者？鲁棒的模型作者归属
AI.tldr: 现有的模型作者归属（MAA）方法在遇到未见过的数据分布时性能会下降。本文提出了ATLAS，一种通过源条件文本建模进行MAA的新方法，它通过比较文本在不同源条件下的似然度来进行归属，并通过令牌级聚合和裁剪来提高鲁棒性。ATLAS在MAABench和OpenTuringBench基准测试中均优于现有方法，特别是在处理领域和版本变化时。此外，ATLAS还可以用于识别蒸馏模型的来源。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）生成文本的广泛使用，其滥用（如学术不端、模型蒸馏、网络攻击）已成为一个日益严峻的社会问题。模型作者归属（MAA）对于识别文本的来源模型至关重要，有助于促进LLM的负责任使用和提高AI安全。然而，现有的MAA方法在面对分布外（OOD）数据时，如未见过的领域、写作设置或未来模型版本，性能会显著下降。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种名为ATLAS（Authorship Tracing via Likelihood-based Attribution of Sources）的新方法。ATLAS将MAA问题建模为源条件文本建模，而不是直接预测来源。它学习每种来源模型生成文本的方式，并通过比较给定文本在每种学习到的源条件下的似然度来进行归属。为了提高鲁棒性，ATLAS在令牌级别聚合似然度证据，并进行裁剪，以防止单个令牌过度影响决策。此外，本文还引入了MAABench，一个用于评估实际OOD设置（如领域和版本）的广泛MAA基准测试。
AI.result: ATLAS在MAABench和OpenTuringBench基准测试中始终优于现有基线。特别是在MAABench上，当生成领域和模型版本都发生变化时，ATLAS的准确率达到了74.27%，比最强的基线高出9.00个百分点。此外，ATLAS在识别蒸馏模型的来源方面也表现出色，能够准确找出所有评估过的蒸馏模型的教师模型。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS通过源条件文本建模和令牌级似然度聚合，有效解决了现有模型作者归属方法在分布外设置下的性能下降问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了显著的优于现有方法的结果。该方法不仅能用于模型作者归属，还能应用于识别蒸馏模型的来源，为LLM的安全和负责任使用提供了重要的技术支持。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用于生成文本，它们的滥用已成为日益严重的社会问题，对学术不端行为、模型蒸馏和网络攻击都有影响。因此，模型作者归属（MAA），即识别给定文本的来源模型，对于促进LLM的负责任使用和提高AI安全至关重要。在实践中，归属系统必须在训练期间观察到的分布之外保持可靠。它们可能会遇到来自未见过领域和写作环境的文本，以及在系统训练时不可用的模型系列的未来版本的生成文本。然而，现有的MAA方法在这种分布转移下通常会表现出显著的性能下降。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了ATLAS（Authorship Tracing via Likelihood-based Attribution of Sources），它通过源条件文本建模而非直接源预测来构建MAA。ATLAS学习每个来源的文本是如何生成的，并通过比较给定文本在每个学习到的源条件下的似然度来进行归属。我们将似然度证据在令牌级别进行聚合，并进行裁剪，以便没有任何单个令牌会主导决策。我们进一步引入了MAABench，一个用于评估实际OOD设置（如领域和版本）的广泛MAA基准。我们的实验表明，ATLAS在MAABench和OpenTuringBench上的表现始终优于现有基线。特别地，当MAABench上的生成领域和模型版本都发生变化时，ATLAS达到了74.27%的准确率，比最强的基线高出9.00个百分点。除了MAA，ATLAS还可以通过测量目标LLM最接近哪个源模型来帮助识别蒸馏源模型。我们扩展的实验表明，ATLAS能够恢复我们评估的每个蒸馏模型的已知教师模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为ATLAS的新型模型作者归属（MAA）方法，旨在解决现有方法在分布外（OOD）设置下面临的性能下降问题。ATLAS通过源条件文本建模，学习不同来源模型生成文本的模式，并基于文本在这些模式下的似然度进行归属。该方法在令牌级别聚合似然度并进行裁剪，以增强鲁棒性。同时，研究人员还发布了MAABench基准测试，用于评估实际OOD场景。实验证明，ATLAS在多个基准测试中均优于现有方法，尤其是在领域和版本发生变化时表现突出。此外，ATLAS还能有效识别蒸馏模型的来源。
AI.keywords: 模型作者归属, 分布外泛化, 源条件文本建模, 似然度归属, LLM安全
AI.comments: ATLAS方法在模型作者归属领域取得了显著进展，尤其是在处理分布外数据方面。通过将MAA视为一个似然度度量问题而非直接分类问题，并结合令牌级聚合和裁剪技术，有效提升了方法的鲁棒性和准确性。MAABench的引入为该领域的研究提供了重要的评估平台。然而，该方法在计算效率方面可能存在挑战，并且对于极其相似的模型或非常短的文本，其归属能力仍有待进一步验证。此外，未来研究可以探索ATLAS在其他文本归属任务中的应用潜力。

title: Full AFLs Closed under Nested Iterated $k$-Variate Substitution and Depth-k Storage Automata
comments: (10pt, A4, 3 figures, 13 pages) This is a preliminary report
summary: Greibach and Ginsburg (1969) studied abstract families of languages or AFLs. A full AFL is a class of languages closed under the following operations: homomorphism, inverse homomorphism, intersection with regular languages, union, concatenation, and Kleene star. Greibach (1970) used a restricted substitution, called nested iterated substitution, to introduce the notion of super AFLs, which are full AFLs that are further closed under nested iterated substitution. The smallest super AFL was shown to be the class of all context-free languages. From this fact, we focus on Greibach's limited, univariable application of nested iterated substitution and further generalize it into k-variate. This introduces the notion of nested iterated $k$-variate substitution whose definition does not rely on "machines". Recently, a "two-tape" version of Hibbard's (1967) rewriting systems, which were later reformulated by Pighizzini and Pisoni (2014) as k-limited automata with "single" input/work tapes, has been studied under the name of depth-k storage automata. This work unearths a few characteristics of the languages recognized by those automata under a restriction known as frozen blank sensitivity in terms of full AFLs and nested iterated k-variate substitution. This will promote a further abstract treatment of those languages.

AI.title_translation: 全 AFL 在嵌套迭代 k-变量替换和深度 k 存储自动机下闭合
AI.tldr: 该研究将嵌套迭代替换的概念从单变量推广到 k 变量，并研究了深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言的性质，将其与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 变量替换联系起来。
AI.motivation: 研究 Greibach 的嵌套迭代替换，并将其推广到 k 变量，以抽象地处理深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言。
AI.method: 将嵌套迭代替换推广到 k 变量，并研究深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言的性质，重点关注其与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 变量替换的关系。
AI.result: 揭示了深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言的一些性质，这些语言在冷冻空白敏感性的限制下，与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 变量替换相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言提供了一种更抽象的处理方式，并将其与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 自动机联系起来。
AI.translation: Greibach 和 Ginsburg (1969) 研究了抽象语言族或 AFL。全 AFL 是在以下操作下闭合的语言类：同态、逆同态、与正则语言的交集、并集、连接和克莱尼星。Greibach (1970) 使用了一种受限的替换，称为嵌套迭代替换，引入了超级 AFL 的概念，超级 AFL 是在嵌套迭代替换下也闭合的全 AFL。最小的超级 AFL 被证明是所有上下文无关语言的类。基于此，我们关注 Greibach 的受限的、单变量的嵌套迭代替换的应用，并进一步将其推广到 k 变量。这引入了嵌套迭代 k 变量替换的概念，其定义不依赖于“机器”。最近，Hibbard (1967) 的重写系统的“双带”版本，后来由 Pighizzini 和 Pisoni (2014) 改写为具有“单”输入/工作带的 k-限制自动机，在“冷冻空白敏感性”的限制下，以深度 k 存储自动机的名称进行了研究。这项工作揭示了那些自动机在“冷冻空白敏感性”限制下所识别的语言的一些特性，这些特性与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 变量替换相关。这将促进对这些语言的进一步抽象处理。
AI.summary: 这项工作将 Greibach 的嵌套迭代替换从单变量推广到 k 变量，即嵌套迭代 k 变量替换，其定义不依赖于机器。研究了具有“冷冻空白敏感性”限制的深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言的性质，并将它们与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 变量替换联系起来，为这些语言提供了更抽象的处理方法。
AI.keywords: 全 AFL, 嵌套迭代 k-变量替换, 深度 k 存储自动机, 抽象语言论, 上下文无关语言
AI.comments: 这项工作成功地将嵌套迭代替换的概念从单变量推广到 k 变量，并为深度 k 存储自动机识别的语言提供了一种新的抽象视角。研究结果将这些语言与全 AFL 和嵌套迭代 k 变量替换联系起来，为未来的研究奠定了基础。然而，文中提到的“冷冻空白敏感性”限制的具体影响和实际应用有待进一步阐述。

title: Seven Limit Cycles in a Periodically Forced Three-Zone Equation
summary: We construct a seven-cycle example for a periodically forced scalar equation with a continuous three-zone piecewise-linear nonlinearity. Symbolic integration and linear elimination reduce the four-flight matching conditions to two equations in the residence times. The competing exterior visits produce an additional turn of the critical response and lead to the rational parameters $(A,B,μ)=(9,3/2,181363/100000)$. At these parameters, finite Taylor estimates give three sign changes of the return displacement. Scalar order, analyticity along transverse itineraries, and half-period reflection then establish at least seven distinct isolated periodic orbits on the phase cylinder.

AI.title_translation: 周期性强迫的三区方程中的七个极限环

title: Moral Combat: Exploiting Moral Foundations Theory to Jailbreak LLMs
summary: Social psychology has long described how people can be persuaded to interpret a harmful act as moral. Recent research suggests that Large Language Models (LLMs) echo aspects of human psychology, from cognitive biases to social conformity. This raises a question with direct safety implications: can LLMs be moralized to bypass safety guardrails? We answer this question with a multi-agent framework grounded in Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). Given a harmful request that is initially refused, our agents diagnose which moral foundation (MF) the prompt is violating, identify a justifiable foundation under which the same request appears virtuous, rewrite the prompt accordingly, and reinforce it with generated precedents of comparable moral reframing. We evaluate our framework on harmful prompts from three well-known jailbreak datasets across five open-source and proprietary models. Our analysis reveals that models are highly susceptible to moralization, exhibiting high single-trial jailbreak rates with success increasing further under repeated attempts. We also find that safety benchmarks are imbalanced in the MFs they violate, concentrating on foundations toward which models already exhibit biases.

title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
summary: Repeated event forecasting requires extracting predictive signals from noisy evidence and evaluating their value across successive decisions. We introduce JockeyBench, a benchmark and evaluation protocol that studies this problem through historical Japanese horse racing. The protocol combines time-gated evidence, priced tools, paired frozen-program controls, and two workflows: executing an LLM-written predictor or acquiring evidence for a fresh per-race LLM forecast. Evaluation separates forecast quality, benchmark-specific net utility, and retrospective betting returns and risk under fixed decision rules. Across 28 model--scaffold configurations on 324 races, paired tests identify seven revision gains and two declines after multiple-testing correction. Yet every configuration has negative mean profit under capped-Kelly settlement. In a four-model comparison, the reusable-program workflow has higher mean betting profit and lower research fees, although both workflows lose on average. Further diagnostics reveal that mean probability bias reverses on selected bets and that profitable individual runs can depend on concentrated returns. These findings motivate evaluating predictive competence, adaptation, resource use, and decision value separately when assessing agents for repeated event forecasting.

title: L3M: A Verifiable Harness and Runtime for Self-Extending and Self-Improving Agents
summary: The lasting gains in AI have come from methods that absorb more computation, and language models already scale computation within a call. Useful work, though, happens across calls: over hours or days, through tools and external systems, among many agents and the humans they work for, and increasingly through code the agents write themselves. Whether that work compounds is enabled by the harness around it, and the harness faces a constraint the model does not: of the three participants in such a computation, the human, the model and code, only the human's attention does not scale, so the computation can grow only if the human is not in every loop. L3M is a runtime built on that premise, written in Lean 4 so that one language implements the harness, states its invariants, and is the language agents extend it in. One computation spans humans, agents, models and code, and all of its state lives in Git: a rich state trajectory -- rather than a chat conversation -- is an object the runtime can resume, rewind, fork, compare and merge. Waiting, communication, delegation and undo are primitives, not patterns the model reasons through each time. When an agent works out a procedure, it can write it once as a sealed Lean program whose type is its permission request, and the harness offers it back as a tool -- machinery for the model to use. To take the human out of the loop, L3M uses reversibility to decide where that is safe: a tool's review tier follows from how far its effects can be undone, so agents act freely where the runtime can recover. Because the machinery can change, the properties that make this safe are stated as kernel-checked theorems about the code that runs. On Terminal-Bench, an untuned L3M reaches about two thirds of its (unsafe) shell-equipped pass rate using only safe (not needing human review) tools.

AI.title_translation: L3M：一个可验证的线索和用于自我扩展和自我改进代理的运行时
AI.tldr: L3M是一个可验证的运行时，它允许AI代理通过使用可逆的工具和Git进行自我扩展和改进，从而在不持续人工干预的情况下处理跨越多个调用和参与者的复杂计算。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在处理更多计算方面取得进展，AI代理需要在多次交互中进行有用的工作，而不仅仅是在单次调用中。然而，这种跨调用工作依赖于围绕它的“线索”，而线索必须考虑人类注意力的有限性，因此计算只能在不持续涉及人类的情况下进行扩展。L3M旨在解决这个问题，通过提供一个运行时来支持这种扩展和改进。
AI.method: L3M是一个用Lean 4编写的运行时，它使用Git来管理状态，并将等待、通信、委托和撤销作为基本操作。代理可以将程序写成“密封的Lean程序”，其类型代表权限请求，L3M将其作为工具提供给代理。L3M使用可逆性来确定何时可以安全地将人类排除在循环之外，工具的可恢复性决定了其审查级别。所有这些安全属性都通过内核检查的定理来形式化。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench基准测试中，未经优化的L3M使用安全的（无需人工审查的）工具，达到了（不安全的）shell工具的约三分之二的通过率。
AI.conclusion: L3M通过提供一个可验证的、基于Git的运行时，实现了AI代理的自我扩展和自我改进，它通过可逆性将人类排除在循环之外，并确保了安全操作。该系统在安全性方面取得了显著进展，并且在效率方面有进一步优化的潜力。
AI.translation: AI领域的持久性进步来自于吸收更多计算的方法，而语言模型已经在调用中扩展了计算。然而，有用的工作发生在调用之间：跨越数小时或数天，通过工具和外部系统，在多个代理和它们所服务的人类之间，以及越来越多地通过代理自己编写的代码。这项工作是否能累积取决于围绕它的线索，而线索面临着一个模型没有的约束：在这样的计算的三方参与者——人类、模型和代码——中，只有人类的注意力不会扩展，所以计算只能在人类不在每个循环中时才能增长。L3M是一个基于该前提构建的运行时，用Lean 4编写，因此一种语言实现了线索，陈述了它的不变量，并且是代理扩展它的语言。一次计算跨越人类、代理、模型和代码，并且它的所有状态都存在于Git中：一个丰富的状态轨迹——而不是一个聊天对话——是运行时可以恢复、倒回、分叉、比较和合并的对象。等待、通信、委托和撤销是基本操作，而不是模型每次都需要推理的模式。当代理制定一个程序时，它可以将其作为密封的Lean程序写一次，其类型是它的权限请求，线索将其作为工具提供——供模型使用的机制。为了将人类排除在循环之外，L3M使用可逆性来决定何处是安全的：一个工具的审查级别源于其影响可被撤销的程度，因此代理可以在运行时可以恢复的地方自由行动。因为机制会改变，使其安全的属性被陈述为关于运行代码的内核检查定理。在Terminal-Bench上，一个未经优化的L3M使用仅安全的（不需要人工审查的）工具，达到了（不安全的）配备shell的通过率的大约三分之二。
AI.summary: L3M是一个创新的运行时，它使用Lean 4和Git来支持AI代理的自我扩展和自我改进。通过将状态管理集成到Git中，并引入等待、通信、委托和撤销等基本操作，L3M克服了传统线索的局限性。该系统利用可逆性来安全地将人类排除在关键循环之外，并通过内核检查的定理来保证其操作的安全性。在基准测试中，L3M展示了其在不依赖人工审查的情况下实现高通过率的潜力。
AI.keywords: AI代理, 运行时, Lean 4, Git, 可逆性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个名为L3M的新颖的运行时框架，用于构建能够自我扩展和自我改进的AI代理。其主要创新点在于利用Lean 4进行形式化验证和代码扩展，以及使用Git进行状态管理，这使得计算过程具有可恢复性、可追溯性和可组合性。通过将可逆性作为安全性的度量标准，L3M能够在不持续人工干预的情况下实现自主操作，这在处理复杂和长期的任务中具有重要意义。然而，该研究也提到“未经优化的L3M”达到了“（不安全的）shell工具”的约三分之二的通过率，这暗示了在性能和安全性之间可能存在的权衡，以及进一步优化和扩展其应用范围的空间。

title: InstructPro2: Natural Language and Biological Grounding Guided De Novo Protein Design
summary: The ability to generate proteins with desired functions is a central goal of computational biology. Although natural language can express diverse design objectives, existing protein generation methods often support only narrow tasks or make limited use of biological constraints. We develop InstructPro2 to translate natural-language design objectives into protein sequences while incorporating task-specific biological context. A text encoder captures the design instructions, while dedicated ligand and antigen encoders provide biological context to the sequence-generating decoder. For pretraining, we assemble InstructPro2Bench, comprising 205.7 million <function description, protein> pairs from UniProtKB. We subsequently adapt the model to ligand-binding protein and antibody design. On functional protein generation benchmarks, InstructPro2 outperforms Pinal, the strongest baseline, achieving a functional recovery F1 of 74.8 versus 62.2 and lowering global RMSD from 5.33A to 3.04A. For antibody design, the model obtains a DockQ score of 0.39, while ligand-binding protein design reaches a docking success rate of 72.6%. These findings highlight how integrating language-based instructions with biological conditioning can extend protein generation to distinct design settings.

title: RoboSpan: Learning Modular Coordination Policies for High-DoF Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation with Teleoperation
