title: Sparse universal graphs for planarity
comments: v5: corrects an error in the proof of Lemma 20
summary: We show that for every integer $n\geq 1$ there exists a graph $G_n$ with $(1+o(1))n$ vertices and $n^{1 + o(1)}$ edges such that every $n$-vertex planar graph is isomorphic to a subgraph of $G_n$. The best previous bound on the number of edges was $O(n^{3/2})$, proved by Babai, Chung, Erdős, Graham, and Spencer in 1982. We then show that for every integer $n\geq 1$ there is a graph $U_n$ with $n^{1 + o(1)}$ vertices and edges that contains induced copies of every $n$-vertex planar graph. This significantly reduces the number of edges in a recent construction of the authors with Dujmović, Gavoille, and Micek.
comment: v5: corrects an error in the proof of Lemma 20

title: On composition and decomposition operations for vector spaces, graphs and matroids
comments: Newer version titled "free products" (arXiv:2610.14111) has been uploaded
summary:
In this paper, we study the ideas of composition and decomposition in the context of vector spaces, graphs and matroids. For vector spaces $\V_{AB},$ treated as collection of row vectors, with specified column set $A\uplus B,$ we define $\V_{SP}\lrarv \V_{PQ}, S\cap Q= \emptyset, $ to be the collection of all vectors $(f_S,f_Q)$ such that $(f_S,f_P)\in \V_{SP}, (f_P,f_Q)\in \V_{PQ}$. An analogous operation $\G_{SP}\lrarg \G_{PQ}\equivd \G_{PQ}$ can be defined in relation to graphs $\G_{SP}, \G_{PQ},$ on edge sets $S\uplus P, P\uplus Q,$ respectively in terms of an overlapping subgraph $\G_P$ which gets deleted in the right side graph (see for instance the notion of $k-sum$ \cite{oxley}). For matroids we define the `linking' $\M_{SP}\lrarm \M_{PQ} \equivd (\M_{SP}\vee \M_{PQ})\times (S\uplus Q)$, denoting the contraction operation by '$\times$'. In each case, we examine how to minimize the size of the `overlap' set $P,$ without affecting the right side entity. In the case of vector spaces, there is a polynomial time algorithm for achieving the minimum, which we present. Similar ideas work for graphs and for matroids under appropriate conditions.
  Next we consider the problem of decomposition. Here, in the case of vector spaces, the problem is to decompose $\V_{SQ}$ as $\V_{SP}\lrarv \V_{PQ},$ with minimum size $P.$ We give a polynomial time algorithm for this purpose. In the case of graphs and matroids we give a solution to this problem under certain restrictions.
comment: Newer version titled "free products" (arXiv:2610.14111) has been uploaded

title: Noise-Aware Differentially Private Variational Inference
summary: Differential privacy (DP) provides robust privacy guarantees for statistical inference, but this can lead to unreliable results and biases in downstream applications. While several noise-aware approaches have been proposed which integrate DP perturbation into the inference, they are limited to specific types of simple probabilistic models. In this work, we propose a novel method for noise-aware approximate Bayesian inference based on stochastic gradient variational inference which can also be applied to high-dimensional and non-conjugate models. We also propose a more accurate evaluation method for noise-aware posteriors. Empirically, our inference method has similar performance to existing methods in the domain where they are applicable. Outside this domain, we obtain accurate coverages on high-dimensional Bayesian linear regression and well-calibrated predictive probabilities on Bayesian logistic regression with the UCI Adult dataset.

title: Congestion-Aware Charging Coordination for Electric Ride-Hailing Fleets under Stochastic Demand
summary: In this study, we develop a dynamic charging scheduling method that integrates day-ahead charging planning and online reactive vehicle dispatch and charger assignment. The day-ahead planning model minimizes expected charging costs by considering anticipated waiting times and overnight energy replenishment costs. The online model then adapts this plan by maximizing the profit from vehicle dispatching and assigning vehicles to chargers through a reservation-based charging request scheduler to minimize the total charging-related operational time. The developed charging policy is tested on a Manhattan-like study area using synthetic data drawn from NYC yellow taxi data with a fleet size of 100 vehicles given the scenarios of 3000 and 4000 customers/day. The computational results show that our method outperforms different benchmark policies with up to +21.68% profit and +22.22% service rate for 4000 customers relative to the weakest benchmark. Sensitivity analyses are conducted for different system parameters, and managerial insights are discussed.

title: Exploring the unleaved tree of numerical semigroups up to a given genus
summary: We present a new algorithm for exploring or counting the numerical semigroups of a given genus that uses the unleaved version of the tree of numerical semigroups. In the unleaved tree there are no leaves rather than the ones at depth equal to the genus in consideration. For exploring the unleaved tree we present a new encoding system of a numerical semigroup given by the gcd of its left elements and its shrinking, that is, the semigroup generated by its left elements divided by their gcd. We show a method to determine the right generators and strong generators of a semigroup by means of the gcd and the shrinking encoding, as well as a method to encode a semigroup from the encoding of its parent or of its preceding sibling. With the new algorithm, we obtained $n_{76}=29028294421710227$ and $n_{77}=47008818196495180$.

title: Split the Yield, Share the Risk: Pricing, Hedging and Fixed rates in DeFi
summary: We present the first formal treatment of \emph{yield tokenization}, a mechanism that decomposes yield-bearing assets into principal and yield components to facilitate risk transfer and price discovery in decentralized finance (DeFi). We propose a model that characterizes yield token dynamics using stochastic differential equations. We derive a no-arbitrage pricing framework for yield tokens, enabling their use in hedging future yield volatility and managing interest rate risk in decentralized lending pools. Taking DeFi lending as our focus, we show how both borrowers and lenders can use yield tokens to achieve optimal hedging outcomes and mitigate exposure to adversarial interest rate manipulation. Furthermore, we design automated market makers (AMMs) that incorporate a menu of bonding curves to aggregate liquidity from participants with heterogeneous risk preferences. This leads to an efficient and incentive-compatible mechanism for trading yield tokens and yield futures. Building on these foundations, we propose a modular \textit{fixed-rate} lending protocol that synthesizes on-chain yield token markets and lending pools, enabling robust interest rate discovery and enhancing capital efficiency. Our work provides the theoretical underpinnings for risk management and fixed-income infrastructure in DeFi, offering practical mechanisms for stable and sustainable yield markets.

title: Conjectured Bounds for 2-Local Hamiltonians via Token Graphs
comments: 47 pages, 2 figures v2: updated with Basu et al's proof of conjectures and added separation oracle to convex relaxations v3: updated with refutation of Conjecture 7
summary: We explain how the maximum energy of the Quantum MaxCut, XY, and EPR Hamiltonians on a graph $G$ are related to the spectral radii of the token graphs of $G$. From numerical study, we conjecture new bounds for these spectral radii based on properties of $G$. We show how these conjectures tighten the analysis of existing algorithms, implying state-of-the-art approximation ratios for all three Hamiltonians. Our conjectures also provide simple combinatorial bounds on the ground state energy of the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model, which we prove for bipartite graphs.
comment: 47 pages, 2 figures v2: updated with Basu et al's proof of conjectures and added separation oracle to convex relaxations v3: updated with refutation of Conjecture 7

title: State Space Models Naturally Produce Time Cell and Oscillatory Behaviors and Scale to Abstract Cognitive Functions
comments: Sen Lu and Xiaoyu Zhang contributed equally. Wei D. Lu is the corresponding author. 5 figures are included in 15 pages
summary: A grand challenge in modern neuroscience is bridging the gap between the microscale neural circuits and cognitive functions. While extensive knowledge exists about neuronal connectivity and biophysics, how low-level phenomena give rise to abstract behaviors remains largely unresolved. Here, we propose that a mathematical framework based on State Space Models offers mathematical sufficiency and computational plausibility to generate response profiles that resemble time cells, ramping activity, and oscillatory responses. Our results suggest that such behaviors can emerge from a structured multi-timescale complex rotational basis, which enables optimized history compression and naturally generates structured temporal dynamics even prior to training, mirroring recent findings in biological circuits. Learning exploits and adapts to the pre-existing temporal basis for specific tasks. We show that the model can readily scale to abstract cognitive functions such as event counting, supporting its use as a computationally tractable framework for understanding neural activities.

title: Computational Aspects of the Trace Norm Contraction Coefficient
comments: 35 pages, 2 figures; minor improvements and corrections. Computational model added. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Information Theory, DOI: 10.1109/TIT.2026.3743741
summary: We show that approximating the trace norm contraction coefficient of a quantum channel within a constant factor is NP-hard. Equivalently, this shows that determining the optimal success probability for encoding a bit in a quantum system undergoing noise is NP-hard. This contrasts with the classical analogue of this problem that can clearly be solved efficiently. We also establish the NP-hardness of deciding if the contraction coefficient is equal to 1, i.e., the channel can perfectly preserve a bit. As a consequence, deciding if a non-commutative graph has an independence number of at least 2 is NP-hard. In addition, we establish a converging hierarchy of semidefinite programming upper bounds on the contraction coefficient.
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures; minor improvements and corrections. Computational model added. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Information Theory, DOI: 10.1109/TIT.2026.3743741

title: Linearly Convergent Algorithms for Nonsmooth Problems with Unknown Smooth Regions
summary: We develop efficient algorithms for optimizing piecewise smooth (PWS) functions when their smooth regions are \emph{unknown} to the algorithm. For convex PWS functions satisfying a quadratic growth (QG) condition, we demonstrate that the bundle-level (BL)-type method~\cite{lemarechal1995new} achieves global linear convergence---to our knowledge, the first such result for any algorithm for this problem class. We extend the method to solve weakly convex PWS problems, achieving the same order of complexity as in smooth non-convex optimization. Furthermore, we introduce a verifiable and accurate termination criterion for PWS optimization. Like the gradient norm in smooth optimization, this certificate tightly characterizes the optimality gap under the QG condition and can be evaluated without knowledge of any problem parameters. We develop a search subroutine for this certificate and embed it within a guess-and-check framework, resulting in almost parameter-free algorithms for both convex QG and weakly convex PWS problems.

title: Rare Event Simulation of Quantum Error-Correcting Circuits
comments: Accepted on Sept 29, 2026 for publication in Quantum Journal; 15 pages, 15 figures; includes a new treatment of circuits with leakage noise and post-selection, added author contribution statement
summary: We describe a practical approach for accessing the logical failure rates of quantum error-correcting (QEC) circuits under low physical (component) failure rate regimes. Standard Monte Carlo is often the de facto approach for studying the failure rates of quantum circuits. However, in the study of fault-tolerant error-correcting circuits, the ability to extend this approach to low physical failure rates is limited. In particular, the use of Monte Carlo to access circuits that are relatively large or have high correcting power becomes more difficult as we lower the input failure rates of the individual components (gates) in the circuit. For these reasons, many simulations studying the circuit model go no lower than end-to-end logical failure rates in the 10^{-6} regime. In this report, we outline an approach that borrows from earlier work by Bravyi and Vargo to the more complex circuit noise model. Earlier works studied both the capacity and phenomenological noise models, but the work is insufficient for generating similar simulations in the circuit-noise model. To the best of our knowledge, our team is the first to develop a full prescription of the rare event simulation by splitting technique for the circuit-based noise model. We have also generated promising results that are confirmed by standard Monte Carlo simulation under an accessible regime. This work shows that we can access noise in the circuit-model prescription of quantum error-correcting code to failure rates below 10^{-20} regime.

title: Generalized Multi-agent Social Simulation Framework
summary: Multi-agent social interaction has clearly benefited from Large Language Models. However, current simulation systems still face challenges such as difficulties in scaling to diverse scenarios and poor reusability due to a lack of modular design. To address these issues, we designed and developed a modular, object-oriented framework that organically integrates various base classes through a hierarchical structure, harvesting scalability and reusability. We inherited the framework to realize common derived classes. Additionally, a memory summarization mechanism is proposed to filter and distill relevant information from raw memory data, prioritizing contextually salient events and interactions. By selecting and combining some necessary derived classes, we customized a specific simulated environment. Utilizing this simulated environment, we successfully simulated human interactions on social media, replicating real-world online social behaviors. The source code for the project will be released and evolve.

title: When is a System Discoverable from Data? Discovery Requires Chaos
comments: Newest version contains complete discoverability classification
summary: The deep learning revolution has enabled major AI advances in physical sciences, particularly in discovering dynamical systems from observational data. Yet the reliability of learned surrogates and symbolically discovered models is often undermined by non-uniqueness: models may fit observed trajectories perfectly, but lack genuine predictive power. We show that chaos, despite its association with unpredictability, is often what makes governing equations discoverable. We prove that the classical Lorenz system is analytically discoverable and verify experimentally that for many systems out-of-domain generalization emerges precisely at chaos onset. Conservative systems, by contrast, are inherently non-discoverable from data alone. The prevalence of chaotic systems in benchmarks may have inadvertently obscured this limitation. These findings help explain why AI excels at weather forecasting, yet struggles in many engineering applications: the systems most amenable to discovery (chaotic ones) are often least amenable to control.
comment: Newest version contains complete discoverability classification

title: VEDA: Generation of 3D Molecules via Variance-Exploding Diffusion with Annealing
summary: Diffusion models show promise for 3D molecular generation, but face a fundamental trade-off between sampling efficiency and conformational accuracy. While flow-based models are fast, they often produce geometrically inaccurate structures, as they have difficulty capturing the multimodal distributions of molecular conformations. In contrast, denoising diffusion models are more accurate but suffer from slow sampling, a limitation attributed to sub-optimal integration between diffusion dynamics and SE(3)-equivariant architectures. To address this, we propose VEDA, a unified SE(3)-equivariant framework that combines variance-exploding diffusion with annealing to efficiently generate conformationally accurate 3D molecular structures. Specifically, our key technical contributions include: (1) a VE schedule that enables noise injection functionally analogous to simulated annealing, improving 3D accuracy and reducing relaxation energy; (2) a novel preconditioning scheme that reconciles the coordinate-predicting nature of SE(3)-equivariant networks with a residual-based diffusion objective, and (3) a new arcsin-based scheduler that concentrates sampling in critical intervals of the logarithmic signal-to-noise ratio. On the QM9 and GEOM-DRUGS datasets, VEDA matches the sampling efficiency of flow-based models, achieving state-of-the-art valency stability and validity with only 100 sampling steps. More importantly, VEDA's generated structures are remarkably stable, as measured by their relaxation energy during GFN2-xTB optimization. The median energy change is only 1.72 kcal/mol, significantly lower than the 32.3 kcal/mol from its architectural baseline, SemlaFlow. Our framework demonstrates that principled integration of VE diffusion with SE(3)-equivariant architectures can achieve both high chemical accuracy and computational efficiency.

title: Fundamental Limitations of QAOA on Constrained Problems and a Route to Exponential Enhancement
comments: Substantially revised manuscript. New high-probability feasibility bounds for TSP/ATSP ensembles, including uniform mixer-angle control and a linear-depth extension for linked cost-angle schedules. Added transition-feature analysis, adaptive sampling consequences, and an exponential CE-QAOA separation. Discussion and conclusion rewritten
summary: We study the feasibility limitations of generic QAOA for permutation-constrained optimization, where valid configurations occupy an exponentially small fraction of the Boolean hypercube. Using random edge-cost TSP/ATSP ensembles, we establish high-probability bounds showing that optimized generic QAOA retains exponentially small feasible probability over specified parameter domains. At depth one, the bound holds uniformly over all mixer angles and a cost-angle grid that may be exponentially large in n^2. The analysis combines Walsh-Fourier/Krawtchouk estimates, which suppress low- and high-degree contributions, with transition-feature collision bounds controlling objective-dependent interference. Complementary cost-angle averaging, fourth-moment estimates, and light-cone analysis characterize energy-fibre coherence, typical-angle concentration, and constraint-correlation geometry. We compare generic QAOA with a constraint-enhanced kernel (CE-QAOA) initialized in a product one-hot subspace and evolved with a block-local XY mixer. For N = n^2 binary variables, CE-QAOA attains feasible probability at least n!/n^n at every depth, yielding an exp[Omega(n^2)] advantage over optimized generic QAOA at depth one with high probability. For linked cost-angle schedules with independently optimized mixer angles, the generic feasibility obstruction and exponential CE-QAOA separation extend throughout linear-depth windows p <= alpha*n, for fixed alpha > 0. These parameter-uniform bounds also imply exponential raw-sample requirements for adaptive feasible sampling within the prescribed domains.

title: What If They Took the Shot? A Hierarchical Bayesian Framework for Counterfactual Expected Goals
summary: How would the probability of scoring change if a different player took the same shot? Although expected goals models describe the difficulty of scoring opportunities, comparing players on identical chances requires accounting for uncertainty in their estimated conversion probabilities. We address this question through a hierarchical Bayesian framework that evaluates alternative shooters under the same observed circumstances. Using 35,700 eligible shots from four leagues during the 2015/16 season, we compare a contextual benchmark with a primary player-intercept model and a provisional extension that allows player differences to vary with shooting conditions. Paired posterior draws preserve shared uncertainty when individual probability differences are aggregated across opportunities. Chronological validation demonstrates improved predictive performance relative to a constant-rate baseline, but introducing player effects provides negligible additional gains. Controlled single-seed experiments show that greater information per player improves estimation accuracy and narrows uncertainty intervals, although distinguishing small differences remains difficult and confident conclusions about near-null effects can become more frequent. Applications involving Giroud--Vardy and Berardi--Sansone similarly yield estimated differences that are small relative to their posterior uncertainty. These findings highlight an important distinction between predicting the outcome of a shot and establishing whether one player would be more likely to convert it. The proposed framework makes this distinction explicit by evaluating alternative shooters on fixed recorded opportunities while accounting for their contextual exposure. The resulting comparisons concern conditional conversion rather than the causal consequences of replacing a player in a match.

title: Tracking large chemical reaction networks and rare events by neural networks
summary: Chemical reaction networks are widely used to model stochastic dynamics in biophysical processes. Their exact probabilistic description via the chemical master equation becomes intractable for high-dimensional systems due to the exponential growth of the state space. This difficulty is further exacerbated when metastable transitions and rare events dominate the dynamics. Here, we present an advanced neural-network approach that effectively tackles large reaction networks and rare-event dynamics within a unified framework. Building on autoregressive representations of the full joint probability distribution, we achieve efficient training through second-order optimization methods, including natural gradient descent and the time-dependent variational principle. We leverage enhanced-sampling strategies that enable accurate resolution of low-probability regions governing rare transitions. We demonstrate the method on a multistable genetic toggle switch and a mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) cascade consisting of 16 species and 35 reactions with dense coupling. We further quantify rare events in spatially extended Schlögl models in both one- and two-dimensional lattices, reaching system sizes with extremely large state spaces up to $3\times10^{15}$. These results highlight the potential of neural modeling as a flexible and scalable framework for studying high-dimensional chemical reaction networks and rare events.

title: Imaging-anchored Multiomics in Cardiovascular Disease: Integrating Cardiac Imaging, Bulk, Single-cell, and Spatial Transcriptomics
comments: The authors are withdrawing this version of the preprint to incorporate extensive updates, refine the multi-modal fusion pipelines, and expand the evaluation benchmarks for cardiac imaging and spatial transcriptomics integration. A revised and updated version will be resubmitted shortly
summary: Cardiovascular disease arises from interactions between inherited risk, molecular programmes, and tissue-scale remodelling that are observed clinically through imaging. Health systems now routinely generate large volumes of cardiac MRI, CT and echocardiography together with bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, yet these data are still analysed in separate pipelines. This review examines joint representations that link cardiac imaging phenotypes to transcriptomic and spatially resolved molecular states. An imaging-anchored perspective is adopted in which echocardiography, cardiac MRI and CT define a spatial phenotype of the heart, and bulk, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics provide cell-type- and location-specific molecular context. The biological and technical characteristics of these modalities are first summarised, and representation-learning strategies for each are outlined. Multimodal fusion approaches are reviewed, with emphasis on handling missing data, limited sample size, and batch effects. Finally, integrative pipelines for radiogenomics, spatial molecular alignment, and image-based prediction of gene expression are discussed, together with common failure modes, practical considerations, and open challenges. Spatial multiomics of human myocardium and atherosclerotic plaque, single-cell and spatial foundation models, and multimodal medical foundation models are collectively bringing imaging-anchored multiomics closer to large-scale cardiovascular translation.

title: Beyond Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Accelerators: Directed Evidence for Adaptive Sustainability Portfolios
comments: 28 pages, 5 figures; supplementary information (Tables S1-S9, Figures S1-S2) included as ancillary file. Code and data: see Open Research statement in the paper
summary: Governments and development partners often seek Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) "accelerators" whose progress can propagate gains across human well-being, institutions, resources, and environmental priorities. Such claims require evidence on direction, timing, robustness, and trade-offs, not only network connectivity. We map directed SDG interdependence using a balanced panel of 114 countries observed annually from 2000 to 2024. Because the goal series are persistent, trending, and cross-sectionally dependent, we combine Dumitrescu-Hurlin panel Granger non-causality tests on first-differenced series with false-discovery control across 272 directed goal pairs, and panel local projections with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors for 31 theory-derived indicator linkages. We find 84 directed linkages after correction: 40 synergies and 44 trade-offs. This dense structure does not support a universal accelerator. Driver-receiver rankings are fragile across lag orders, centrality metrics, bootstrap resampling, and alternative dependence controls; only peace and strong institutions as a net receiver and poverty reduction as an effect-size-weighted driver are distinguishable in the bootstrap screen. Two local-projection pathways are supported, both leading to lower child mortality, and the education-child-health association is corroborated in independent World Development Indicators data across 183 countries. The policy implication is not to abandon SDG integration, but to replace fixed global accelerator rankings with adaptive portfolios built around supported, time-lagged linkages and monitored constituent indicators.

title: Is Flow Matching Just Trajectory Replay for Sequential Data?
summary: Flow matching (FM) is increasingly used in scientific domains for time series generation and forecasting, where data often arise from underlying dynamical systems. However, it is not well-understood whether it learns transferable dynamical structure or simply performs an effective ''trajectory replay''. We study this question by deriving the optimal velocity field targeted by the empirical FM objective on sequential data. For the Gaussian conditional paths commonly used in practice, we show that the resulting sampler is an ODE whose dynamics describe a nonparametric, memory-augmented continuous-time dynamical system. The driving velocity field admits a closed-form expression as a weighted mixture of instantaneous velocities determined by observed transitions. This characterization provides an interpretable view of neural FM models as parametric estimation of an underlying nonparametric target and naturally leads to FreeFM: a closed-form, training-free realization of this target. FreeFM provides a transparent reference for studying sequential FM while yielding effective probabilistic forecasts directly from historical transitions.

title: Minimax Binary Counting under Shuffle Privacy: Poisson Limits and Randomized-Response Optimality
comments: 39 pages, 1 figure. v2: complete revision with a new title and scope; it replaces v1 entirely. The two-dominant hybrid argument of v1 is withdrawn (see the Introduction). Ancillary files contain the certificate scripts for Proposition 10.1
summary: We study estimation of a deterministic binary count from the shuffled outputs of a common single-message local channel. Privacy is required for every neighboring composition at fixed global parameters $(\varepsilon,δ)$, and estimators may be biased. We obtain uniform critical Poisson and Skellam approximations and characterize the limiting minimax risk as an infimum over finite observed-mark Poisson experiments. Let $Λ$ be the noise intensity required by the boundary Poisson-shift profile and let $λ_{\min}$ be the intensity required by the full composition-maximized randomized-response profile. Binary randomized response is asymptotically minimax optimal if and only if $Λ=λ_{\min}$. When $Λ<λ_{\min}$, the minimax value lies strictly between $(Λ+λ_{\min})/2$ and $λ_{\min}$, and a randomized-response construction with observed rare marks strictly improves on binary randomized response. We give a finite-sample certified example. Binary randomized response is strictly suboptimal at $\varepsilon=0$ for every $0<δ<1$, and this persists for sufficiently small positive $\varepsilon$ at each fixed target. For every fixed positive $\varepsilon$, strict suboptimality also occurs along a sequence of fixed privacy targets tending to zero. The variational characterization permits approximation by finite marked channels; it does not assert that a finite optimizer exists.
comment: 39 pages, 1 figure. v2: complete revision with a new title and scope; it replaces v1 entirely. The two-dominant hybrid argument of v1 is withdrawn (see the Introduction). Ancillary files contain the certificate scripts for Proposition 10.1

title: Sharp Statistical Thresholds for Attributed Gaussian Graph Matching
summary: We investigate the problem of matching networks where both edge weights and node features are correlated following a specific node correspondence. While prior work has established sharp thresholds for matching either graphs or features individually, the joint setting has been significantly less explored. In this study, we derive precise information-theoretic thresholds for exact recovery, almost-exact recovery, and partial recovery of the underlying alignment. These are expressed in terms of graph and feature correlation strengths, the number of nodes, and the dimension of the features. Interestingly, whereas an all-or-nothing phase transition is observed in the standard graph-matching scenario, the inclusion of contextual information at the node level introduces a richer structure: the exact-recovery threshold separates from the shared threshold for almost-exact and partial recovery. Closing gaps left by prior works, we provide a sharp characterization of the thresholds governing how structural and contextual information interact in graph matching, and thereby establish a benchmark for designing efficient algorithms in the high-dimensional setting.

title: Dictionary learning for Kernel EDMD
summary:
Studying nonlinear dynamical systems through their state space behavior can be challenging, and one possible alternative is to analyze them via their associated Koopman operator. This turns the nonlinear problem into a linear, infinite-dimensional one. To approximate the operator in finite dimensions, extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) is a commonly used algorithm. It requires a finite list of functionals and a set of snapshots from the system to compute an approximation of the operator and its corresponding spectrum. Instead of choosing the list of functionals directly, it can be implicitly defined via kernels, a method known as kernel extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). However, one still needs to define the kernel and choose its parameter values.
  In this paper, we aim to streamline this process by extending dictionary learning for EDMD to kernel learning in kEDMD. By simplifying kEDMD, we show how to perform gradient-based optimization over the learnable kernel parameters and demonstrate that this method leads to useful kernels for the original kEDMD. The focus of our work is a method that takes a weighted list of kernels with randomly initialized values as input and outputs a list of kernels and parameter values suitable for approximating the Koopman operator of the underlying system. We demonstrate that unimportant kernels can be removed from the list by analyzing the weights in the weighted sum. We evaluate the method across several experiments, including the Duffing oscillator and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, showcasing the method's different strengths.

title: The power of unentanglement without destructive interference
comments: 85 pages, 2 figures, 7 protocols, and 2 algorithms. Abstract shortened due to the arXiv length restriction. v3: Minor changes, to appear in SODA 2027. v2: Added the results that StoqMA(k)_log is in MA and StoqMA_log = BPP, and made minor changes
summary:
Stoquasticity, originating in sign-problem-free physical systems, gives rise to $\sf StoqMA$, introduced by Bravyi, Bessen, and Terhal (2006), a quantum-inspired intermediate class between $\sf MA$ and $\sf AM$. Unentanglement similarly gives rise to ${\sf QMA}(2)$, introduced by Kobayashi, Matsumoto, and Yamakami (CJTCS 2009), which generalizes $\sf QMA$ to two unentangled proofs and still has only the trivial $\sf NEXP$ upper bound. In this work, we initiate a systematic study of the power of unentanglement without destructive interference via ${\sf StoqMA}(2)$, the class of unentangled stoquastic Merlin--Arthur proof systems. Beyond its complexity-theoretic interest, ${\sf StoqMA}(2)$ is connected to the optimality of non-negative tensor optimization algorithms. We highlight:
  1. ${\sf NP} \subseteq {\sf StoqMA}(2)$ with $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{n})$-qubit proofs and completenes $1-2^{-{\rm polylog}(n)}$. Conversely, the Sum-of-Squares algorithm of Barak, Kelner, and Steurer (STOC 2014) gives an exponential-time upper bound for ${\sf StoqMA}(2)$. Our tightened analysis shows the optimality of our protocol and the BKS algorithm under ETH.
  2. For logarithmic-size proofs, ${\sf NP} \subseteq {\sf StoqMA}(2)_{\log}$ with completeness $1-O(n^{-2})$ and vanishing gap, while ${\sf StoqMA}(2)_{\log} \subseteq {\sf MA}$. Consequently, quantum-inspired randomness enables exponentially shorter unentangled proofs even under the assumption ${\sf MA}={\sf NP}$.
  3. For ${\sf StoqMA}(2)_1$, the parameter dependence in the general ETH-optimal time bound can be exponentially improved, or the bound achieved simultaneously with polynomial space.
  Our lower bounds are obtained by stoquastizing the short-proof ${\sf QMA}(2)$ protocols using distribution testing techniques. Our upper bounds for the nearly perfect completeness case are proved via our rectangular closure testing framework.
comment: 85 pages, 2 figures, 7 protocols, and 2 algorithms. Abstract shortened due to the arXiv length restriction. v3: Minor changes, to appear in SODA 2027. v2: Added the results that StoqMA(k)_log is in MA and StoqMA_log = BPP, and made minor changes

title: Sequential vs. Synchronized Entanglement Swapping: QKD Secret-Key Rate under Optimized Link-Layer Control
summary: Quantum repeater chains build long-distance entanglement for quantum key distribution (QKD) by creating pairs on short links and joining them through entanglement swapping. Because stored pairs lose fidelity while they wait, swap timing can affect the secret-key rate. We study how network-layer swap scheduling affects six-state QKD on a simulated four-hop chain under an idealized Werner-state noise model. We compare a sequential (swap-and-wait) discipline, which builds and stores partial chains, with a synchronized (wait-and-swap) discipline, which waits until all links are ready before swapping. Both use the same reinforcement-learned link controllers, isolating the effect of the swapping discipline. When stored pairs cannot retain sufficient fidelity for one network time step, our sequential implementation produces no key, while synchronized retains a small key rate from simultaneous link deliveries. Once sequential becomes viable, it outperforms synchronized by up to 19.1% in the homogeneous chains studied, with the advantage decreasing as memory lifetime increases. We predict the synchronized short-memory pair-delivery rate from link-delivery statistics and derive a closed-form condition for when sequential can preserve progress across time steps. We also examine chains with one slower link, where partial chains can wait and decay at the bottleneck. In this setting, synchronized slightly outperforms sequential at longer memory lifetimes. Moving the slow link has little effect on key rate away from the transition region but strongly affects sequential link-buffer occupancy. Choosing a swapping discipline therefore depends not only on whether memories can preserve partial progress, but also on how the link configuration determines where that progress must wait and decay.

title: A proximal gradient algorithm for composite log-concave sampling
summary: We propose an algorithm to sample from composite log-concave distributions over $\mathbb{R}^d$, i.e., densities of the form $π\propto e^{-f-g}$, assuming access to gradient evaluations of $α_f$-convex $f$ and a restricted Gaussian oracle (RGO) for $α_g$-convex $g$, where $α_g \ge 0$. The latter requirement means that we can easily sample from the density $\text{RGO}_{g,h,y}(x) \propto \exp(-g(x) -\frac{1}{2h}||y-x||^2)$, which is the sampling analogue of the proximal operator for $g$. If $f + g$ is $α$-convex and $f$ is $β$-smooth, our sampler achieves $\varepsilon$ error in total variation distance using $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(κ\sqrt d \log^4(1/\varepsilon))$ oracle calls where $κ:= 1 \vee β/α$, with $0\le α_g \le β$ and $α:= α_f + α_g > 0$, which matches prior state-of-the-art results for the case $g=0$. We further extend our results to cases where (1) $π$ is non-log-concave but satisfies a Poincaré or log-Sobolev inequality, and (2) $f$ is non-smooth but Lipschitz.

title: UPSim: UxNB Propagation Simulator for 3D Map-Driven FR3 Deployments
summary: We introduce UPSim (UxNB Propagation Simulator), an open-source, Ray Tracing-calibrated solution for spatially consistent FR3 (16.95 GHz) air-to-ground propagation modeling in Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks. Instead of executing point-to-point ray launches for every ground position, UPSim derives deterministic visibility regions directly from global 3D building geometry (3D-GloBFP) via fast shadow projection. It then augments these regions with Line-of-Sight (LOS) state-specific, UAV height- and distance-dependent path loss, spatially correlated large-scale fading, and log-logistic small-scale fading parameterized by over 136 million Ray Tracing (RT) channels. Validation against reference RT data demonstrates that UPSim accurately reproduces empirical attenuation maps, outperforming the 3GPP baseline by reducing the aggregate Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance from 0.33 to 0.04. The resulting maps enable route-based analysis of channel evolution in complex urban layouts, capturing critical trajectory-level metrics such as spatial outage persistence. Consequently, UPSim provides a highly scalable, open-source middle ground between computationally expensive full RT and purely stochastic models for mobility-aware 6G aerial network planning.

AI.title_translation: UPSim: 3D地图驱动的FR3部署的UxNB传播模拟器
AI.tldr: UPSim是一个开源的、射线追踪校准的模拟器，用于FR3无人机网络传播，利用3D地图快速准确地生成衰减图，性能优于3GPP基线，并支持可扩展的6G网络规划。
AI.motivation: 解决无人机网络中空间一致的FR3空对地传播建模问题，提供一个介于计算成本高昂的全射线追踪和纯随机模型之间的高可扩展性、开源解决方案，用于移动感知的6G空中网络规划。
AI.method: UPSim通过快速阴影投影直接从全局3D建筑几何（3D-GloBFP）推导出确定性可见区域，而不是执行点对点射线发射。然后，它利用LOS状态特定、无人机高度和距离相关的路径损耗、空间相关的大尺度衰落以及由超过1.36亿个射线追踪（RT）信道参数化的对数逻辑小尺度衰落来增强这些区域。
AI.result: 与参考RT数据验证表明，UPSim准确重现了经验衰减图，通过将聚合Kolmogorov-Smirnov距离从0.33降低到0.04，优于3GPP基线。生成的地图支持复杂城市布局中信道演变的基于路由分析，捕获了空间中断持久性等关键轨迹级指标。
AI.conclusion: UPSim为移动感知的6G空中网络规划提供了一个高可扩展的开源中间解决方案，介于计算成本高昂的全射线追踪和纯随机模型之间。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了UPSim（UxNB传播模拟器），这是一个开源的、射线追踪校准的解决方案，用于在无人机（UAV）网络中进行空间一致的FR3（16.95 GHz）空对地传播建模。UPSim不是为每个地面位置执行点对点射线发射，而是通过快速阴影投影直接从全局3D建筑几何（3D-GloBFP）推导出确定性可见区域。然后，它利用LOS（视距）状态特定、无人机高度和距离相关的路径损耗、空间相关的大尺度衰落以及由超过1.36亿个射线追踪（RT）信道参数化的对数逻辑小尺度衰落来增强这些区域。与参考RT数据验证表明，UPSim准确重现了经验衰减图，通过将聚合Kolmogorov-Smirnov距离从0.33降低到0.04，优于3GPP基线。生成的地图支持复杂城市布局中信道演变的基于路由分析，捕获了空间中断持久性等关键轨迹级指标。因此，UPSim为移动感知的6G空中网络规划提供了一个高可扩展的开源中间解决方案，介于计算成本高昂的全RT和纯随机模型之间。
AI.summary: UPSim是一个开源的、射线追踪校准的模拟器，用于无人机网络中的FR3空对地传播。它通过利用3D建筑几何和快速阴影投影，结合由大量RT数据参数化的详细衰落模型，高效生成空间一致的衰减图。UPSim准确重现了经验衰减，显著优于3GPP基线，并为6G空中网络规划提供了一个可扩展的解决方案，弥合了全RT和随机模型之间的鸿沟。
AI.keywords: UxNB传播模拟器, 射线追踪, FR3, 无人机网络, 6G空中网络规划, 3D地图驱动
AI.comments: 这篇论文介绍了UPSim，这是一种创新的传播模拟器，它在全射线追踪的高精度和大规模网络规划所需的计算效率之间取得了实用平衡。其主要创新在于利用3D建筑几何的快速阴影投影来定义可见区域，与传统射线追踪相比，这显著降低了计算负荷，同时仍结合了详细的、RT校准的衰落模型。其开源性质以及相对于3GPP基线所展示的卓越性能，使其成为未来6G空中网络部署的宝贵工具。它能够捕获轨迹级指标对于移动无人机场景尤为重要。

title: Symmetry-Compatible Principle for Optimizer Design: Embeddings, LM Heads, SwiGLU MLPs, and MoE Routers
summary: A striking geometric disparity has long persisted in the practice of deep learning. While modern neural network architectures naturally exhibit rich symmetry and equivariance properties, popular optimizers such as Adam and its variants operate inherently coordinate-wise, rendering them unable to respect the equivariance structures of the parameter space. We address this disparity by introducing a symmetry-compatible principle for optimizer design: the gradient update rule should be equivariant under the symmetry group acting on the corresponding weight block. Following this principle, we first provide a unified perspective on bi-orthogonally equivariant updates for general matrix layers, as employed by stochastic spectral descent, Muon, Scion, and polar gradient methods. More importantly, by moving from orthogonal groups to permutation and shared-shift symmetries, we derive symmetry-compatible optimizers for parameter blocks whose symmetries differ from those of general matrix layers: embedding and LM head matrices, SwiGLU MLP projections, and MoE router matrices. These constructions include one-sided spectral, row-norm, hybrid row-norm/spectral, row-aware, column-aware, centered row-norm, and left-spectral updates. They yield an end-to-end layerwise optimizer stack in which each major matrix-valued parameter class is assigned an update whose equivariance matches its symmetry group. We corroborate this principle through pre-training experiments on dense and sparse MoE language models, including Qwen3-0.6B-style, Gemma 3 1B-style, OLMoE-1B-7B-style, and downsized gpt-oss architectures. Across these experiments, symmetry-compatible update rules consistently improve final validation loss, reduce expert load imbalance in sparse MoE models, and in several cases control final vocabulary-logit growth, improve router stability, and overall training stability over the corresponding AdamW updates.

AI.title_translation: 优化器设计的对称兼容原则：嵌入层、语言模型头、SwiGLU MLP 与 MoE 路由器
AI.tldr: 本文提出对称兼容原则，为大语言模型中具有不同对称性的参数块（如Embedding、LM Head、SwiGLU、MoE Router）定制等变更新规则，在预训练中全面超越AdamW。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络具有丰富的对称性与等变结构，但主流优化器（如Adam及其变体）主要基于逐坐标操作，无法遵循参数空间的等变性，造成了几何结构上的脱节。
AI.method: 提出“对称兼容原则”，要求优化器的更新规则在对应参数块的对称群作用下保持等变。研究拓展了传统的双正交群更新，进一步引入置换与共享平移对称性，针对Embedding、LM Head、SwiGLU MLP和MoE Router等模块推导了单侧谱、行范数、混合行范数/谱、行/列感知、中心化行范数及左谱等特定更新规则，构建了一套端到端的层级化优化器栈。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-0.6B风格、Gemma 3 1B风格、OLMoE-1B-7B风格及降采样gpt-oss等稠密与稀疏MoE架构的预训练实验中，该方法持续降低了最终验证损失，缓解了MoE专家负载不平衡，并在多项设置中抑制了词表logit增长、增强了路由器及全局训练的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过让梯度更新规则严格匹配各权重块的几何对称群（对称兼容原则），可以有效消除优化器与模型参数之间的几何不匹配，显著提升大语言模型预训练的泛化表现与训练稳定性，优于传统AdamW。
AI.translation: 在深度学习实践中，长期存在着显著的几何差异：现代神经网络架构天然具有丰富的对称性和等变性，但常用的优化器（如Adam及其变体）在本质上是按坐标独立操作的，无法遵循参数空间的等变结构。为此，我们提出了优化器设计的对称兼容原则：梯度更新规则在作用于对应权重块的对称群下应保持等变。依据该原则，我们首先对通用矩阵层采用的双正交等变更新（如随机谱下降、Muon、Scion和极分解梯度方法）提供了统一视角；更重要的是，通过从正交群拓展至置换和共享平移对称性，我们为具有非通用矩阵对称性的参数块推导出了对称兼容优化器，包括嵌入层和LM头矩阵、SwiGLU MLP投影以及MoE路由器矩阵。这些设计涵盖单侧谱、行范数、混合行范数/谱、行感知、列感知、中心化行范数以及左谱更新，构成了一个端到端的逐层优化器栈，使每个主要矩阵参数类别都分配有与其对称群匹配的更新。我们在稠密和稀疏MoE语言模型（涵盖Qwen3-0.6B风格、Gemma 3 1B风格、OLMoE-1B-7B风格以及缩减版gpt-oss架构）的预训练实验中验证了该原则。跨实验结果表明，相比对应的AdamW更新，对称兼容更新规则持续改善了最终验证损失，降低了稀疏MoE模型中的专家负载不均衡，并在多数情况下有效抑制了最终词表logit增长，提升了路由器稳定性和整体训练稳定性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了优化器设计的“对称兼容原则”，主张参数更新应与其对称群保持等变。作者为Embedding、LM Head、SwiGLU MLP与MoE Router等参数模块量身定制了多种对称兼容更新规则，并在多个主流稠密和MoE架构预训练中取得了优于AdamW的损失表现和训练稳定性。
AI.keywords: 对称兼容原则, 优化器设计, 等变性, 混合专家模型, 预训练
AI.comments: 该研究针对当前大模型优化领域的一个关键理论与实践痛点，系统性地揭示了现代神经网络参数结构的对称群与经典坐标式优化器（如Adam）之间的几何失配。作者没有局限于通用矩阵的谱更新（如近期热门的Muon），而是前瞻性地将对称兼容原则推广到Embedding、LM Head、SwiGLU及MoE Router等特殊参数块，形成了细粒度的层级优化方案。在多种前沿开源模型架构上的预训练收益和稳定性改进，证明了在优化器设计中结合参数几何先验的巨大潜力。

title: Spanning-Tree Maximization Forces Isoperimetry in the Square Lattice
summary: We determine which connected sets of $N$ vertices in the square lattice support the most spanning trees, using all lattice edges between the chosen vertices. Every maximizer minimizes the number of edges joining the set to the rest of the lattice. Its shape is a rectangle with at most two straight strips of vertices removed at opposite corners. For $N\ge18$, the maximizer is unique up to translation, rotation, and reflection: an explicitly determined rectangle with one possibly empty corner strip removed along its longer side. The proof combines comparisons of Laplacian determinants with geometric comparisons of corner deletions. For $N=n^2$, we prove a sharp stability inequality that bounds the symmetric difference from a translated $n\times n$ square in terms of the loss in logarithmic tree count. Thus, nearly optimal tree counts force the vertex set to be close to a square. We also derive an exact product formula and a recurrence for the number of spanning trees in rectangles with a single corner strip removed.

AI.title_translation: 方格图中最大生成树强制等周性
AI.tldr: 该研究确定了方格图中支持最多生成树的连通顶点集，发现这些集具有等周性，形状接近矩形且边界边数最少。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在确定方格图中哪些包含N个顶点的连通集能支持最多的生成树，并理解这些集合的几何特性。
AI.method: 证明结合了拉普拉斯行列式的比较和角部删除的几何比较。研究还推导了移除了单个角条的矩形中生成树数量的精确乘积公式和递归关系。
AI.result: 最大化器使连接该集合与格图其余部分的边数最小化。其形状是一个矩形，最多在对角移除两个直条状的顶点。对于N≥18，最大化器在平移、旋转和反射下是唯一的，是一个明确确定的矩形，沿其长边可能移除一个空的角条。对于N=n^2，证明了一个尖锐的稳定性不等式，表明接近最优的树计数强制顶点集接近正方形。此外，还推导出了移除了单个角条的矩形中生成树数量的精确乘积公式和递归关系。
AI.conclusion: 在方格图中最大化生成树的数量，会强制连通顶点集具有等周性，具体表现为最小化其与格图其余部分的边界，并呈现出近似矩形的形状。
AI.translation: 我们确定了方格图中哪些N个顶点的连通集，在使用所选顶点之间的所有格边时，能支持最多的生成树。每个最大化器都使连接该集合与格图其余部分的边数最小化。其形状是一个矩形，最多在对角移除两个直条状的顶点。对于N≥18，最大化器在平移、旋转和反射下是唯一的：一个明确确定的矩形，沿其长边可能移除一个空的角条。证明结合了拉普拉斯行列式的比较和角删除的几何比较。对于N=n^2，我们证明了一个尖锐的稳定性不等式，该不等式根据对数树计数的损失，限制了与平移的n×n正方形的对称差。因此，接近最优的树计数强制顶点集接近正方形。我们还推导出了一个精确的乘积公式和一个递归关系，用于计算移除了单个角条的矩形中的生成树数量。
AI.summary: 本文研究了方格图中支持最多生成树的N个连通顶点集。研究发现，这些最大化器以最小化边界边数为特征，并通常形成带有特定角部移除的矩形形状。对于N≥18，最大化器是唯一的。该研究结合了拉普拉斯行列式比较和几何分析，对于N=n^2，建立了稳定性不等式，表明接近最优的树计数意味着形状接近正方形。此外，还推导了特定矩形形状中生成树数量的公式。
AI.keywords: 生成树, 方格图, 等周性, 拉普拉斯行列式, 图论
AI.comments: 该论文通过将生成树最大化与方格图中的等周性联系起来，在图论和组合学领域做出了重要贡献。对于N≥18的唯一性结果和稳定性不等式尤其具有创新性，为最大化生成树所诱导的几何特性提供了深刻见解。拉普拉斯行列式的使用是该领域中一种标准而强大的技术。

title: On Constructing and Decoding Quantum Triorthogonal Codes
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. v3: Added the proof of Theorem 2 (Appendix A)
summary: Triorthogonal codes are a basic ingredient in magic-state distillation, as they enable transversal implementation of logical $\mathsf{T}$ gates. As a non-Clifford operation, the $\mathsf{T}$ gate enables universal fault-tolerant quantum computation when combined with Clifford operations. We derive an existence criterion for even-weight triorthogonal generator matrices with a target dual minimum distance. The criterion combines triorthogonality constraints with MacWilliams identities via Krawtchouk-polynomial conditions on the dual weight distribution, yielding an integer linear programming formulation for the construction problem. We find novel nontrivial triorthogonal codes (degenerate and non-degenerate) that are not necessarily constructed from triply even binary linear codes. By imposing automorphism-group constraints, the formulation also recovers the known [[49,1,5]] and [[95,1,7]] triorthogonal codes. We also evaluate the performance of the obtained high-distance triorthogonal codes over the dephasing channel using different decoding methods, showing that automorphism ensemble decoding (AED) and guessing random additive-noise decoding (GRAND) are promising options.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. v3: Added the proof of Theorem 2 (Appendix A)

AI.title_translation: 关于构建和解码量子三正交码
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种构建具有目标对偶最小距离的偶权三正交生成矩阵的存在准则，并利用整数线性规划和自同构群约束发现了新的三正交码。此外，还评估了这些码在退相干信道上的解码性能，发现自同构集成解码（AED）和猜测随机加性噪声解码（GRAND）是有效的方法。
AI.motivation: 三正交码是魔术态蒸馏中的基本组成部分，因为它们能够横向实现逻辑 T 门。T 门作为一种非 Clifford 操作，与 Clifford 操作结合使用时，能够实现通用的容错量子计算。
AI.method: 研究通过将三正交约束与 MacWilliams 恒等式结合，利用对偶权重分布上的 Krawtchouk 多项式条件，推导出了偶权三正交生成矩阵的存在准则，并将其转化为整数线性规划问题。通过施加自同构群约束，该方法也能恢复已知的代码。此外，研究还评估了不同解码方法在退相干信道上对高距离三正交码的性能。
AI.result: 研究发现了新的非平凡三正交码（简并和非简并），这些码不一定由三重偶数二进制线性码构成。通过该公式也恢复了已知的 [[49,1,5]] 和 [[95,1,7]] 三正交码。评估显示，自同构集成解码（AED）和猜测随机加性噪声解码（GRAND）是退相干信道上高距离三正交码的有效解码选项。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了新的三正交码，并验证了其存在准则。在解码性能方面，自同构集成解码（AED）和猜测随机加性噪声解码（GRAND）被证明是处理退相干信道中高距离三正交码的有前景的解码方法。
AI.translation: 三正交码是魔术态蒸馏中的基本组成部分，因为它们能够横向实现逻辑 T 门。T 门作为一种非 Clifford 操作，与 Clifford 操作结合使用时，能够实现通用的容错量子计算。我们推导出了具有目标对偶最小距离的偶权三正交生成矩阵的存在准则。该准则将三正交约束与 MacWilliams 恒等式通过对偶权重分布上的 Krawtchouk 多项式条件相结合，从而为构建问题提供了一个整数线性规划公式。我们发现了新的非平凡三正交码（简并和非简并），这些码不一定由三重偶数二进制线性码构成。通过施加自同构群约束，该公式也能恢复已知的 [[49,1,5]] 和 [[95,1,7]] 三正交码。我们还在退相干信道上使用不同的解码方法评估了所获得的高距离三正交码的性能，结果表明自同构集成解码（AED）和猜测随机加性噪声解码（GRAND）是有前景的选择。
AI.summary: 本研究致力于量子三正交码的构建与解码，这类代码对实现容错量子计算中的T门至关重要。作者推导了一个构建偶权三正交生成矩阵的存在准则，并将其转化为整数线性规划问题，成功发现了新的非平凡三正交码。此外，研究还通过评估不同解码方法在退相干信道上的性能，指出自同构集成解码（AED）和猜测随机加性噪声解码（GRAND）是有效的解码策略。
AI.keywords: 量子三正交码, 容错量子计算, 整数线性规划, 解码, T门
AI.comments: 这项工作在量子纠错码领域具有重要意义，尤其是在构建通用容错量子计算所需的T门方面。通过结合代数编码理论（MacWilliams恒等式、Krawtchouk多项式）与优化方法（整数线性规划），提供了一种系统性的三正交码构建框架，并成功发现了新的代码。对解码性能的评估也为实际应用提供了指导。

title: Memory by Design: Bayesian Layers for Sequence Modeling
summary: We introduce the \emph{design-model framework}: a way to derive efficient recurrent sequence maps from explicit assumptions about memory. A design model writes evidence into memory by exact Bayesian filtering; a query- dependent readout produces a predictive distribution whose mean is the layer output. In our linear-Gaussian instantiation, the \emph{Bayesian Layer} propagates both a mean and a covariance: the covariance tracks uncertainty over stored associations, steering writes toward uncertain directions, attenuating gains as evidence accumulates, and preserving confident memories. The same framework unifies several sub-quadratic recurrences: linear attention, GLA, and Mamba-2/SSD are exact filters under a latent-input design model, whereas DeltaNet and related Delta-rule models are covariance-reset reductions of the Bayesian Layer's design model. Restoring covariance propagation yields closed-form predictions for retrieval dynamics, which we verify empirically, and improves robustness beyond the training regime in controlled collision studies, learned associative recall, and the Zoology MQAR benchmark. Training from scratch on WikiText-103 under matched state budgets lowers perplexity on associative-recall hits. Distilling Bayesian Layers into a pretrained 340M Gated DeltaNet improves RULER long-context retrieval over a matched-compute control, at a 2.5--2.7\% held-out perplexity cost.

AI.title_translation: 设计所得的记忆：用于序列建模的贝叶斯层
AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于贝叶斯滤波的设计模型框架，通过在贝叶斯层中联合传播均值与协方差统一并超越了现有的亚二次循环模型，显著提升了记忆与长上下文检索能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在基于对记忆的显式假设，推导并设计出高效的循环序列映射，并为现有的各类亚二次复杂度循环模型提供统一的理论框架与改进方向。
AI.method: 提出了'设计模型框架'（design-model framework），通过精确贝叶斯滤波将证据写入记忆，并以查询相关的预测分布均值作为输出。在线性高斯实例化中构建'贝叶斯层'（Bayesian Layer），通过同时传播均值和协方差来跟踪关联的不确定性，引导写入并保留置信记忆。该框架将线性注意力、GLA和Mamba-2/SSD视为隐输入下的精确滤波器，将DeltaNet归为协方差重置的约简模型。
AI.result: 恢复协方差传播得出了检索动态的闭式预测，并在受控碰撞研究、关联回忆和Zoology MQAR基准中提升了超出训练范围的鲁棒性；在WikiText-103从头训练中降低了关联回忆命中时的困惑度；将贝叶斯层蒸馏到预训练的340M Gated DeltaNet中，在匹配计算量下提升了RULER长上下文检索性能，仅带来2.5-2.7%的保留困惑度代价。
AI.conclusion: 基于精确贝叶斯滤波的设计模型框架及恢复协方差传播的贝叶斯层，不仅在理论上统一了现存的多种亚二次循环序列模型，而且在经验上显著提升了模型的关联回忆能力、分布外鲁棒性以及长上下文检索表现。
AI.translation: 我们引入了“设计模型框架”（design-model framework）：一种根据关于记忆的显式假设来推导高效循环序列映射的方法。设计模型通过精确贝叶斯滤波将证据写入记忆；依赖于查询的读取操作生成一个预测分布，其均值作为该层的输出。在我们线性高斯实例化的“贝叶斯层”（Bayesian Layer）中，同时传播均值和协方差：协方差追踪所存储关联的不确定性，引导写入朝向不确定方向，随着证据的积累衰减增益，并保留高置信度的记忆。该框架统一了多种亚二次循环架构：线性注意力（linear attention）、GLA 和 Mamba-2/SSD 是隐输入设计模型下的精确滤波器，而 DeltaNet 及相关的 Delta 规则模型则是贝叶斯层设计模型的协方差重置约简版本。恢复协方差传播为检索动力学提供了闭式预测（我们对此进行了实证验证），并在受控碰撞研究、学习关联回忆以及 Zoology MQAR 基准测试中提高了超出训练分布的鲁棒性。在状态预算匹配的条件下，在 WikiText-103 上从头开始训练降低了关联回忆命中时的困惑度。将贝叶斯层蒸馏到预训练的 340M Gated DeltaNet 中，在计算量匹配的对照下提升了 RULER 长上下文检索表现，仅付出了 2.5–2.7% 的保留测试集困惑度代价。
AI.summary: 本文提出了设计模型框架，利用精确贝叶斯滤波从记忆假设推导高效循环序列映射。在线性高斯贝叶斯层中联合传播均值与协方差，利用不确定性指导记忆写入与保留。该框架理论上统一了Linear Attention、GLA、Mamba-2和DeltaNet等模型，实证上大幅提升了检索鲁棒性、语言模型关联回忆命中表现及长上下文检索能力。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯滤波, 序列建模, 贝叶斯层, 协方差传播, 亚二次循环模型
AI.comments: 本论文的创新之处在于跳脱出纯粹经验性或启发式的循环结构设计，从概率图模型与精确贝叶斯滤波的严谨理论出发推导序列记忆机制。引入协方差追踪不确定性，解决了传统Delta规则缺乏置信度建模的问题，并巧妙地将Linear Attention、GLA、Mamba-2和DeltaNet统一在同一理论框架下。其局限性可能在于显式传播协方差会增加状态维护的理论与实现复杂度，且蒸馏实验中伴随轻微的困惑度损失（2.5–2.7%）。

title: Nonlocal Teams and Information Structures
summary: We look at Bell inequalities from the lens of information structures in stochastic teams. We consider the usual Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) game and a dynamic variant of the same to study how various classes of strategies, classical, projective and quantum, behave under team theoretic solution concepts. We endow players with a fixed quantum state that we take as the Bell state, and allow variation of the measurement strategies. In the static game, projective strategies (where each player performs projective measurements) are team optimal for all parameter values and are closed under best response. In the dynamic game these properties fail: projective strategies may be strictly outperformed by classical ones, best responses to projective strategies need not be projective, and, beyond a sharp threshold on the channel noise, team optimal projective strategies cease to be person-by-person optimal, even though person-by-person optimal projective pairs always exist. These results shed light on the delicate interplay of information structure in quantum strategies and the fragility, under a change of information structure, of structural properties that are taken for granted in the static setting.

AI.title_translation: 非局域团队与信息结构
AI.tldr: 本文从随机团队的信息结构角度研究贝尔不等式，并通过静态和动态CHSH博弈，分析了经典、投影和量子策略在团队理论下的行为。发现动态博弈中投影策略的优越性会失效，并揭示了信息结构在量子策略中的微妙作用。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在从随机团队的信息结构角度审视贝尔不等式，并研究在团队理论解决方案概念下，经典、投影和量子等各类策略在静态和动态CHSH博弈中的表现，以揭示信息结构在量子策略中的作用及其在信息结构变化下的脆弱性。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：1. 从随机团队的信息结构角度审视贝尔不等式。2. 考虑标准的Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) 博弈及其动态变体。3. 分析经典、投影和量子策略在团队理论解决方案概念下的行为。4. 设定玩家具有固定的贝尔量子态，并允许测量策略的变化。
AI.result: 在静态博弈中，投影策略在所有参数值下都是团队最优的，并且在最佳响应下是封闭的。然而，在动态博弈中，这些特性失效：投影策略可能被经典策略严格超越，对投影策略的最佳响应不必是投影的，并且在超过信道噪声的急剧阈值后，团队最优的投影策略不再是逐人最优的，尽管逐人最优的投影对总是存在的。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了信息结构在量子策略中微妙的相互作用，以及在信息结构变化下，静态设置中被认为是理所当然的结构特性所表现出的脆弱性。
AI.translation: 我们从随机团队的信息结构角度审视贝尔不等式。我们考虑标准的Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) 博弈及其动态变体，以研究在团队理论解决方案概念下，经典、投影和量子等各类策略如何表现。我们赋予玩家一个固定的量子态，将其视为贝尔态，并允许测量策略的变化。在静态博弈中，投影策略（每个玩家执行投影测量）在所有参数值下都是团队最优的，并且在最佳响应下是封闭的。在动态博弈中，这些特性失效：投影策略可能被经典策略严格超越，对投影策略的最佳响应不必是投影的，并且在超过信道噪声的急剧阈值后，团队最优的投影策略不再是逐人最优的，即使逐人最优的投影对总是存在的。这些结果揭示了信息结构在量子策略中微妙的相互作用，以及在信息结构变化下，静态设置中被认为是理所当然的结构特性所表现出的脆弱性。
AI.summary: 本文从随机团队的信息结构视角出发，研究了贝尔不等式，并通过分析静态和动态CHSH博弈中经典、投影和量子策略的表现。研究发现，在静态博弈中投影策略表现出团队最优性，但在动态博弈中，其优越性会失效，可能被经典策略超越，且最佳响应不一定是投影的。此外，当信道噪声超过阈值时，团队最优的投影策略甚至不再是逐人最优。这些发现揭示了信息结构对量子策略的微妙影响以及其在信息结构变化下的脆弱性。
AI.keywords: 贝尔不等式, 信息结构, CHSH博弈, 量子策略, 团队理论
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将贝尔不等式与随机团队的信息结构理论相结合，通过对比静态和动态CHSH博弈，深入探讨了不同策略在量子信息背景下的行为差异。其重要性在于揭示了信息结构变化对量子策略性能和结构特性（如团队最优性、逐人最优性）的显著影响，特别是指出了在动态环境下投影策略的脆弱性，为理解量子信息处理和非局域性提供了新的视角和理论基础。

title: Biclique decompositions from Welzl orders
comments: 17 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 10th SIAM Symposium on Simplicity in Algorithms (SOSA 2027)
summary: A biclique decomposition of a graph is a partition of its edges into complete bipartite subgraphs. We consider graphs whose vertices can be ordered such that the neighborhood of every vertex is the union of a sublinear number of intervals. We observe that these graphs admit compact representations in the form of biclique decompositions of small size. Here, the size of a decomposition is measured as the sum of the number of vertices of its bicliques. Combining this result with the existence of suitable vertex orderings for graphs of low neighborhood complexity, as proven by Welzl in 1988, we recover and extend several known results up to logarithmic factors. These results include upper bounds on the Zarankiewicz problem, matrix multiplication, quantum circuit complexity, and shortest path algorithms in "well-structured" instances.
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 10th SIAM Symposium on Simplicity in Algorithms (SOSA 2027)

AI.tldr: 研究了Welzl序下具有低邻域复杂度的图的双团分解，发现它们具有紧凑表示，并在此基础上改进了Zarankiewicz问题、矩阵乘法等多个已知结果，达到了对数因子级别的提升。
AI.motivation: 寻找一种紧凑表示具有特定顶点排序（Welzl序）和低邻域复杂度的图的方法，以期改进相关算法和问题的界限。
AI.method: 论文首先定义了图的双团分解。然后，研究了那些顶点可以排序使得每个顶点的邻域是次线性数量区间并集的图，并观察到这些图允许以小尺寸双团分解的形式进行紧凑表示。最后，将此结果与Welzl在1988年证明的低邻域复杂度图存在合适的顶点排序相结合。
AI.result: 具有特定顶点排序（即每个顶点的邻域是次线性数量区间并集）的图承认小尺寸双团分解的紧凑表示。结合Welzl的发现，该方法恢复并扩展了包括Zarankiewicz问题上限、矩阵乘法、量子电路复杂性以及“结构良好”实例中的最短路径算法在内的多个已知结果，改进了对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用Welzl序和低邻域复杂度的图特性，双团分解提供了一种有效的图表示方法，并能改进多种经典算法和问题的界限，在理论计算机科学的多个领域显示出广泛应用潜力。
AI.translation: 一个图的双团分解是指将其边划分为完全二分图子图。我们考虑那些顶点可以排序使得每个顶点的邻域是次线性数量区间并集的图。我们观察到这些图以小尺寸双团分解的形式承认紧凑表示。这里，分解的尺寸以其双团的顶点数之和来衡量。将此结果与Welzl在1988年证明的低邻域复杂度图存在合适的顶点排序相结合，我们恢复并扩展了几个已知结果，达到对数因子。这些结果包括Zarankiewicz问题的上限、矩阵乘法、量子电路复杂性以及“结构良好”实例中的最短路径算法。
AI.summary: 这篇论文探讨了Welzl序下具有低邻域复杂度的图的双团分解。研究发现，这类图可以通过小尺寸的双团分解进行紧凑表示，其中分解的尺寸是其双团顶点数之和。结合Welzl 1988年的研究成果，该方法恢复并改进了包括Zarankiewicz问题、矩阵乘法和量子电路复杂性在内的多项已知结果，达到了对数因子级别的提升。
AI.keywords: 双团分解, Welzl序, 图表示, 邻域复杂度, 算法改进
AI.comments: 这项工作通过结合图论中的双团分解和Welzl序的概念，为具有特定结构（低邻域复杂度）的图提供了一种有效的紧凑表示方法。其创新之处在于将图的结构特性与分解技术相结合，并展示了其在改进算法界限方面的广泛应用，尤其是在理论计算机科学的多个领域。

title: A quantum algorithm for one-shot signatures
comments: 32 pages, 5 figures, and 5 tables. Accepted for publication at ACM PQQS 2026
summary: We provide a pre-obfuscation circuit-level implementation of an efficient one shot signature scheme, which has known applications to delegated signatures, secure token transfer, and publicly verifiable randomness. The algorithm consists of two stages: a key generation stage where a classical public key/quantum secret key pair is produced, and a signing stage where the quantum secret key is processed with a message string to produce a classical signature. There is no algorithmic error in the construction and the signed message can be efficiently checked by a classical verifier. Our scheme works by preparing a superposition over elements of a random affine coset determined by the output of a puncturable pseudorandom function, together with a circuit that tests coset membership. The logical qubit number scales like $Θ( κ\log(r) + n + l)$ and the gate complexity scales like $Θ(n^3 + nl)$, where $r$ is the public key size, $n+l$ is the signature size, $l$ is the message size, and $κ= Ω(n)$ is the cryptographic security parameter. We provide explicit qubit and gate counts before obfuscation. A secure instantiation additionally requires modified key generation and a security proof for the resulting obfuscated construction.
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures, and 5 tables. Accepted for publication at ACM PQQS 2026

AI.title_translation: 一种用于一次性签名的量子算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的一次性量子签名方案的预混淆电路实现，明确了其量子比特和门复杂度，并实现了可由经典验证者高效验证的无错误签名。
AI.motivation: 为了满足委托签名、安全代币传输以及公开可验证随机性等应用的需求，提供一个高效的一次性量子签名方案的电路级实现，并给出显式的量子比特数和门复杂度。
AI.method: 通过准备由可穿刺伪随机函数输出确定的随机仿射陪集元素的叠加态，并结合测试陪集成员资格的电路来实现。方案分为密钥生成阶段（产生经典公钥和量子私钥）和签名阶段（处理量子私钥和消息生成经典签名）。
AI.result: 实现了无算法错误的一次性签名方案，签名可由经典验证者高效验证。逻辑量子比特数规模为 $\Theta(\kappa\log(r) + n + l)$，门复杂度规模为 $\Theta(n^3 + nl)$，并给出了混淆前的显式量子比特数和门计数。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个高效的一次性量子签名方案的预混淆电路级实现，具备明确的量子比特和门复杂度规模，为量子委托签名、安全代币传输等应用提供了坚实的技术支撑。
AI.translation: 我们提供了一种高效的一次性签名方案的预混淆电路级实现，该方案在委托签名、安全代币传输和公开可验证随机性方面有着已知的应用。该算法包含两个阶段：生成经典公钥/量子私钥对的密钥生成阶段，以及将量子私钥与消息字符串处理以产生经典签名的签名阶段。该结构没有算法错误，并且签名消息可以由经典验证者高效检查。我们的方案通过准备由可穿刺伪随机函数输出确定的随机仿射陪集元素的叠加态，以及测试陪集成员资格的电路来工作。逻辑量子比特数规模类似于 $\Theta(\kappa\log(r) + n + l)$，门复杂度规模类似于 $\Theta(n^3 + nl)$，其中 $r$ 是公钥大小，$n+l$ 是签名大小，$l$ 是消息大小，$\kappa= \Omega(n)$ 是密码安全参数。我们提供了混淆前的显式量子比特和门计数。一个安全的实例化额外需要修改的密钥生成以及对所得混淆结构的安全性证明。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一个高效的一次性量子签名方案的预混淆电路级实现，包含密钥生成和签名两个阶段，具有无算法错误、经典可验证的特性。文章详细推导了逻辑量子比特数和门复杂度的规模，并指出安全实例化需要进一步的混淆安全证明。
AI.keywords: 量子签名, 一次性签名, 预混淆电路, 量子密码学, 伪随机函数
AI.comments: 该论文在量子密码学领域取得了重要进展，提出了一种高效的一次性签名方案的预混淆电路级实现。该算法在避免算法错误的同时，通过经典的公钥和量子的私钥实现了高效的签名与经典验证。其逻辑量子比特数和门复杂度的显式给出为后续的量子密码实现奠定了基础。不过，完全的安全性实例化还需要修改密钥生成并提供混淆构造的安全证明。

title: Self-Organized Conformal Prediction: Reducing Regional Coverage Gaps with Unsupervised Group Discovery
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Updated to the camera-ready version
summary: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a pooled calibration quantile can hide systematic undercoverage across heterogeneous regions of the feature space. We introduce Self-Organized Conformal Prediction (SOCP), a calibration scheme that discovers input-space groups with an unsupervised Self-Organizing Map (SOM) trained without calibration data. At prediction time, the query's best-matching unit (BMU) retrieves a calibration buffer from one cell, a fixed grid neighborhood, or a prototype enlargement (Regimes 1 to 3). When fixed neighborhoods are too sparse, Regime 3 adds cells by prototype distance, using a global budget selected from training cell occupancies and the planned calibration size before any calibration score is observed. The predictor and nonconformity score remain unchanged. Cell-only retrieval has exact cell-conditional validity, and each fixed union of cells has exact retrieved-set validity. Interpreting a neighborhood threshold at its central cell incurs an explicit Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) bias term. Across ten regression and classification benchmarks, SOCP lowers the mean weighted coverage gap (WCovGap) relative to pooled split conformal prediction (SCP) on all ten datasets. The mean relative change is -14.8%, with a mean increase of 3.0% in output size. Under fixed-neighborhood retrieval, SO calibration lowers mean WCovGap across ten seeds in 43 of 50 score and dataset comparisons, while SO-SCP lowers it for every dataset at all three tested external partition granularities. These results provide local group calibration without supervised partitions or predictor retraining, while the diagnostics make the cost and limits of locality explicit. The code is available at https://github.com/LouisTier/SOCP.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Updated to the camera-ready version

AI.title_translation: 自组织保形预测：通过无监督群组发现减少区域覆盖缺口
AI.tldr: 提出自组织保形预测（SOCP），利用无监督群组发现技术有效降低了保形预测在异构区域的覆盖缺口。
AI.motivation: 传统的保形预测保证边际覆盖率，但合并的校准分位数可能会掩盖特征空间异构区域中系统的覆盖率不足问题。
AI.method: 引入自组织保形预测（SOCP），利用在无校准数据上训练的无监督自组织映射（SOM）来发现输入空间群组，并在预测时通过三种不同的检索机制（Regimes 1-3）获取校准缓冲区。
AI.result: 在十个回归和分类基准测试中，SOCP相比传统的合并分裂保形预测（SCP），在所有十个数据集上均降低了平均加权覆盖缺口（WCovGap），平均相对变化为 -14.8%，同时输出大小平均增加了 3.0%。
AI.conclusion: SOCP能够在无需监督分区或重新训练预测器的情况下，显著减少区域覆盖缺口，提供可靠的局部群体校准，并通过明确的诊断工具权衡局部性成本和限制。
AI.translation: 保形预测保证了边际覆盖率，但合并的校准分位数可能会掩盖特征空间异构区域中的系统性覆盖不足。我们引入了自组织保形预测（SOCP），这是一种校准方案，它使用在无校准数据下训练的无监督自组织映射（SOM）来发现输入空间群组。在预测时，查询的最优匹配单元（BMU）从一个单元、一个固定网格邻域或一个原型扩充（方案1至3）中检索校准缓冲区。当固定邻域过于稀疏时，方案3通过原型距离添加单元，使用在观察任何校准分数之前从训练单元占用率和计划校准大小中选择的全局预算。预测器和非一致性得分保持不变。仅单元检索具有确切的单元条件有效性，并且每个固定的单元并集具有确切的检索集有效性。在中心单元解释邻域阈值会产生显式的柯尔莫哥洛夫-斯米尔诺夫（KS）偏差项。在十个回归和分类基准测试中，SOCP在所有十个数据集上相对于合并分割保形预测（SCP）降低了平均加权覆盖缺口（WCovGap）。平均相对变化为 -14.8%，输出大小平均增加了 3.0%。在固定邻域检索下，SO校准在50个得分与数据集比较中的43个（跨越十个随机种子）降低了平均WCovGap，而SO-SCP在所有三个测试的外部划分粒度下的每个数据集上都降低了WCovGap。这些结果提供了局部群组校准，无需监督分区或预测器重新训练，同时诊断使得局部性的成本和限制显式化。代码可在 https://github.com/LouisTier/SOCP 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了自组织保形预测（SOCP），这是一种通过无监督自组织映射发现输入空间群组来减少区域覆盖缺口的新型校准方案，在保持预测器不变的同时实现了更好的局部群体校准。
AI.keywords: Conformal Prediction, Self-Organizing Map, Group Discovery, Regional Coverage, Uncertainty Quantification
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种自组织保形预测（SOCP）方案，利用无监督自组织映射（SOM）发现特征空间中的群体，有效缓解了传统保形预测在异构区域中覆盖率不足的问题，具有较强的实用性和创新性。

title: Locating a Seymour vertex in oriented graphs having minimum outdegree at most 7
comments: The earlier version of our paper contained different proof technique for two cases of the proof. It involved substantial computational assistance. Whereas this version does not require any computational assistance and is completely based on handwritten logical arguments. The author list has been updated at the request of a co-author listed in the previous version
summary:
A vertex $v$ of an oriented graph $D$ is a Seymour vertex if the number of outneighbors of $v$ is less than or equal to the number of second outneighbors of $v$ (vertices at directed distance exactly $2$ from $v$). Seymour's Second Neighborhood Conjecture claims that every oriented graph contains a Seymour vertex. We propose the following stronger conjecture (Conjecture 1.4): given any oriented graphs $D$, there exists a minimum outdegree vertex $s$, and a Seymour vertex $v^*$ such that the directed distance from $s$ to $v^*$ is at most $\lfloor\frac{δ^+(D)}{3} \rfloor$, where $δ^+(D)$ denotes the minimum outdegree of $D$.
  The main contribution of this article is to show that Conjecture 1.4 is true for all oriented graphs having minimum outdegree at most $7$. This, in particular, improves the results of Kaneko and Locke (2001) which (implicitly) proved Conjecture 1.4 for all oriented graphs having minimum outdegree at most $6$. In particular, this yields Seymour's Second Neighborhood Conjecture for this class of oriented graphs. We also construct a family of digraphs attaining the proposed distance bound, showing that it cannot be improved in general.
  Finally, by adapting existing arguments, we show that if Seymour's Second Neighborhood Conjecture is true then given any oriented graph $D$ and any vertex $v$, it is always possible to find a Seymour vertex $v^*$ such that the directed distance from $v$ to $v^*$ is at most the outdegree of $v$.
