title: To Stack or Not to Stack? Jacobian Conditioning and the Benefits of Depth in Metasurface-Based Linear Transformation Synthesis
summary: This paper investigates when and why stacking programmable metasurfaces into Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIMs) improves linear transformation synthesis at a fixed phase-control budget. The analysis shows that algebraic Jacobian rank alone is insufficient to characterize practical synthesis, which also depends on the strength and balance of the sensitivity directions generated by the available controls. A layer-resolved analysis of the cascade model explains how inter-layer propagation can generate complementary sensitivity directions. The relevance of this mechanism is then assessed using an S-parameter multiport model that includes electromagnetic coupling and multiple scattering. Numerical results in near- and far-field sensing scenarios show that distributing the same control resources across multiple layers can strengthen weak transformation directions, improve Jacobian conditioning, and substantially enhance synthesis accuracy. These findings explain why increasing depth can offer benefits that are not obtained by simply enlarging a single programmable surface, and identify layer complementarity and Jacobian conditioning as useful criteria for SIM architecture design.

title: Modeling Diffuse Scattering in Mobility Scenarios: Ray Tracing Model and Measurement Validation
summary: Open-source ray tracing (RT) frameworks are increasingly used for site-specific channel modeling due to their reproducibility and extensibility. In non-stationary mobility scenarios, repeated RT evaluations can generate different diffuse propagation paths without preserving their correspondence, limiting a consistent representation of their temporal evolution. To address this limitation, we extend diffuse scattering modeling in Sionna RT using persistent surface-associated scattering points. Their positions remain fixed, while their contributions evolve according to changes in the propagation geometry and visibility. The proposed approach is validated using empirical radio channel impulse response measurements in an urban vehicular scenario at 5.9 GHz. Compared with the standard Sionna RT baseline, the proposed model shows improved agreement with measurements in the delay and Doppler domains.

title: CIPHEUR: LLM-Guided Structural Search Control for Conflict-Graph Optimization
summary: Conflict-graph search can stagnate despite effective operators when interventions fail to address the conflicts blocking progress. A disruptive intervention may also require further search before its value emerges. We propose CIPHEUR, a large language model (LLM)-guided framework that connects conflict evidence to coordinated intervention and recovery through Structured Intervention Units (SIUs). The shared control interface supports offline synthesis of executable policies and online contextual decisions. Asynchronous online control sustains native search during inference, while all policies preserve the original objective and feasibility constraints. Across eight satellite-ground scheduling conflict views with five runs per view and a 900-second evaluation cap, CIPHEUR-online achieves the highest mean objective among 11 configurations and increases mean scheduled contact duration by 14.84% over the greedy baseline GWMIN. It exceeds the strongest external per-view mean in seven of eight views and outperforms CHILS in all 40 paired runs. Within the same runs, its normalized objective improvement from 360 to 900 seconds is 1.50 to 1.86 times that of the two programmatic controllers. A separately frozen, one-shot LLM-generated controller also improves the mean objective over CHILS without runtime model calls. Together, these results demonstrate how structural search control translates LLM design knowledge and contextual reasoning into improved solution quality and sustained search progress.

title: High-resolution retinal matrix imaging via computational motion and aberration correction
summary: High-resolution optical imaging of the human retina is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic and neurodegenerative diseases. While adaptive optics combined with coherence gating can resolve retinal structures at the cellular scale, it requires complex, costly, and cumbersome hardware to physically correct for ocular aberrations and motion. Matrix imaging offers a powerful digital alternative by leveraging wave linearity to undo aberrations and multiple scattering; however, its in vivo deployment has been hindered by continuous, involuntary eye movements that destroy phase coherence during acquisition. Here, we overcome this fundamental barrier and demonstrate the first in vivo reflection matrix imaging of the human retina using an ultra-simplified optical setup without physical correctors. We introduce a fully computational framework that tracks and compensates for multi-axial ocular motion directly from raw interferometric data, thereby restoring the phase coherence of a multi-spectral distortion matrix. This enables local, high-order aberration correction to achieve diffraction-limited, volumetric imaging of retinal tissues. By shifting the hardware burden to physics-guided numerical computation, this paradigm opens the way for accessible, non-invasive, and high-resolution digital ophthalmology.

title: The Derivation of The Probability of Error for BPSK, 16-QAM and 64-QAM in Rayleigh Fading Channel: A Unified Approach
summary: Understanding the probability of error is paramount in the design and analysis of digital communication systems, particularly in Rayleigh fading channels where signal impairments are prevalent. This article presents a unified approach for deriving the probability of error formulations applicable to Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK), 16-Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (16-QAM), and 64-QAM in Rayleigh fading channels. This article presents a general approach to derive the probability of error formulations applicable to Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK), 16-Quadruple Amplitude Modulation (16-QAM) and 64-QAM in Rayleigh fading channels. The derivation process encompasses the unique characteristics of each modulation scheme and the statistical properties of Rayleigh fading providing a comprehensive framework to analyze error performance. By establishing a unified formulation, this approach simplifies the analysis and facilitates a deeper understanding of error probability behavior across different modulation schemes. The derived formulations offer insights into the impact of fading-induced impairments on system performance, allowing for accurate prediction and optimization of communication systems in real-world fading environments. The insights and techniques presented herein serve as a valuable resource for researchers, engineers, and practitioners engaged in the design and optimization of communication systems operating in challenging fading environments.

title: SCI-Mamba: Unsupervised Learning based Low-Light Image Enhancement for Non-Cooperative Spacecraft
summary:
Low-light visual perception acts as the core visual foundation for on-orbit servicing missions targeting non-cooperative spacecraft, supporting autonomous rendezvous, pose estimation, component detection and robotic capture operations. Spaceborne imagery suffers from severe low-light degradation, while the extreme scarcity of paired normal/low-light space samples severely limits the generalization capacity of supervised enhancement algorithms. To address this practical bottleneck, this paper proposes SCI-Mamba, an unsupervised enhancement network for low-light orbital spacecraft observations. The proposed framework unites self-calibrated unsupervised learning, linear-complexity VMamba architecture and Retinex physical priors, delivering a lightweight enhancement pipeline adaptable to resource-limited spaceborne hardware. We construct Space Dark-1.0, a dedicated low-light spacecraft dataset integrating real orbital footage, darkroom hardware-in-the-loop measurements and physically constrained synthetic data covering diverse illumination, motion and attitude conditions. Comprehensive comparisons with CNN-, Transformer- and prevailing Mamba-based approaches verify the advantages of SCI-Mamba in visual authenticity, color fidelity and inference speed. The proposed framework provides a practical low-light enhancement solution for close-proximity non-cooperative space operations.
  The code is available at https://github.com/bitswh/SCI-Mamba

title: Stochastic Analysis of Successive Interference Cancellation in a Narrow-Beam LEO Uplink
summary: This paper investigates uplink coverage probability, i.e., the SIR distribution, and SIR order statistics at a low Earth orbit satellite base station (LEO BS) with narrow Gaussian antenna beams. The user equipments (UEs) connected to the satellite radio access network are distributed according to a Poisson point process (PPP) on the Earth's surface. We propose a novel framework for stochastic geometry analysis of the SIR using a Gaussian mixture shadowing model, derive tractable expressions for the mean, variance, and probability density function, and analyze the SIR distributions for the three strongest UEs under successive interference cancellation (SIC). Furthermore, we propose a gamma distribution model for the interference distribution. We show that SIC enables each LEO BS to serve multiple UEs per beam cell, improving user fairness while preserving the network throughput. The observations imply design recommendations for next-generation non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) LEO networks. The analytical insights are validated against Monte Carlo simulations.

title: A Knowledge-Centric Communication For Autonomous Cislunar Networks
summary: Future lunar infrastructure requires communication as a persistent service rather than a mission specific capability. Communication, digital twin, and artificial intelligence (AI) research have advanced autonomy independently while largely assuming that system state can eventually be reconciled with ground truth. Cislunar communication violates this assumption because propagation delay is fundamentally limited by the speed of light, visibility is governed by orbital geometry, and autonomous decisions often precede confirming observations. Here we introduce a knowledge-centric communication framework in which a digital twin continuously integrates delayed observations, communication physics, learned models, uncertainty quantification, and mission objectives into an evolving Operational Knowledge State. To quantify what is known, how uncertain it remains, and how current it is, we define two quantities over the fused Bayesian belief maintained for each communication link: \emph{Knowledge Entropy}, the differential entropy of the posterior belief, and \emph{Knowledge Freshness}, which generalizes Age of Information (AoI) from a single information stream to the temporal validity of the fused Operational Knowledge State. We prove that distributed knowledge fusion systematically improves operational knowledge by reducing uncertainty and demonstrate its importance for mission success through simulations and comparisons with flight data from the Longjiang-2 lunar micro-satellite.

title: Antenna Positioning and Beamforming Optimization in MA Enabled Secure ISAC Systems: A Gradient-Based Meta Learning Approach
summary: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) significantly improves spectral efficiency but introduces security risks regarding the interception of embedded communication signals. This paper proposes an movable antenna (MA)-enabled secure ISAC system that utilizes the spatial degrees of freedom of MA to mitigate these risks. Then, a problem is formulated to maximize the system secrecy rate by jointly optimizing antenna positioning, transmit beamforming, and artificial noise. However, the principal challenge arises from the non-convexity of the optimization problem and the strong coupling of the optimization variables. Generally, traditional optimization methods for this problem suffer from complex mathematical derivations, while existing deep learning approaches rely heavily on the training data distribution. To address these issues, we introduce a gradient-based meta learning (GML) algorithm, which works without pre-training and demonstrates favorable performance. Specifically, the algorithm establishes a neural network for each optimization variable, where the gradient of the objective function with respect to the variable serves as the input, and the output of the network determines the variable's update step. By handling the constraints and constructing penalty terms, the global loss function is used to guide the optimization process. Extensive numerical simulations confirm that the proposed algorithm achieves satisfactory performance in terms of both communication security and sensing capabilities.

title: Low-complexity Soft-decision LLR Calculations for Next-generation IM-DD Systems with RIN
summary: The demand for higher speeds in intra-data center interconnects will eventually require high-order pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) combined with soft-decision (SD) forward error correction (FEC). The laser relative intensity noise (RIN) is an important noise impairment that limits the performance of high-speed intensity-modulation (IM) and direct-detection (DD) systems, as it induces a channel with signal-dependent noise. In this paper, we show that an accurate calculation of the log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) is critical for the performance of the SD-FEC decoder in RIN-dominated IM-DD systems. First, we show that assuming signal-independent additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) statistics to compute LLRs results in a significant penalty in performance. As an alternative, we propose a low-complexity piecewise linear approximation of the exact LLRs of Gray-coded PAM-4 and PAM-8 for the RIN-dominated IM-DD channel. We show using the generalized mutual information that our approximation results in no performance loss versus using exact LLRs, unlike the AWGN-like assumption. Furthermore, we validate the analysis with bit error rate (BER) performance of SD decoding. We show that our approximation matches the BERs achieved using exact LLRs. Therefore, our approximation avoids a BER error floor penalty of up to 7.2 times using an extended Hamming code with PAM-4, and up to 2.41 dB of optical modulation amplitude penalty using high-code-rate low-density parity-check codes with PAM-8 for the same target BER.

title: ALF: Spectrally Anchored Latent Flow Matching for Wireless Signal Generation
summary: Wireless time-series generation is useful for emerging applications that will drive the adoption and integration of machine learning tasks within next-generation networks, such as waveform classification in shared spectrum bands and interpretation of the physical world through integrated sensing and communications. Unlike a generic time series, wireless signals have time-frequency duality, where a frequency domain bandwidth constraint implicitly imposes latent structural constraints on the evolution of the time-domain sequence. In this paper, we develop Anchored Latent Flow (ALF), a latent space flow model for label-conditioned signal generation that exploits this duality. Our flow model "reasons'" through a spectrogram, which is a 2-D representation of the signal constructed by applying a windowed Fast Fourier Transform to successive, overlapping signal segments and mapping their frequency-domain power components across time. Specifically, we shape the latent space of the flow model through a training-time auxiliary objective that is supervised by the (latent) spectrogram (i.e., anchoring through the spectrogram). By guiding the flow field to reason through a spectrogram, the generated sequence maintains long-range coherence across time and greatly improves the signal quality at inference. Empirically, ALF exhibits state-of-the-art generation quality and reconstruction error across various signal lengths, waveform classes, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and channel conditions, reaching a train on synthetic, test on real (TSTR) accuracy of 84.5%, a 1.9X average memory reduction, and 100X average compute speedup over existing models. Our design further enables downstream tasks, including style transfer and data augmentation, and has broad utility for the wireless community.

title: Discrete p-Fold Directional Models for Binned Orientation Data with Applications to Sand-Grain Orientations and Urban Street Networks
summary: Discrete directional data exhibiting p-fold rotational symmetry, where directions separated by integer multiples of 2π/p are equivalent, arise in various applications but are often modeled using continuous distributions. In this article, we develop two general methods for constructing distributions for such data: symmetrization and folding of discrete circular distributions, and wrapping of discrete linear distributions. Particular models arising from these constructions are studied, together with their properties and estimation methods. For axial sand-grain orientation data, the proposed models are compared with discretized continuous axial distributions, whose category probabilities require numerical integration. The proposed models attain smaller Akaike information criterion values among the models considered while allowing direct likelihood evaluation without numerical integration. The framework is also applied to binned Manhattan street-orientation data, demonstrating its applicability to higher-order rotational structures, specifically the 4-fold case.

title: Predicting future insurance markets: Simulation of technology adoption paths with a Bayesian Bass model
summary: Technological progress can give rise to new loss exposures or reduce existing risks. In either case, it strongly affects insurance companies' existing lines of business. As the magnitude of such effects is often closely connected to the innovation's market penetration, reliably predicting its adoption process is vital in enabling insurers to adapt their business strategy accordingly. To tackle this challenge, we propose a novel combination of contributions from the domain of innovation diffusion. Our methodology generates adoption scenarios that holistically account for different sources of uncertainty, offers a structured way to incorporate expert judgment and insights from pre-existing technologies, and updates its predictions as new information on the technology's diffusion becomes available. Its modular nature ensures that components can be easily replaced by suitable alternatives. Using publicly accessible data on privately-owned battery electric vehicles in Germany, the application of our approach for predicting changes to insurance losses and for supporting insurers' sustainability strategies is visualized in a motor insurance case study.

title: Probabilistic AI models outperform numerical weather prediction models on record breaking heat extremes
summary: AI weather prediction (AIWP) models have emerged as a key complement to physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, and now often outperform them on aggregate skill. Yet, several studies report that physics-based models still forecast extreme events better, in particular record-breaking extremes, based on the evaluation of deterministic forecasts. Here we evaluate heat extreme forecasts from probabilistic AIWP models over global land and show that they clearly outperform the ECMWF IFS ensemble, both raw and post-processed, including for record-breaking events, in all regions and at all lead times considered. AIWP models better forecast the occurrence and intensity of extremes, are better calibrated in the tail and miss fewer records. Station observations confirm these results. We argue that many reported AIWP limitations stem from unsuitable verification choices, specifically comparing deterministic forecasts that target different quantities. Instead, a fair evaluation of extremes necessitates probabilistic verification.

title: A Sociophysics Approach to Measuring Democracy in the Decision Making of a Group: Three Indices
summary: A group does not usually consult all its members before every decision. This paper develops a quantitative framework for measuring how widely members are consulted in decision making within a group. Two kinds of records are considered: the number of members consulted for each decision and the number of decisions in which each member is consulted. From these records, two participation indices are defined, and their equality is proved analytically. A third index measures the fraction of decisions for which at least a specified percentage of members are consulted. The distribution of consultation levels is described using a discrete maximum-entropy model from statistical physics. Tail probabilities are used to obtain bounds for the main participation index. This study examines aggregate survey data from two groups. Their observed characteristics are broadly consistent with the patterns found across the full survey. Using binomial and Poisson calculations, the future probability that all members will be consulted for a decision is examined. Inequality in consultation among members is examined through Lorenz curves, the Gini coefficient and a normalised Shannon participation measure. The member-decision structure is represented as a bipartite network. Controlled simulations show that the same overall level of consultation can have different distributions among the members. The framework measures both the overall breadth of consultation and how consultation is distributed among the members. It therefore provides a quantitative sociophysical description of one measurable aspect of democracy in decision making within a group.

AI.title_translation: 一种测量群体决策中民主程度的社会物理学方法：三个指数
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于社会物理学的定量框架，通过三个新颖的指数和网络分析来测量群体决策中的民主程度与参与度分布。
AI.motivation: 群体通常不会在每次决策前咨询所有成员，本文旨在开发一个定量框架，用于测量群体决策中成员被咨询的广泛程度。
AI.method: 定义了两个参与指数和一个衡量特定决策比例的第三指数；利用统计物理学中的离散最大熵模型描述咨询水平的分布；使用洛伦兹曲线、基尼系数和归一化香农参与度量分析不平等性；将成员-决策结构表示为二分网络并进行受控模拟。
AI.result: 通过分析两组的聚合调查数据，发现其观察到的特征与全调查的模式大致一致；利用二项式和泊松计算检查了未来所有成员被咨询的概率；模拟表明相同的整体咨询水平在成员中可以有不同的分布。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功构建了一个量化评估群体决策中民主程度的社会物理学框架，能够有效衡量咨询的广度及其在成员间的分布情况。
AI.translation: 群体在做出每个决定之前通常不会咨询其所有成员。本文开发了一个定量框架，用于衡量群体决策中成员被咨询的广泛程度。考虑了两种记录：每个决策咨询的成员数量以及每个成员被咨询的决策数量。从这些记录中定义了两个参与指数，并分析证明了它们的相等性。第三个指数测量了至少有指定百分比的成员被咨询的决策比例。使用来自统计物理学的离散最大熵模型描述了咨询水平的分布。利用尾部概率获得了主要参与指数的界限。本研究检查了两组的汇总调查数据。他们观察到的特征与整个调查中发现的模式大致一致。使用二项式和泊松计算，检查了未来所有成员将被咨询进行决策的概率。通过洛伦兹曲线、基尼系数和标准化的香农参与度量，检查了成员之间咨询的不平等性。成员-决策结构被表示为二分网络。受控模拟表明，相同的总体咨询水平在成员中可以有不同的分布。该框架既衡量了整体咨询的广度，又衡量了咨询在成员之间的分布情况。因此，它为群体决策中民主的一个可测量方面提供了定量社会物理描述。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于社会物理学的定量框架来测量群体决策中的民主程度。通过定义三个参与指数、运用统计物理最大熵模型、洛伦兹曲线和二分网络分析，该研究能够有效评估群体决策中咨询的广度及其在成员间的分配不平等性。
AI.keywords: 社会物理学, 民主测量, 决策, 参与指数, 二分网络
AI.comments: 该论文通过社会物理学方法，将群体决策中的民主程度量化，创新性地引入了三个指数及最大熵模型，为研究组织行为和决策机制提供了新颖的定量工具。

title: Longitudinal Brain Aging in Covariance Space: Temporally Calibrated Bayesian Inference for Adaptive Covariance Operators
comments: 32 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary materials: 8 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Includes theoretical results, technical details, and a simulation study
summary: Functional brain aging is often characterized by differences between people of different ages, although aging unfolds within individuals. This distinction is especially important for functional connectivity, where the direction of covariance change may evolve across adulthood. We introduce a Bayesian longitudinal covariance-operator framework that models each visit covariance as a latent positive-definite state informed by repeated resting-state fMRI runs. The approach calibrates run-level information for temporal dependence and replicate variability, separates within-person aging from between-person age differences, and uses an adaptive tangent representation to learn the low-dimensional structure of longitudinal change without relying on pooled covariance variation. The longitudinal operator varies smoothly in magnitude and orientation with age, while exact Fréchet derivatives translate the fitted trajectory to the covariance scale. This framework allows us to examine how brain covariance organization changes within individuals, whether longitudinal aging follows the population age gradient, and which functional systems contribute to their divergence. In the Dallas Lifespan Brain Study, within-person covariance aging differs substantially from the cross-sectional age gradient through early and middle adulthood, with the discrepancy diminishing later in life. Covariance reorganization is strongest around midlife, and the longitudinal signal is concentrated in a few coordinated directions, with most off-diagonal change occurring between functional systems. These findings demonstrate that population-level signatures of brain aging do not necessarily reflect individual aging trajectories and highlight the importance of modeling longitudinal covariance change directly.

AI.title_translation: 协方差空间中的纵向大脑老化：自适应协方差算子的时间校准贝叶斯推断
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新型贝叶斯纵向协方差框架，发现个体内部的大脑功能老化轨迹与横截面的人群年龄差异存在显著不同，强调了直接研究个体纵向脑网络重组的重要性。
AI.motivation: 功能性大脑老化通常通过不同年龄人群的差异来表征，但老化实际上发生在个体内部。特别是对于功能连接而言，协方差变化的趋势可能在成年期不断演变，因此需要区分个体内部的老化与人群间的年龄差异。
AI.method: 引入了一种贝叶斯纵向协方差算子框架，将每次访问的协方差建模为潜正定状态，校准运行水平的时间依赖性和重复变异性，利用自适应切线表示学习纵向变化的低维结构，并使用精确的弗雷歇导数将拟合轨迹转换到协方差尺度。
AI.result: 在达拉斯全寿命脑研究中，个体内部协方差老化在成年早期和中期与横截面年龄梯度有很大不同，这种差异在晚年减小；协方差重组在成年中期最强，纵向信号集中在少数协调方向上。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，人群层面的大脑老化特征并不一定反映个体老化轨迹，强调了直接建模纵向协方差变化的重要性。
AI.translation: 功能性大脑老化通常通过不同年龄人群之间的差异来表征，尽管老化是在个体内部展开的。这种区分对于功能连接尤为重要，因为协方差变化的方向可能在整个成年期发生演变。我们引入了一个贝叶斯纵向协方差算子框架，将每次访问的协方差建模为一个由重复静息态fMRI运行支持的潜正定状态。该方法针对时间依赖性和重复变异性校准了运行水平的信息，将个体内老化与个体间年龄差异分离，并使用自适应切线表示来学习纵向变化的低维结构，而不依赖于合并的协方差变异。纵向算子随年龄在幅度和方向上平滑变化，而精确的弗雷歇导数将拟合的轨迹转换到协方差尺度。该框架使我们能够检查大脑协方差组织如何在个体内部发生变化，纵向老化是否遵循群体年龄梯度，以及哪些功能系统导致了它们的背离。在达拉斯全寿命脑研究中，个体内的协方差老化在成年早期和中期与横截面年龄梯度有很大不同，这种差异在晚年减小。协方差重组在成年中期最强大，纵向信号集中在几个协调的方向上，大多数非对角线变化发生在功能系统之间。这些发现表明，大脑老化的群体水平特征并不一定反映个体老化轨迹，并强调了直接模拟纵向协方差变化的重要性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种贝叶斯纵向协方差算子框架，用于分析静息态fMRI数据，以区分个体内部的大脑老化轨迹与人群间的年龄差异。研究发现，在成年早期和中期，个体内部的协方差老化与横截面年龄梯度存在显着差异，这表明群体水平的大脑老化特征不能简单等同于个体老化轨迹。
AI.keywords: 功能连接, 脑老化, 纵向协方差, 贝叶斯推断, 静息态fMRI
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一个贝叶斯纵向协方差算子框架，有效区分了个体内部老化轨迹与人群间的年龄差异，揭示了脑功能协方差在成年早期和中期随时间变化的独特性，对理解人类大脑老化具有重要方法论意义。

title: A New Perspective on Cumulative Residual Rényi Entropy
summary: This paper introduces a new cumulative residual Rényi entropy (CRRE), which addresses limitations of the existing cumulative residual Rényi entropy. The conventional measure suffers from two primary drawbacks: its failure to converge to the cumulative residual entropy (CRE) as the order parameter approaches unity, and its lack of guaranteed positivity. Our proposed CRRE resolves these issues, offering a theoretically consistent and always nonnegative measure of uncertainty in residual lifetimes. We explore its mathematical properties, including its relationship with existing information measures. Furthermore, the concept is extended to its dynamic version, and its time-dependent characteristics are investigated. A non-parametric estimator of the proposed CRRE is developed, its almost sure convergence is established, and is validated through Monte Carlo simulation. The effectiveness of CRRE as a tool for quantifying uncertainty is confirmed through its application in chaotic theory and financial data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个改进的累积剩余Rényi熵，克服了传统定义无法收敛到累积剩余熵且不保证非负性的缺陷，并在理论性质、估计方法及实际应用（如金融和混沌理论）中表现出优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的累积剩余Rényi熵（CRRE）存在两个主要缺陷：当阶参数趋于1时无法收敛到累积剩余熵（CRE），且无法保证非负性。为此，本文旨在提出一个新的视角来解决这些理论局限。
AI.method: 提出了改进的累积剩余Rényi熵定义，研究了其数学性质与与其他信息度量的关系，推导了其动态版本及时间相依特征，开发了非参数估计量并通过渐近几乎必然收敛性证明与蒙特卡洛模拟进行了验证。
AI.result: 提出的新型CRRE解决了传统度量的不收敛和非负性问题，提供了非负且理论一致的剩余寿命不确定性度量；证明了非参数估计量的几乎必然收敛性，并通过混沌理论和金融数据应用证实了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的新型累积剩余Rényi熵成功克服了传统度量的数学缺陷，为剩余寿命及相关领域的不确定性量度提供了一个理论一致且非负的稳健工具。
AI.translation: 本文引入了一种新的累积剩余Rényi熵（CRRE），以解决现有累积剩余Rényi熵的局限性。传统测度存在两个主要缺点：当阶参数趋于1时，它无法收敛到累积剩余熵（CRE），并且缺乏保证的非负性。我们提出的CRRE解决了这些问题，为剩余寿命的不确定性提供了一个理论上一致且始终非负的测度。我们探讨了它的数学性质，包括它与现有信息测度的关系。此外，该概念扩展到了动态版本，并研究了其时间依赖特征。开发了所提出的CRRE的非参数估计量，确立了其几乎必然收敛性，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行了验证。通过其在混沌理论和金融数据中的应用，证实了CRRE作为量化不确定性工具的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型的累积剩余Rényi熵（CRRE），解决了传统度量在极限收敛和非负性方面的缺陷。作者研究了其数学性质、动态扩展及非参数估计的收敛性，并通过模拟和实际数据应用验证了其在量化不确定性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 累积剩余Rényi熵, 不确定性度量, 非参数估计, 动态版本, 金融数据
AI.comments: 该论文针对传统累积剩余Rényi熵在极限情况下无法收敛至累积剩余熵以及缺乏非负性的严重缺陷，提出了一个修正的新定义。理论上更加自洽，并通过非参数估计和蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其有效性，在混沌理论和金融数据分析中展现出良好的应用前景。

title: Inverse Probability Weighting-based Mediation Analysis for Microbiome Data
summary:
Motivation: Mediation analysis is an important tool for elucidating causal mechanisms in biomedical research and has recently gained increasing attention in microbiome studies. Motivated by a microbiome study of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients, we investigate whether the effect of induction chemotherapy intensity on infection status is mediated through gut microbial taxa. This problem poses substantial methodological challenges due to the high dimensionality, zero inflation, and dependence of microbial mediators, as well as the presence of an exposure-induced mediator--outcome confounder, antibiotic use.
  Results: To address these challenges, we propose a novel nonparametric identification formula for the interventional indirect effect, a causal mediation estimand that remains identifiable in the presence of exposure-induced mediator--outcome confounding. Building on this identification result, we develop an inverse probability weighting estimator and construct standard normal bootstrap confidence intervals for inference. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed method achieves accurate effect estimation and maintains appropriate type I error rates and power in finite samples. Application to the AML microbiome study provides evidence of a statistically significant interventional indirect effect of induction chemotherapy intensity on infection risk through alterations in the gut microbiome.
  Availability and implementation: The R code for the simulation studies is available at https://github.com/YX-ZHANG-1/CausalMediationMicrobiome and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21960802.

AI.title_translation: 基于逆概率加权的微生物组数据中介分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于逆概率加权的中介分析方法，用于处理微生物组数据，解决了高维性、零膨胀和混杂等挑战。该方法在模拟中表现出准确性，并在急性髓系白血病(AML)患者研究中发现化疗强度通过肠道微生物组对感染风险产生显著间接影响。
AI.motivation: 在微生物组研究中阐明因果机制，特别是调查急性髓系白血病(AML)患者中诱导化疗强度对感染状态的影响是否通过肠道微生物类群介导。研究面临微生物介质的高维性、零膨胀、依赖性以及暴露诱导的介质-结果混杂因素（抗生素使用）等方法学挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种用于干预性间接效应的非参数识别公式，该估计量在存在暴露诱导的介质-结果混杂时仍可识别。在此基础上，开发了一种逆概率加权估计器，并构建了标准正态自举置信区间进行推断。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明，所提出的方法在有限样本中实现了准确的效应估计，并保持了适当的I型错误率和功效。应用于AML微生物组研究，提供了诱导化疗强度通过肠道微生物组改变对感染风险产生统计学上显著的干预性间接效应的证据。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的基于逆概率加权的中介分析方法有效解决了微生物组数据中高维性、零膨胀、依赖性及混杂等挑战，能够准确识别干预性间接效应，为生物医学研究中阐明复杂因果机制提供了有力工具。
AI.translation:
动机：中介分析是阐明生物医学研究中因果机制的重要工具，最近在微生物组研究中受到越来越多的关注。受一项关于急性髓系白血病（AML）患者微生物组研究的启发，我们研究了诱导化疗强度对感染状态的影响是否通过肠道微生物类群介导。这个问题由于微生物介质的高维性、零膨胀和依赖性，以及暴露诱导的介质-结果混杂因素（抗生素使用）的存在，带来了重大的方法学挑战。
结果：为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新的非参数识别公式，用于干预性间接效应，这是一种在存在暴露诱导的介质-结果混杂时仍可识别的因果中介估计量。在此识别结果的基础上，我们开发了一种逆概率加权估计器，并构建了标准正态自举置信区间进行推断。模拟研究表明，所提出的方法在有限样本中实现了准确的效应估计，并保持了适当的I型错误率和功效。应用于AML微生物组研究提供了诱导化疗强度通过肠道微生物组改变对感染风险产生统计学上显著的干预性间接效应的证据。
可用性和实施：模拟研究的R代码可在https://github.com/YX-ZHANG-1/CausalMediationMicrobiome获取，并已存档在Zenodo：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21960802。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于微生物组数据中介分析的逆概率加权（IPW）新方法，旨在解决高维性、零膨胀、依赖性及混杂等挑战。该方法引入了干预性间接效应的非参数识别公式和IPW估计器，并结合自举置信区间进行推断。模拟研究验证了其准确性和鲁棒性。在急性髓系白血病（AML）患者中的应用表明，诱导化疗强度通过肠道微生物组改变对感染风险存在显著的间接影响。
AI.keywords: 微生物组数据, 中介分析, 逆概率加权, 因果推断, 急性髓系白血病
AI.comments: 该论文为因果中介分析提供了一种创新的非参数方法，特别适用于复杂的微生物组数据。其优势在于解决了高维性和混杂等关键方法学挑战，这在微生物组研究中很常见。逆概率加权的使用为识别干预性间接效应提供了一个稳健的框架。这对于理解复杂的生物通路至关重要，并可能促进临床环境中更具针对性的干预措施。

title: The long shadow of pandemic: Understanding the lingering effects of cause-specific mortality shocks
comments: Mortality shocks, Long-lasting pandemic effects, Stochastic mortality modeling, Cause-specific mortality, Natural hedging
summary: In the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, empirical data have revealed that large-scale health crises not only cause immediate disruptions in mortality dynamics but also have persistent effects that may last for several years. Existing mortality models largely assume that mortality shocks are transitory and overlook how their effects can be long-lasting and heterogeneous across age groups and causes of death. In response to this limitation, we propose a novel stochastic mortality model that captures age- and cause-specific long-lasting effects of mortality jumps through a gamma-density-like decay function, estimated via a customized conditional maximum likelihood algorithm. Applying the model to recent U.S. mortality data, we reveal divergent persistence patterns across demographic groups and provide key insights into the tail risk profiles of life insurance and annuity products. Our scenario-based analyses further show that neglecting persistent shock effects can lead to suboptimal hedging, while the proposed model enables what-if testing to analyze such effects under potential future health crises.
comment: Mortality shocks, Long-lasting pandemic effects, Stochastic mortality modeling, Cause-specific mortality, Natural hedging

AI.title_translation: 大流行的漫长阴影：理解特定死因死亡冲击的持续影响
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的随机死亡率模型，旨在捕捉大流行等健康危机对特定年龄和特定死因死亡率的持久且异质性影响，并通过美国数据验证了其有效性，为保险产品提供了尾部风险洞察。
AI.motivation: 现有死亡率模型普遍认为死亡率冲击是暂时性的，忽视了其可能持续数年且在不同年龄组和死因之间存在异质性的长期影响。在COVID-19大流行后，实证数据揭示了大规模健康危机不仅造成即时死亡动态中断，还带来持久影响，因此需要一个能捕捉这些长期效应的模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的随机死亡率模型，通过伽马密度衰减函数来捕捉死亡率跳跃的年龄和特定死因的长期影响。该模型通过定制的条件最大似然算法进行估计。
AI.result: 模型应用于美国近期死亡率数据后，揭示了不同人口群体之间存在不同的持久模式。研究提供了关于人寿保险和年金产品尾部风险状况的关键见解。情景分析表明，忽视持续冲击效应可能导致次优的对冲。
AI.conclusion: 提出的模型能够有效捕捉大规模健康危机对特定年龄和特定死因死亡率的长期且异质性影响。忽视这些持久效应会影响风险管理决策，而该模型为分析未来健康危机下的潜在影响提供了“假设”测试能力。
AI.translation: 在COVID-19大流行之后，经验数据表明，大规模健康危机不仅会导致死亡率动态的即时中断，还会产生可能持续数年的持久影响。现有的死亡率模型大多假设死亡率冲击是短暂的，并且忽略了其影响如何长期存在以及在不同年龄组和死因之间存在异质性。针对这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的随机死亡率模型，该模型通过伽马密度衰减函数捕捉死亡率跳跃的年龄和特定死因的长期影响，并通过定制的条件最大似然算法进行估计。将该模型应用于近期美国死亡率数据，我们揭示了不同人口群体之间存在不同的持久模式，并为人寿保险和年金产品的尾部风险状况提供了关键见解。我们的情景分析进一步表明，忽视持续的冲击效应可能导致次优的对冲，而所提出的模型能够进行假设测试，以分析未来潜在健康危机下的此类影响。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有死亡率模型未能充分捕捉大规模健康危机（如大流行）对死亡率的长期、异质性影响的局限性，提出了一种新的随机死亡率模型。该模型利用伽马密度衰减函数，通过定制的条件最大似然算法，捕捉年龄和特定死因的死亡率跳跃的持久效应。应用于美国死亡率数据，该模型揭示了不同人口群体的持久模式，并为保险产品的尾部风险提供了洞察。研究强调，忽视这些持久效应会导致次优对冲，而新模型支持对未来健康危机的“假设”分析。
AI.keywords: 死亡率模型, 长期影响, 大流行, 尾部风险, 保险
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种能够捕捉死亡率冲击长期和异质性影响的新型随机死亡率模型，弥补了现有模型在处理大流行等危机后持续影响方面的不足。这对于保险和风险管理领域具有重要意义，因为它提供了更准确的风险评估工具，尤其是在当前全球健康不确定性增加的背景下。

title: Simulation Based Inference of a Simple Neural Network Structure
summary: Neurophysiologists are nowadays able to record from a large number of extracellular electrodes and to extract, from the raw data, the sequences of action potentials or spikes generated by many neurons. Unfortunately these ''many neurons'' still represent only a tiny fraction of the neuronal population that constitutes the network. Using association statistics such as the estimation of the cross-correlation functions, they are trying to infer the structure of the network formed by the recorded neurons. But this inference is compromised by the tremendous under-sampling of the neuronal population. We propose to focus instead on simple spike train statistics, like the empirical spikes frequency, or the interspike interval distribution. Their sampling distributions can be estimated by simulations, and, given a few observed spike train statistics, they provide enough information to infer the structure of the underlying network. We show that, on a ''toy model'', our method gives significantly better results than the sub-network reconstruction method with regards to the inference of the connection probability of the original network.

AI.title_translation: 基于仿真的简单神经网络结构推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用简单的脉冲序列统计数据和仿真来推断神经网络结构的方法，该方法在处理神经元种群欠采样问题上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 神经生理学家在推断由记录神经元形成的神经网络结构时，面临着巨大的神经元种群欠采样问题，导致现有基于关联统计（如交叉相关函数）的推断方法效果不佳。
AI.method: 该论文提出转而关注简单的脉冲序列统计数据，如经验脉冲频率或脉冲间隔分布。这些统计数据的采样分布可以通过仿真估计，并且在给定少量观测到的脉冲序列统计数据的情况下，它们提供了足够的信息来推断底层网络结构。
AI.result: 在“玩具模型”上，该方法在推断原始网络的连接概率方面，比子网络重建方法取得了显著更好的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用简单的脉冲序列统计数据和仿真，可以有效地克服神经元种群欠采样问题，从而更好地推断神经网络的结构。
AI.translation: 神经生理学家现在能够从大量的细胞外电极记录数据，并从原始数据中提取出许多神经元产生的动作电位或脉冲序列。不幸的是，这些“许多神经元”仍然只占构成网络的神经元总数的一小部分。他们试图通过使用关联统计，如交叉相关函数的估计，来推断由记录神经元形成的网络的结构。但是这种推断受到神经元种群巨大欠采样的影响。我们建议转而关注简单的脉冲序列统计数据，例如经验脉冲频率或脉冲间隔分布。它们的采样分布可以通过仿真进行估计，并且在给定少量观测到的脉冲序列统计数据的情况下，它们提供了足够的信息来推断底层网络的结构。我们表明，在一个“玩具模型”上，我们的方法在推断原始网络的连接概率方面，比子网络重建方法取得了显著更好的结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种解决神经元网络结构推断中欠采样问题的新方法。现有方法因只能记录一小部分神经元而受到限制。该研究转而利用简单的脉冲序列统计数据（如脉冲频率和脉冲间隔分布），并通过仿真估计其采样分布。实验结果表明，在“玩具模型”上，该方法在推断网络连接概率方面显著优于传统的子网络重建方法。
AI.keywords: 神经网络结构, 仿真推断, 脉冲序列统计, 欠采样, 连接概率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种通过关注简单脉冲序列统计数据并结合仿真来克服神经元种群欠采样问题的神经网络结构推断方法。这对于神经科学领域理解大脑连接性具有重要意义，尤其是在面对有限的实验数据时。其提出的方法在“玩具模型”上显示出优越性，未来可进一步验证其在更复杂、真实神经系统数据上的表现。

title: Principal stratification with continuous treatments and continuous post-treatment variables
summary: Principal stratification (PS) is a commonly used approach for understanding the mechanisms through which a treatment affects an outcome. The goal of this work is to extend the PS framework to studies with continuous treatments, which introduces a number of both challenges and opportunities in terms of defining causal effects and performing inference. This manuscript provides multiple key methodological contributions: 1) we introduce principal causal estimands for continuous treatments that provide insights into different causal mechanisms, 2) we show that nonparametric identification is possible under a principal ignorability assumption, but only under a restrictive assumption on the joint distribution of potential mediators, which can be dropped under certain parametric assumptions, 3) we utilize nonparametric Bayesian models for the joint distribution of the potential mediating variables to mitigate issues from model misspecification, and 4) we provide theoretical justification for utilizing an outcome model to identify the joint distribution of the potential mediating variables, and show that this is only possible if a principal ignorability assumption is violated. Lastly, we illustrate our methodology by applying it to a novel study of the relationship between the economy and arrest rates, and how this is potentially mediated by police capacity.

AI.title_translation: 带有连续处理和连续后处理变量的主分层研究
AI.tldr: 本文将主分层因果推断框架扩展至连续处理变量和连续中介变量，提出了新的因果估计量、识别条件和非参数贝叶斯推断方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的主分层（PS）方法通常局限于离散处理，无法满足包含连续处理变量和连续后处理变量（中介变量）的复杂研究需求，因此需要扩展PS框架以理解这类情境下的因果机制。
AI.method: 提出了连续处理下的主因果估计量；在主可忽略性假设下探讨了非参数识别条件；利用非参数贝叶斯模型建模潜在中介变量的联合分布以减少模型误设；并对利用结果模型识别联合分布提供了理论依据。
AI.result: 证明了在主可忽略性假设下进行非参数识别的条件；展示了非参数贝叶斯模型在缓解模型误设方面的作用；阐明了利用结果模型识别潜在中介变量联合分布的必要条件（即需违反主可忽略性假设）；并成功应用于警察警力如何介导经济与逮捕率关系的实证研究。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将主分层框架扩展至连续处理与连续中介变量，提出了新的因果效应估计量，讨论了识别条件，并通过非参数贝叶斯模型进行推断，最后成功应用于经济与逮捕率的实证研究中。
AI.translation: 主分层（PS）是理解处理影响结果机制的常用方法。本工作的目标是将PS框架扩展到具有连续处理的研究中，这在定义因果效应和进行推断方面引入了许多挑战和机遇。本手稿提供了多个关键的方法论贡献：1）我们引入了用于连续处理的主因果估计量，以深入了解不同的因果机制；2）我们证明了在主可忽略性假设下非参数识别是可能的，但前提是对潜在中介变量的联合分布做出严格假设，而在某些参数假设下可以放弃该假设；3）我们利用潜在中介变量联合分布的非参数贝叶斯模型来减轻模型误设带来的问题；4）我们为利用结果模型识别潜在中介变量的联合分布提供了理论依据，并表明这只有在违反主可忽略性假设时才可能实现。最后，我们将该方法应用于一项关于经济与逮捕率之间关系及其如何可能由警力介导的新研究中。
AI.summary: 本文将主分层框架扩展至连续处理和连续后处理变量，提出了新型主因果估计量，探讨了非参数识别条件，采用非参数贝叶斯模型克服模型误设，并提供了关于结果模型识别的理论洞察，最后通过实际数据验证了方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 主分层, 连续处理变量, 因果机制, 非参数贝叶斯, 因果推断
AI.comments: 该论文将主分层（PS）框架推广到连续处理变量和连续后处理变量的场景，具有重要的理论和方法论价值，特别是在处理无参数识别、模型误设以及利用结果模型进行识别方面作出了创新贡献。

title: Propensity score with factor loadings: evaluating the effect of the Paris Agreement on the returns of European stocks
summary: Factor models for longitudinal data, where policy adoption is unconfounded with respect to a low-dimensional set of latent factor loadings, have become increasingly popular for causal inference. Most existing approaches, however, rely on a causal finite-sample approach or computationally intensive methods, limiting their applicability and external validity. In this paper, we propose a novel method for panel causal inference within a super-population framework, based on inverse propensity score weighting, where the propensity score is a function of latent factor loadings. The approach relaxes the traditional restrictive assumptions of causal panel methods, while offering advantages in terms of causal interpretability, policy relevance, and computational efficiency. Under standard assumptions, we develop a three-step estimation procedure for the ATT and derive its large-sample properties using M-estimation theory. Simulation results show that the proposed estimator remains reliable across a variety of designs, including settings with misspecified factor structure and weakly dependent errors. We apply the method to assess the causal effect of the Paris Agreement - a policy aimed at fostering the transition to a low-carbon economy - on European stock returns. Our empirical results suggest a statistically significant and negative short-run effect on the stock returns of firms that demonstrate a strong commitment to sustainability.

AI.title_translation: 带因子载荷的倾向得分：评估《巴黎协定》对欧洲股票收益的影响
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种带因子载荷的倾向得分新方法，用于面板数据的因果推断，并发现《巴黎协定》对致力于可持续发展的欧洲股票收益有统计上显著的短期负面影响。
AI.motivation: 现有的面板因果推断方法大多依赖于因果有限样本方法或计算密集型方法，限制了其适用性和外部有效性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于逆倾向得分加权的面板因果推断新方法，其中倾向得分是潜在因子载荷的函数，并在超总体框架下进行。该方法开发了一个三步估计程序来计算ATT，并利用M估计理论推导了其大样本性质。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，所提出的估计器在各种设计中都保持可靠，包括因子结构错误指定和弱相关误差的情况。实证结果表明，《巴黎协定》对那些表现出强烈可持续发展承诺的公司的股票收益产生了统计上显著的短期负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新颖且稳健的面板因果推断方法，并发现《巴黎协定》对致力于可持续发展的欧洲公司的股票收益产生了统计上显著的短期负面影响。
AI.translation: 因子模型用于纵向数据，其中政策采纳与低维潜在因子载荷不混淆，已在因果推断中越来越受欢迎。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于因果有限样本方法或计算密集型方法，限制了其适用性和外部有效性。在本文中，我们提出了一种在超总体框架下进行面板因果推断的新方法，该方法基于逆倾向得分加权，其中倾向得分是潜在因子载荷的函数。该方法放宽了因果面板方法的传统限制性假设，同时在因果可解释性、政策相关性和计算效率方面具有优势。在标准假设下，我们开发了一个用于平均处理效应（ATT）的三步估计程序，并利用M估计理论推导了其大样本性质。模拟结果表明，所提出的估计器在各种设计中都保持可靠，包括因子结构错误指定和弱相关误差的情况。我们将该方法应用于评估《巴黎协定》（一项旨在促进向低碳经济转型的政策）对欧洲股票收益的因果效应。我们的实证结果表明，对那些表现出强烈可持续发展承诺的公司的股票收益产生了统计上显著的短期负面影响。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的面板因果推断方法，该方法基于逆倾向得分加权，其中倾向得分是潜在因子载荷的函数，旨在解决现有方法在适用性和外部有效性方面的局限性。该方法在超总体框架下开发，并提供了因果可解释性、政策相关性和计算效率方面的优势。模拟结果证实了其稳健性，而应用于《巴黎协定》的实证分析表明，该协定对那些强烈致力于可持续发展的欧洲公司的股票收益产生了统计上显著的短期负面影响。
AI.keywords: 倾向得分, 因子载荷, 因果推断, 巴黎协定, 股票收益
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种将因子载荷纳入倾向得分的逆倾向得分加权方法，用于面板因果推断，这在理论上放宽了传统假设，并在实践中提高了计算效率和因果可解释性。其对《巴黎协定》影响的实证分析具有重要的政策相关性，揭示了气候政策对特定股票市场的短期影响。

title: Robust inference for risk heterogeneity under group imbalance
summary: Population-level heterogeneity is ubiquitous in biomedical data, where differences across demographic or clinical subgroups can substantially alter risk patterns. For example, in intensive care unit (ICU) studies, the mortality risk associated with specific admission diagnoses can vary across ethnic groups. Existing approaches for detecting risk heterogeneity are often sensitive to baseline model misspecification and regularization bias, both of which commonly arise in practice. In this paper, we propose a robust framework for inferring risk heterogeneity between two populations using Neyman orthogonality, which yields estimators that are locally insensitive to nuisance parameter estimation error. The proposed estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal, and simulation studies demonstrate that in finite samples our method substantially reduces bias and improves inferential stability compared with standard likelihood-based approaches. In an application to the eICU Collaborative Research Database, our method reveals clinically meaningful ethnicity-specific heterogeneity in admission diagnoses for in-hospital mortality that standard likelihood-based methods fail to detect.

AI.title_translation: 群体失衡下风险异质性的稳健推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Neyman正交性的稳健框架，用于推断两群体间的风险异质性，该方法对基线模型误规范和正则化偏差不敏感，并在模拟和真实数据中表现出优于传统方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 生物医学数据中普遍存在群体水平异质性，不同人口统计学或临床亚组间的差异会显著改变风险模式。现有检测风险异质性的方法对基线模型误规范和正则化偏差敏感，而这些问题在实践中很常见。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于Neyman正交性的稳健框架，用于推断两群体间的风险异质性。该方法产生的估计量对干扰参数估计误差局部不敏感。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明，在有限样本中，该方法与标准似然方法相比，显著降低了偏差并提高了推断稳定性。在eICU协作研究数据库的应用中，该方法揭示了入院诊断中与种族相关的临床意义异质性，而标准似然方法未能检测到。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于Neyman正交性的稳健框架能够有效且稳健地推断群体间的风险异质性，尤其在现有方法失效的情况下，具有重要的临床应用价值。
AI.translation: 群体水平异质性在生物医学数据中普遍存在，其中人口统计学或临床亚组间的差异可以显著改变风险模式。例如，在重症监护病房 (ICU) 研究中，与特定入院诊断相关的死亡风险可能因种族群体而异。现有检测风险异质性的方法通常对基线模型误规范和正则化偏差敏感，这两者在实践中都很常见。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于Neyman正交性的稳健框架，用于推断两群体间的风险异质性，该框架产生的估计量对干扰参数估计误差局部不敏感。所提出的估计量是一致且渐近正态的，模拟研究表明，在有限样本中，我们的方法与标准似然方法相比，显著降低了偏差并提高了推断稳定性。在eICU协作研究数据库的应用中，我们的方法揭示了入院诊断中与种族相关的临床意义异质性，而标准似然方法未能检测到。
AI.summary: 本文针对生物医学数据中常见的群体风险异质性推断问题，提出了一种基于Neyman正交性的稳健框架。该方法旨在解决现有方法对模型误规范和正则化偏差敏感的缺点，通过产生对干扰参数估计误差局部不敏感的估计量，实现对两群体间风险异质性的稳健推断。模拟研究和真实世界数据应用均表明，该方法在降低偏差、提高推断稳定性和发现临床有意义的异质性方面优于传统的似然方法。
AI.keywords: 风险异质性, 稳健推断, Neyman正交性, 群体失衡, 生物医学数据
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了Neyman正交性来构建一个对基线模型误规范和正则化偏差具有局部不敏感性的稳健推断框架。这解决了现有方法在处理生物医学数据中常见复杂性时的局限性，特别是在群体失衡和风险异质性分析方面具有重要意义。其在真实ICU数据中的应用结果也证实了该方法的临床价值。

title: Interior smoothness and zero-variance geometry for finite-maturity Heston American puts
summary: We study finite-maturity American puts in the Heston model without the Feller condition. At positive variance, the exercise boundary is smooth and strictly decreasing in remaining maturity and variance. At zero variance, the endpoint is locally Lipschitz in remaining maturity, the boundary moves with bounded speed in maturity uniformly down to zero variance, and it extends continuously to the axis. Each boundary slice at positive maturity has a regular $C^1$ closure tangent to the zero-variance axis, its stock threshold has variance derivative tending to minus infinity, and both partial derivatives of the inverse boundary graph vanish along the slice. The continuation premium at the axis contact stock is of order variance, and as a consequence smooth fit fails in the variance direction at the axis. At expiry the whole boundary, including its axis edge, converges to the strike. We give quantitative boundary gap bounds, an exact limiting weighted boundary Hessian, and vertical identities retaining the maturity term. Exact boundary gap equivalents remain open.

AI.title_translation: 有限期Heston美式看跌期权的内部平滑性和零方差几何
AI.tldr: 本文研究了Heston模型中有限期美式看跌期权的行权边界行为，特别是在正方差和零方差条件下的平滑性、连续性及其与到期日和方差的关系。
AI.motivation: 研究Heston模型中有限期美式看跌期权的行权边界特性，尤其是在没有Feller条件下的行为，以及在零方差情况下的几何特性。
AI.result: 在正方差下，行权边界是平滑且严格递减的。在零方差下，端点局部Lipschitz，边界以有界速度移动并连续延伸到轴。每个正到期日的边界切片具有规则的C^1闭包，与零方差轴相切，其股票阈值的方差导数趋于负无穷大，并且逆边界图的两个偏导数沿切片消失。轴接触股票的续期溢价是方差量级的，导致在轴处方差方向的平滑拟合失败。到期时，整个边界（包括其轴边缘）收敛到执行价格。提供了量化边界间隙界限、精确的加权边界Hessian极限和保留到期项的垂直恒等式。
AI.conclusion: Heston模型中有限期美式看跌期权的行权边界在不同方差条件下展现出复杂的几何和平滑性特性，特别是在零方差轴处平滑拟合失败，且边界在到期时收敛到执行价格。
AI.translation: 我们研究Heston模型中没有Feller条件的有限期美式看跌期权。在正方差下，行权边界是平滑的，并且随着剩余到期日和方差的增加而严格递减。在零方差下，端点在剩余到期日上局部Lipschitz，边界以有界速度在到期日上均匀移动至零方差，并连续延伸到轴。每个正到期日的边界切片具有规则的C^1闭包，与零方差轴相切，其股票阈值的方差导数趋于负无穷大，并且逆边界图的两个偏导数沿切片消失。轴接触股票的续期溢价是方差量级的，因此在轴处的方差方向上平滑拟合失败。到期时，整个边界，包括其轴边缘，收敛到执行价格。我们给出了量化边界间隙界限，一个精确的加权边界Hessian极限，以及保留到期项的垂直恒等式。精确的边界间隙等价物仍然是开放问题。
AI.summary: 本文分析了Heston模型中有限期美式看跌期权的行权边界特性，特别关注其在正方差和零方差条件下的平滑性和几何行为。研究发现，在正方差下边界平滑且递减，而在零方差下，边界展现出局部Lipschitz连续性，并连续延伸至零方差轴。文章还揭示了在零方差轴处平滑拟合的失效，并提供了关于边界间隙、Hessian和垂直恒等式的量化结果。
AI.keywords: Heston模型, 美式看跌期权, 行权边界, 零方差几何, 平滑性
AI.comments: 这篇论文深入探讨了Heston模型中美式期权定价的一个复杂方面，即行权边界的几何和分析性质，特别是在方差接近零时的行为。其创新之处在于详细分析了零方差条件下的边界特性，并指出了平滑拟合失效的关键发现。这对于理解Heston模型在低波动率情景下的应用具有重要意义。

title: Regime Detection in Latent Factor Models -- A Bayesian Decision-Theoretic Approach
summary: Regime-switching multi-factor models are widely used in quantitative finance, but filtering does not by itself determine when an agent should act on inferred regime changes. We formulate online regime detection with latent factors and hidden regimes as a Bayesian decision problem balancing false alarms, detection delay, and misclassification. Since posterior regime probabilities are generally non-Markovian, the problem is represented as a measure-valued optimal stopping problem and approximated using particle filtering with Monte Carlo dynamic programming. A single-change-point Heston model provides a benchmark. With observed variance, the problem reduces to a two-dimensional Markov free-boundary problem, while under latent variance decisions are based on the filtered posterior measure. Numerical experiments in Heston and regime-switching Vasicek models show that the latent-information procedure can outperform feasible plug-in rules.

AI.title_translation: 潜因子模型中的机制检测——一种贝叶斯决策理论方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种贝叶斯决策理论方法，用于在线检测潜因子模型中的机制转换，平衡了误报、检测延迟和错误分类，并通过数值实验证明其优于现有规则。
AI.motivation: 现有的机制转换多因子模型广泛应用于量化金融，但滤波本身无法确定代理何时应根据推断出的机制变化采取行动。
AI.method: 本文将包含潜因子和隐藏机制的在线机制检测问题表述为贝叶斯决策问题，以平衡误报、检测延迟和错误分类。由于后验机制概率通常是非马尔可夫的，该问题被表示为一个测度值最优停止问题，并使用粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划进行近似。以单变点Heston模型作为基准，在观测方差下，问题简化为二维马尔可夫自由边界问题；在潜藏方差下，决策基于滤波后的后验测度。
AI.result: 在Heston和机制转换Vasicek模型中的数值实验表明，潜信息（latent-information）过程可以优于可行的即插即用（plug-in）规则。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出并验证了一种基于贝叶斯决策理论的潜因子模型在线机制检测方法，该方法通过平衡误报、检测延迟和错误分类等成本，在数值实验中表现出优于传统即插即用规则的性能。
AI.translation: 机制转换多因子模型在量化金融中被广泛使用，但滤波本身并不能决定代理何时应该根据推断出的机制变化采取行动。我们将包含潜因子和隐藏机制的在线机制检测问题表述为一个贝叶斯决策问题，以平衡误报、检测延迟和错误分类。由于后验机制概率通常是非马尔可夫的，该问题被表示为一个测度值最优停止问题，并使用粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划进行近似。单变点Heston模型提供了一个基准。在观测方差下，该问题简化为二维马尔可夫自由边界问题，而在潜藏方差下，决策则基于滤波后的后验测度。在Heston和机制转换Vasicek模型中的数值实验表明，潜信息过程可以优于可行的即插即用规则。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯决策理论方法，用于解决潜因子模型中在线机制检测的问题。该方法将检测任务框架为一个平衡误报、检测延迟和错误分类的贝叶斯决策问题，并通过测度值最优停止问题和粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划进行近似。研究在Heston和Vasicek模型上进行了数值实验，结果表明该潜信息处理方法在性能上优于传统的即插即用规则。
AI.keywords: 机制检测, 潜因子模型, 贝叶斯决策, 最优停止, 粒子滤波
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将在线机制检测问题（特别是包含潜因子和隐藏机制的情况）转化为一个贝叶斯决策问题，并引入了测度值最优停止问题和粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划来解决非马尔可夫后验概率的挑战。这种方法能够更有效地平衡决策中的各种成本，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Active Portfolio Management in Concentrated Equity Markets
summary: The equal-weighted portfolio is a passive, rule-based strategy that has historically been difficult to outperform, delivering higher returns than the capitalization-weighted "market" benchmark across many markets and periods. Stochastic portfolio theory (SPT) reveals that this relative performance is regime dependent, with the equal-weighted portfolio underperforming during periods of increasing market concentration and high correlations, particularly market bubbles. These observations have motivated us to formulate and solve a stochastic control problem in which an investor actively allocates between the equal-weighted and market portfolios. The investor bases their allocation decisions on forecasts made under a flexible stochastic diversity--dispersion (SDD) model. Using a quadratic surrogate for implementation frictions, we characterize the optimal allocation through a linear forward--backward SDE and obtain an explicit "aiming in front of a moving target" representation of the optimal trading rate, in the spirit of Gârleanu and Pedersen. The penalty parameters are calibrated in sample to match the cumulative wealth effect of proportional transaction costs, while out-of-sample performance is evaluated with those costs deducted directly from portfolio wealth. Using historical S&P 500 data, we show that a mean-reverting SDD specification reproduces several empirical features of market diversity and dispersion. In out-of-sample backtests from 1995 to 2024, the resulting strategies deliver higher cumulative net returns than both the equal-weighted and market portfolios, and higher information ratios than the equal-weighted portfolio after 15-basis-point proportional transaction costs.

AI.title_translation: 集中股票市场中的主动投资组合管理
AI.tldr: 提出了一种在集中股票市场中动态配置等权重和市值加权组合的主动策略，通过控制交易成本显著提升了长期的净回报和信息比率。
AI.motivation: 等权重组合虽然历史表现优异，但在市场集中度上升、高相关性或泡沫期表现落后，因此需要一种主动分配策略在等权重组合和市值加权市场组合之间进行动态优化，并考虑交易成本的影响。
AI.method: 构建基于随机多样性-离散度（SDD）模型的随机控制问题，利用二次代理处理实施摩擦，通过线性正向-反向随机微分方程（BSDE）求解最优配置，并采用历史数据进行样本内校准与样本外回测。
AI.result: 使用1995至2024年S&P 500历史数据的样本外回测表明，该策略在扣除15个基点的比例交易成本后，实现了高于等权重和市值加权组合的累积净回报，以及高于等权重组合的信息比率。
AI.conclusion: 基于SDD模型的动态资产配置策略能有效平衡等权重和市值加权组合，在考虑交易成本的前提下实现超额收益和更高的信息比率。
AI.translation: 等权重投资组合是一种被动、基于规则的策略，历史表明很难被超越，它在许多市场和时期都提供了高于资本加权“市场”基准的回报。随机投资组合理论（SPT）表明，这种相对表现在不同机制下有所不同，在市场集中度增加和高相关性时期（特别是市场泡沫期间），等权重投资组合表现不佳。这些观察促使我们制定并解决了一个随机控制问题，其中投资者在等权重投资组合和市场投资组合之间进行主动资产配置。投资者的配置决策基于在灵活的随机多样性-离散度（SDD）模型下做出的预测。利用实施摩擦的二次替代方案，我们通过线性正向-反向SDE刻画了最优配置，并获得了类似于Gârleanu和Pedersen的关于最优交易速率的显式“瞄准移动目标前方”的表示。惩罚参数通过样本内校准以匹配比例交易成本的累积财富效应，而样本外绩效则直接从投资组合财富中扣除这些成本进行评估。使用历史标普500数据，我们表明均值回归的SDD规范再现了市场多样性和离散度的几个经验特征。在1995年至2024年的样本外回测中，在扣除15个基点的比例交易成本后，所得策略不仅实现了比等权重和市场投资组合更高的累积净回报，还获得了比等权重投资组合更高的信息比率。
AI.summary: 该文提出了一种在集中股票市场中进行主动投资组合管理的方法，通过结合随机投资组合理论和灵活的SDD模型，动态分配等权重组合与市值加权组合，在考虑交易成本的情况下有效提升了投资组合的风险调整收益。
AI.keywords: 主动投资组合管理, 随机投资组合理论, 资产配置, 交易成本, 市场集中度
AI.comments: 该论文结合了随机投资组合理论（SPT）与最优交易控制，通过引入随机多样性-离散度（SDD）模型和二次交易摩擦惩罚，解决了在集中度高或市场泡沫时期等-weight组合表现不佳的问题，在1995至2024年的S&P 500回测中取得了优于基准的净回报和信息比率。
